title: KYC Senior Analyst
description:
Step into a role of KYC Senior Analyst, where you’ll take responsibility for client service and operational execution task. You must take responsibility for controlling risk and enhancing controls in connection to your job and areas of responsibility in accordance with rules and regulations.
  
  
**You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:**

* Good knowledge and experience of KYC.
* End-to-end KYC (E2E KYC), CDD and EDD, entity types like Corporates, Fund, trust, SPV and FI. Client onboarding, periodic reviews, renewals/refresh, remediation etc.
* Basics of Financial crime.

**Desirable Skillsets**

* Any AML stream related experience, preferably CDD (Client Onboarding).
* Should have interacted with Front office and RM teams via Phone on a daily basis.
* Should have worked on all Risk types and individually able to classify a risk of both individual and entity client types.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support Wholesale Onboarding with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, and issue resolution.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Support with day-to-day Wholesale Onboarding initiatives including KYC processing, reviewing (which can include Quality Checking), reporting, trading and issue resolution.
* Collaboration and engagement with clients/front office to gather Customer Due Diligence information/evidence in order to onboard or refresh a clients KYC in line with documented policy.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate Wholesale Onboarding processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in Wholesale Onboarding processes.
* Development and implementation of Wholesale Onboarding procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on Wholesale Onboarding performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in Wholesale Onboarding.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve Wholesale Onboarding efficiency and effectiveness.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Head of Engineering: EHR Integration
description:
**Head of Engineering: EHR Integration**

**Pay:**
₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

**Type:**
Full-time

**Hours:**
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST

**Entity:**
XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)

**Department:**
EHR Integration

**On-site or remote:**
On-site, Monday through Friday

**Reports to:**
Chief Technology Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

**Position Summary**

You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDox’s SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance.
* Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim.
* Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur.
* Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action.
* Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production.
* Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review.
* Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years building production software.
* 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery.
* Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact.
* Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations.
* Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems.
* Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team.
* Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines.

**Location and Schedule**

This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel.

**Compensation**

* Base salary of ₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
* Stock options.
* Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts.

**Benefits**

* Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy.
* Company cab service for all Noida employees.

**To Apply**

Apply at
https://careers.xpertdox.com/
.

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Software Test Engineer (ACCT)
description:
**Description**
**Trintech**
is an award-winning AI driven Fintech SaaS organization transforming the way finance teams operate and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Software Test Engineer**
to lead quality assurance efforts and ensure the delivery of reliable, high-performing software solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing comprehensive test strategies across all phases of the software development lifecycle. Your expertise in test automation, performance testing and quality standards will guide the team in identifying and resolving issues effectively, fostering a culture of quality.
  
  
As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership to improve testing processes, tools and methodologies. Your role will have a significant impact on enhancing the efficiency, scalability and reliability of our products, ensuring an exceptional user experience.
  
  
This position is ideal for a seasoned professional with a strong technical foundation, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* The Sr Software Test Engineer will be responsible for end-to-end testing activities.
* Develop and execute test plans consisting of both manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality against requirements and specifications.
* Identify, troubleshoot, report, and track software defects and issues.
* Perform functional, performance, and regression testing of software products.
* Report test results and defects to the development team and other stakeholders and work on the resolution.
* Provide suggestions and feedback to improve the quality of the software development process across teams.
* Stay updated with industry trends in software testing methodologies and tools.
* Active participation in planning, analysis, and estimation of backlog requirements.
* Configure test environments with different platform combinations for testing.
* Ability to work in a close team environment and engage with other departments.
* Able to work with minimal supervision and still meet job requirements and tight deadlines.
* Learn an automation tool (if new to automation) and automate the test cases.
* Learn a performance testing tool (if new to performance testing) and run the performance test cases.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 4-6 years of experience in software testing
* Extensive experience with manual and automated testing methodologies, including functional, regression and performance testing.
* Experience in test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium or playwright
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner or other related tools to validate scalability and system performance under load.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, isolate and troubleshoot issues, ensuring high-quality test coverage.
* Proven ability to work effectively with developers, product managers and other stakeholders, ensuring that testing needs are integrated early in the development process.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to clearly report issues, document test cases and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, promoting best practices and continuous improvement within the team.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or similar.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered testing tools and working knowledge of how AI and ML model behaviors influence test strategy, test data design, and validation approaches.
* Experience testing cloud-native applications on Azure, or any other cloud platform, including validation of microservices, APIs, and cloud service integrations
* Previous experience with Reconciliation and/or month-end close applications is preferred

**Cultural Fit**

* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Superior analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Desire to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Detail-oriented with excellent organization skills
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Creative and Innovative thinking
* Embraces change, growth, and evolution

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Enterprise Patch Management

* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.

* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.

Automation & Integration
  
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement & Delivery Governance
  
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

**Required Skills**

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

**MINIMUM EDUCATION**
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.
  
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Identify and Prioritise Risk
  
  

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
* Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.

Coordinate Remediation
  
  

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
* Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Improve Security Practices
  
  

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
* Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

Report and Govern
  
  

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.

Desirable

* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

**Head of D2C — The Cinnamon Kitchen (TCK)**

Location: Delhi NCR (hybrid) · Full-time ·

**About TCK:**
The Cinnamon Kitchen is a D2C health-snacking and bakery brand built on one promise — “So good, you’ll forget it’s good for you!” We sell direct, on quick commerce, and on e-commerce, and we’re scaling fast.

**The role:**
we’re looking for someone to take full ownership — strategic and financial — of our D2C website channel. This isn’t a pure strategist role or a pure media-buying role: you’re accountable for the complete P&L of this channel (revenue, ad spend efficiency, margins), you can run and monitor paid campaigns hands-on when needed, and you’ll manage our performance marketing agency with enough technical depth to catch problems in real time rather than after the fact. You’ll also work directly with our in-house creative and copy teams to get the right tests shipped fast.

**What you’ll own:**

* Full P&L ownership of the D2C website channel — revenue, ad spend efficiency/ROAS, margins, and net contribution, not just a growth or conversion number
* Hands-on ability to run, monitor, and audit paid campaigns directly (Meta, Google Ads) — not solely through agency briefs; you can step in and execute or course-correct in real time
* Managing our external performance marketing agency: setting strategy, holding them to agreed thresholds (like an agreed ROAS floor), and catching problems as they happen, not after a monthly report
* Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, product pages, and checkout
* A direct working relationship with our in-house creative and copy leads, so creative testing moves at the speed the business needs

**What you bring:**

* 6-8+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct hands-on experience running paid campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads) at meaningful spend — agency-side or brand-side
* Proven experience owning a full P&L or revenue-and-cost number for a channel or business unit, not just a media budget
* Experience managing or working closely with an external performance marketing agency, with the technical depth to audit and push back on their work
* Comfort with funnel/CRO thinking (landing page and checkout optimization), not just media buying
* Working fluency with analytics tools (GA4, Shopify or similar) and the discipline to make decisions from data, not channel dashboards alone
* D2C or FMCG category experience, ideally food or consumables, is a strong plus

To apply, please email on priyasha@cinnamon.kitchen with the subject- Head of Growth- D2C

title: Brand Strategist
description:
**About Us**

SEREKO is India’s first psychodermatology skincare brand, built at the intersection of skin science,

mental wellness, and modern consumer behaviour. We believe skincare is not just topical, it’s

emotional, habitual, and deeply personal. We’re building a brand that’s thoughtful, science-backed,

and culturally relevant.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a Brand Associate who lives and breathes brand thinking, storytelling, and

consumer insight. This role sits at the heart of how SEREKO shows up, across campaigns, product

launches, content, community, and culture. You will be responsible for shaping brand communication

that is emotionally resonant, strategically sound, and performance-aware.

This is not a pure “marketing execution” role this is for someone who can think why before how,

and turn insight into creative that actually moves people.

Location: Sector 142, Noida

Experience Level: 2–3 years preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand Strategy & Communication**

• Own and evolve SEREKO’s brand voice, narrative, and communication across all

touchpoints: digital, offline, performance, PR, and experiential.

• Ensure consistency and clarity of brand messaging across platforms (website, social, ads,

packaging, events, collaborations).

• Translate psychodermatology insights into relatable, consumer-first storytelling.

**Creative Copywriting & Content Direction**

• Lead creative copywriting for campaigns, product launches, ads, website, emails, and brand

decks.

• Develop strong creative briefs for designers, videographers, and external partners.

• Review and refine all brand-facing content to ensure it aligns with brand tone, positioning,

and consumer psychology.

**Campaign Planning & Execution**

• Conceptualise, plan, and execute brand campaigns from ideation to launch, including digital-

first and integrated campaigns.

• Own end-to-end brand marketing for new product launches—from positioning and

messaging to go-to-market strategy.

• Work closely with performance, social, and influencer teams to ensure campaigns are both

creative-led and insight-driven.

**Consumer Behaviour & Data Insights**

• Deeply analyse customer data, feedback, reviews, and behaviour to identify patterns,

emotional triggers, and white spaces.

• Use insights to inform campaign ideas, creatives, messaging angles, and channel strategy.

• Continuously refine brand communication based on learnings and performance.

**Creative Ads & Assets**

• Conceptualise high-performing creative angles for ads based on consumer behaviour and

intent.

• Guide the development of ad creatives, scripts, hooks, and narratives that drive recall and

resonance—not just clicks.

• Collaborate with performance teams to iterate creatives based on data insights.

**Offline Events, Pop-ups & Experiences**

• Plan and execute offline brand experiences including pop-ups, events, brand activations, and

community meet-ups.

• Ensure offline experiences are deeply aligned with brand philosophy and storytelling.

• Own brand presence, communication, and experience design at physical touchpoints.

**Community Building & Brand Collaborations**

• Identify and plug SEREKO into relevant community-building opportunities—wellness,

skincare, mental health, and lifestyle spaces.

• Conceptualise collaborations and partnerships that feel authentic and brand-aligned.

• Help build long-term brand love, recall, and cultural relevance beyond paid media.

**What We’re Looking For**

• 2–3 years of experience in a D2C brand, preferably skincare, beauty, or wellness.

• Strong creative copywriting skills with a deep understanding of tone, emotion, and consumer

psychology.

• Proven experience in campaign planning, product launch marketing, and brand storytelling.

• Strong grasp of consumer behaviour, customer data, and insight-led marketing.

• Ability to think strategically while executing fast in a startup environment.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with performance marketing, design, product, and

founders.

• Someone who understands that brand building is a long game—but knows how to win

attention today.

**Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership on environmental and social risk management across infrastructure, renewable energy, mining, industrial, agribusiness, transport and urban development projects globally.
  
  
You will play a leading role in:
  
  
**Technical Delivery**

* Leading major international Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD), Social Impact Assessment (SIA), Human Rights and Social Risk Assessments.
* Directing the identification, assessment and management of social risks and impacts throughout project development, construction and operation.
* Providing expert advice on complex social issues including:

+ Land acquisition and involuntary resettlement;
+ Livelihood restoration;
+ Stakeholder engagement;
+ Labour and working conditions;
+ Human rights and supply chain risks;
+ Community health, safety and security;
+ Gender equality, social inclusion and vulnerable groups.

* Developing and reviewing:

+ Social Management Plans;
+ Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs);
+ Livelihood Restoration Plans (LRPs);
+ Labour Management Plans;
+ Stakeholder Engagement Plans;
+ Human Rights Assessments and Relevant Management Plans;
+ Gender Action Plans and Equal Opportunities Action Plans.

title: Management Trainee
description:
**Start your career where your work helps 2 crore children learn.**

Sampark Foundation is looking for bright, curious fresh postgraduates who want to build a career while building something that matters. Hired for potential. Trained for impact.

**At a glance**

* **Engagement:**
  Full-time, fixed-term Management Trainee engagement of 11 months, from Monday, 14 December 2026 to Saturday, 13 November 2027
* **Monthly CTC:**
  Rs. 30,000 (inclusive of TDS)
* **Path to a permanent role:**
  High-performing trainees can move into a full-time role at Rs. 40,000 Monthly CTC, decided at the final review
* **Eligibility:**
  Master’s degree in any discipline; no prior full-time work experience required
* **Location:**
  On-site at Sampark Foundation, B-16, Sector 132, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
* **Working days:**
  Monday–Friday, plus the 2nd Saturday of each month, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* **Last date to apply:**
  Monday, 30 November 2026

**Your 11-month journey**

* **Days 1–15:**
  Structured induction and training at Head Office, covering the organisation, the mission, the people and the tools you will use
* **Months 1–9:**
  Hands-on work across core functions on live projects, with structured performance reviews at 3, 6 and 9 months
* **Months 10–11:**
  Specialisation and a capstone project, closing with a final review: the decision point for your full-time offer

Based on your background, interest and competency, you will be trained in one of three streams: Mastering Communication & Partnerships, Mastering Content Creation for Children, or Mastering Data Analytics & Reporting.

This is not a sit-and-watch role. We hire for potential and train for skill. You are not expected to arrive job-ready, but to be curious, learn, take ownership and grow fast.

**What you will do**

* Take on real, live projects across communications, partnerships, programs and data, starting guided and growing more independent
* Draft clear notes, decks, reports and communication for internal and external audiences
* Conduct research and analysis to support decisions, proposals, campaigns and programs
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to move work forward
* Build and maintain trackers, dashboards and reports, and keep data clean and decision-ready
* Use modern digital and AI tools to work faster and smarter, with judgment on quality and accuracy
* Own a capstone project and present it to leadership

**What we are looking for**

* A recently completed Master’s degree in any discipline. Strong academics help, but aptitude, attitude and instinct matter more than marks.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English; working proficiency in Hindi is a plus
* A sharp, analytical mind that breaks problems down and thinks clearly under ambiguity
* Natural curiosity, high learning agility and openness to feedback
* Comfort with digital tools and generative-AI workflows, with judgment on accuracy and originality
* Ownership and initiative to get things done with minimal hand-holding
* Genuine interest in education and social impact
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Noida/NCR, and able to commit to the full 11-month engagement on-site

Academic projects, internships, competitions, campus leadership and volunteering all count in your favour.

**What you will gain**

* 15 days of structured training, then continuous mentorship from senior leaders
* Real ownership of real work from early on, not errands and admin
* Clear quarterly feedback, so you always know how you are doing and how to improve
* A strong path to a permanent role at one of India’s largest education non-profits

**About Sampark Foundation**

Sampark Foundation was founded by Anupama Nayar and Vineet Nayar (Former Vice Chairman and CEO of HCL Technologies). It believes that frugal innovation, combined with relentless execution in partnership with the government, can drive large-scale change in learning outcomes.

Since 2013, our flagship Sampark Smart Shala program has transformed learning in rural government schools. It uses low-cost teaching-learning materials, audio devices with the voice mascot “Sampark Didi” and bot-enabled mobile apps that reach teachers in their classrooms. Working alongside State Education Departments, SCERTs, DIETs and block-level officials, we impact 2 crore children across nearly 2 lakh government schools in 8 states. We also train over 8.5 lakh teachers every year. Our next ambition is to reach 5 crore children across 5 lakh schools.

Visit us: https://samparkfoundation.org/

  https://forms.gle/WSwMYoJ7qesrdHo5A

description:

We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Analyst-Vulnerebility Remediation to join our team in Noida, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients. The engineer will handle complex L2/L3 incidents, contribute to platform improvements, and serve as a reliable technical contributor within NTT DATA's EPM managed services practice supporting clients across US, APAC, and EMEA geographies.

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.

Patch Management

* Generate and present patch compliance dashboards and exception reports to delivery leads and client stakeholders.

Application & Software Management
  
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure & Platform Management
  
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.

* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, patch management, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation

* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices

* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required

title: Growth Marketer
description:
We run two businesses. Goela School of Finance (GSF) teaches people about the stock market. Goela Financial Services (GFS) is our SEBI-registered advisory that guides clients with their investments. We already have a big, warm audience and products people want. What we're missing is one person who owns the system that turns that audience into leads and customers — so it doesn't depend on the founders doing it themselves.

That's this role. You'll work in the Founder's Office. Your job: turn new audiences into GSF learners, and GSF learners into GFS clients — as a clear, repeatable system, not a one-off scramble. You set the plan, and you're the one who makes it happen.

If you've built marketing funnels before and you're ready to fully own one, this is a rare chance to do that — working close to the founders, with an audience and a budget already in place.

**What you'll own:**

* **The lead system**
  across both brands — from a stranger's first click to a real, interested lead.
* **Our existing audience**
  — WhatsApp, email, and message sequences that turn our current list into leads and customers. This is our biggest and fastest win.
* **Paid ads**
  on Meta, Google, and YouTube — running them, reading the numbers, and making them better.
* **Landing pages, free downloads, and sign-up forms**
  — built and improved every week.
* **A simple weekly report**
  of what's working: how many leads, what they cost, and what turned into revenue.

**Your first 90 days might look like:**

* **Weeks 1–3:**
  learn our audience and our numbers, and send your first campaign to our existing list.
* **Weeks 4–8:**
  set up one clean paid-ads channel and one repeatable landing-page flow.
* **Weeks 9–12:**
  get the GSF→GFS journey running as a clear system, with a weekly report the founders can read at a glance.

**You'll do well here if you:**

* Have about 2–4 years running growth or performance marketing — at an agency or inside a company.
* Have real hands-on experience with some of these: email/WhatsApp campaigns, landing pages, free downloads, webinar funnels, and ads on Meta, Google, or YouTube.
* Are comfortable with numbers — you look at what things cost and what they earn, and let that guide your decisions.
* Write clearly and move fast. You'd rather launch something and improve it than plan for months.
* Like ownership. You do your best work when the result is yours to drive, not handed to you.

Finance, edtech, or D2C experience is a bonus, but any real consumer-marketing background works if you can show a funnel you actually ran. We care about your judgment and results more than your degree.

**What's in it for you:**

* A real ownership role next to the founders — your plan, your funnel, your numbers.
* A warm audience and a real budget, so your work builds on itself instead of starting from zero.
* Room to grow into leading a small team as things scale.
* Fast learning across two very different businesses — education and regulated advice — that most marketers never get to see.

**The setup:**

* **Location:**
  Sector 92, Noida. Full-time, in-office, with some flexibility.
* **Pay:**
  a competitive base of
  **₹6–8 LPA**
  based on your experience and results,
  **plus a performance bonus**
  tied to real outcomes — leads, conversions, and revenue.
* Do you have a great track record? We'll stretch the pay for the right person.

**How we'll measure the role**

On what actually matters — how many good leads you bring in, how many convert, and the revenue you help create. We'll review it with you every quarter. Not likes or follower counts.

title: GDS Cyber - AI Driven IAM - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security- Senior AI Engineer – IAM & Cybersecurity**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non-human identity security.
  
  
As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
  
  
The ideal candidate should bring strong hands-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise-scale IAM transformation programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI-driven IAM governance including risk-based authentication, risk-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive-ready recommendations.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.

**Nice to have**

* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About You**

title: Senior VoIP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Alyssum Global Services IT & Consulting

Full-time

Location: Sector 90

Alyssum Global Services is an IT and consulting company focused on delivering technology solutions that help businesses operate and grow. We value practical problem-solving, collaboration, and reliable technology delivery.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior VoIP Infrastructure Engineer to own the full lifecycle of a large, multi-server Asterisk PBX farm: dial plan and AGI development, Linux and container hosting, networking, databases, asynchronous messaging and observability.

You should be equally comfortable debugging SIP and dial plans at a low level and automating cloud infrastructure at scale - and you will work closely with our global VoIP and NOC teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Design advanced Asterisk dialplans, including large machine-generated dialplans, with AGI scripting and dynamic dialplan generation in PHP, Python or Bash (Asterisk, AGI, AMI, chan\_sip/PJSIP).
* Set up and troubleshoot WebRTC and SIP - ICE/STUN/TURN, SIP over TLS and SRTP - and build and support browser-based softphones (SIP.js, JsSIP).
* Keep PBX services stable across Debian, CentOS and Rocky Linux (systemd, package management, performance tuning).
* Manage routing, firewalls and NAT/port forwarding for SIP/RTP traffic (iptables/nftables, NAT traversal for VoIP).
* Deploy and operate LXC and Docker containers, including a Next.js front end from a monorepo (Docker Compose).
* Provision and manage AWS compute, storage and messaging for the PBX/CDR pipeline (EC2, S3, VPC/security groups, IAM, SQS, SNS).
* Administer MySQL, MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL for CDR and application data.
* Build event pipelines for media processing and CDR sharing (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS), and maintain the Python CDR microservices that publish to SQS, link recordings from S3 and notify stakeholders (boto3).
* Run centralized log analysis and alerting (Loki, Grafana).
* Own operations: backup and restore, Git-based change control, Ansible orchestration across the server farm, and master-slave high-availability design for 99.99% uptime.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Proven hands-on production experience with Asterisk PBX at scale - a must.
* Strong understanding of ICE, WebRTC, SIP/TLS and SRTP, with hands-on experience building or maintaining browser-based softphones using SIP.js or JsSIP.
* Significant, demonstrable production experience with AWS: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC/networking, SQS and SNS.
* Significant, demonstrable experience building, deploying and operating LXC and Docker containers in production - not only for local development.
* Strong scripting in Python, TypeScript, PHP and Bash.
* Solid Linux administration across multiple distributions, and working knowledge of networking, firewalls and NAT for VoIP.
* Experience with at least two of MySQL, MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL, and with RabbitMQ or an equivalent message broker.
* Experience with Ansible or comparable configuration management, Git-based version control and disciplined change management.
* Experience designing or maintaining master-slave / high-availability architectures.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.

**Advantage:**
Next.js or modern JavaScript front-end experience; Grafana/Loki or an equivalent observability stack; telecom-adjacent domain experience (contact centre, call recording/compliance).

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)**
**Role Overview**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

  
  

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
  
  
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
  
  
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
  
  
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
  
  
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
  
  
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
  
  
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
  
  
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
  
  
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
  
  
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
  
  
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
  
  
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.
  

  

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

  
  

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

  

  
* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
  
  
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
  
  
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
  
  
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
  
  
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
  
  
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
  
  
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
  
  
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
  
  
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
  
  
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.
  

  

**Skills & Experience**
**Exchange Online & Messaging**

  

  
* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
  
  
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
  
  
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
  
  
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.
  

  

**Email Security**

  

  
* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
  
  
* Experience administering secure email gateway
  
  
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
  
  
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
  
  
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.
  

  

**SMTP & Application Email**

  

  
* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
  
  
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
  
  
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
  
  
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.
  

  

**Identity, Automation & Operations**

  

  
* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
  
  
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.
  
  
* Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates.
  
  
* Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.
  

  

**Communication & Customer Support**

  

  
* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates.
  
  
* Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement.
  
  
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams.
  

  

**Personal Attributes**

  

  
* Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
  
  
* Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made.
  
  
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages.
  
  
* Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape.
  
  
* Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists.
  
  
* Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams.
  
  
* Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer.
  
  
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues.
  
  
* Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team.
  

  

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst.

  
  

They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed.

  
  

Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

  
  

**Desirable Qualifications & Vendor Experience**

  

  
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate, or equivalent experience.
  
  
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Information Protection Administrator Associate (SC-400).
  
  
* Vendor training or certification from Proofpoint, Mimecast, Egress or a similar email security provider.
  
  
* Experience with DMARC reporting platforms.
  
  
* Experience in a large enterprise with many domains, business units or acquired companies.
  
  
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or divestments: domain migration, coexistence and mail routing during transition.
  
  
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. title: Associate
description:
**Associate, Consulting India**

**Chennai/Pune/Gurgaon/Noida**

**Who is ZoomRx?**

ZoomRx is a rapidly growing life science market research and consulting company founded upon the belief that there is important work to be done at the intersection of data, healthcare, and technology. We help some of the world’s biggest biopharmaceutical companies answer questions no one else can. We support our clients through their entire business lifecycle; providing market intelligence that helps them launch new therapies, optimize promotional efforts, defend against competitive pressure, shape marketing strategies, and much more.

At ZoomRx we also have various impactful products (Ferma.AI, PERxCEPT, & HCP-PT). Ferma.AI provides healthcare intelligence to pharma firms of all sizes, making it easy for teams to stay on top of their market landscape and help them make informed decisions. PERxCEPT is a one-stop shop for omnichannel intelligence in the life sciences industry, providing visibility into every digital campaign in a market from the customer’s point of view. HCP-Pt conversations is a point-of-care market insights platform that gives a real-world view of the prescribing process. Brand Builder provides holistic insights programs for new brand launches and post-launch brand optimization.

At ZoomRx, we have a flat organization structure where everyone is encouraged to take risks, learn from mistakes, and continuously grow towards realizing their career goals. We offer a collaborative, environment that optimizes for the:

• pride in doing high-quality work

• joy of tackling creative, intellectually challenging work

• camaraderie of working with smart, grounded peers

**What will you be a part of?**

Consulting India works with drug commercialization teams at top pharma and biotech companies to understand their complex business needs and help them make informed decisions. The team creates strategic narratives for senior management teams of blockbuster drugs by designing and executing custom market research studies, conceiving new data analysis methods, and drawing insights from complex datasets.

**What does your day look like as an Associate?**

• As an Associate, you will be focusing on successful project execution

• You will be responsible for the execution of project activities that cover the project lifecycle from start to completion, including but not limited to:

o Data collection: Pressure-testing data collection tools and methods, ensuring that the data that flows in through these tools are accurate

o Data processing: Monitoring data collected, performing pre-analysis sanity checks to ensure data quality and organizing the data in a way that’s easy to analyze

o Data analysis: Reviewing the data and data cuts in line with the client’s business questions, and modifying existing/creating new views as required

o Client delivery: Develop the client deliverable with inputs from the AC / C (typically in PowerPoint decks) in line with the storyboard finalized by the team. Through building these presentations, Associates are expected to build context on clients, projects and therapeutic areas

• At any given time, you will be expected to work on ~2 average-sized projects that span across different pharmaceutical brands/drugs from the same or different client.

**What will make you successful as an Associate candidate?**

**Required Skills/Expertise:**

• A degree in life-sciences related/or a quantitative discipline (engineering, economics, business, statistics, mathematics)

• 0 to 2 years’ experience in life sciences and/or business analysis

• Demonstrated experience in preparing and delivering analytically robust, data-driven strategic stories

• Advanced level of proficiency in MS Office tools like Excel, PowerPoint, Word

• Good verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to work in teams

**Preferred Skills/Expertise:**

• Experience in additional healthcare market intelligence functions besides primary market research (competitive intelligence; sales analytics; forecasting; etc.)

• Experience in qualitative market research

• Experience in Life Sciences or Healthcare industries

**Why should you choose ZoomRx?**

• You will have wide-reaching creative control and the power to make impactful decisions. At ZoomRx, we favour collaboration over hierarchy.

• You will develop deep expertise in a wide range of topics within life sciences by drawing on existing knowledge bases while building new ones.

• You will work with smart, grounded peers who are experts in their own right and thrive on the camaraderie of working in high-performance, intelligent, impactful teams.

• You will join a vertically integrated organisation - with our own business consulting team, cutting-edge technology platform, and robust panels of healthcare professionals - empowered to provide our clients with highly tailored, fast, effective solutions that other consultancies cannot.

* Month end processing and reconciliations.

Verify that COLA, location and exceptional allowance rates provided by the external vendor have been correctly applied by the external payroll provider and resolve any discrepancies to ensure accurate employee payments.

Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with MSP, Finance and other People Function teams to ensure smooth payroll execution and reporting.
* Collaborate with in-country teams, approvers, and external vendors to resolve payroll issues.
* Maintain proactive communication with the payroll service providers via scheduled monthly/quarterly/annual meetings.
* Partner with our external vendor for payroll/tax advice and compliance for our UK employees on international assignments
* Support cross-functional initiatives for payroll-related data accuracy and process alignment.

Case & Employee Query Management
  
  

* Respond to payroll-related and hr operations related queries from employees via case management systems (C4C).
* Handle and resolve complex employee payroll issues such as tax queries, tax calculation checks etc.
* Strive to understand stakeholder queries and resolve tickets in a customer centric manner.
* Investigate discrepancies, exceptions, and one-off payments, ensuring timely resolution.

Compliance & Audit
  
  

* Ensure compliance with local legislation, global policies, and internal controls.
* Review, and ensure timely submission of statutory reports, accruals, and tax filings.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation, payroll records, and reference files.
* Liaise with third parties, government and statutory bodies as required.

Continuous Improvement & Automation

* Lead process automation, payroll transformation, digitalisation, and system improvements.

* Support review and implementation of SOPs, variance sheets, and knowledge documentation.

* Propose opportunities for process simplification, standardisation, and automation.

* Collaborate with Advisory, Payroll, Reward, and Finance colleagues to ensure a seamless end-to-end employee experience.

Communication & Reporting
  
  

* Communicate payroll deadlines, changes, and issues proactively to stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate with all approvers and key personnel to ensure effective coordination and approvals of payroll payments.
* Prepare and share payroll reports and journals for approvals.
* Escalate risks or delays promptly to management.

* Ensure proper logging and tracking of payroll activities in internal systems.

Collaboration & Teamwork

**Minimum/essential**

regarding direct payment and benefits

title: Manager — Development, Support & Onboarding
description:
**About the Platform**

The Digital Office Platform is a multi-tenant, configuration-driven government case-management platform that lets many independent government bodies each configure their own case lifecycle — data model, intake forms, versioned workflows, roles, SLAs, notifications, audit and reporting — and run real cases end-to-end withoutcustom code per tenant. It is built as ~20 independent Spring Boot microservices (engines), each owning its own PostgreSQL database, coordinated behind a Next.js web application, and deployed hosting-agnostic on sovereign/government cloud using open-source components. Tenant isolation is by tenant\_id; published workflow versions are immutable and live cases pin to their version; security and data boundaries fail closed.

**Role and Responsibilities**

1. Provide technical coordination across development, tenant onboarding / provisioning (the admin-portal onboarding and provisioning flow) and L1 / L2 / L3 support, running them as one integrated service for the platform.
2. Own tenant onboarding and the provisioning lifecycle — from request through configuration (object types, forms, workflows, roles, branding) to go-live — with segregation of duties preserved, so platform-admin provisioning privilege is held and operated separately from development.
3. Own incident management and escalation, problemmanagement and the change-advisory process; monitor and report SLAs across tenants and engines.
4. Coordinate release-to-support handover, maintain runbooksand the knowledge base, and drive continuous service improvement across the ~20 engines.
5. Plan capacity and rostersfor the supporttiers (including the three juniorresources), run the government reporting cadence, and act as the primary coordination point between government bodies, DIC and the engineering team.
6. Track service metrics (uptime,ticket volumes, resolution times, SLA adherence) and drive remediation of recurring issues.

**Qualifications and Experiences**

1. Bachelor's degreein any discipline with 8+ years of experience in IT delivery/ service-delivery management.

**Required Skill Set**

1. Strong ITIL / servicedelivery, incident, problem,change and SLA management, and SDLC coordination.
2. Understanding of microservice platformsand multi-tenant onboarding sufficient to coordinate development, support and provisioning.
3. Strong stakeholder communication, reportingand team management across L1 / L2 / L3 support.
4. Experience managing onboarding / provisioning for multi-tenant or SaaS systemspreferred.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About the Platform**

The Digital Office Platform is a multi-tenant, configuration-driven government case-management platform that lets many independent government bodies each configure their own case lifecycle

* data model, intakeforms, versioned workflows, roles, SLAs, notifications, audit and reporting
* and run real cases end-to-end withoutcustom code per tenant. It is built as ~20 independent Spring Boot microservices (engines), each owning its own PostgreSQL database, coordinated behind a Next.js web application, and deployed hosting-agnostic on sovereign

/ government cloud using open-source components. Tenant isolationis by tenant\_id; published workflow versions are immutable and live cases pin to their version; security and data boundaries fail closed.

**Role and Responsibilities**

1. Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that compile (Maven), test, security-scan (SAST / DAST / dependency scanning) and containerise each of the ~20 engines as a reproducible, multi-stage Docker image, with uniform pipelineshape across the fleet.
2. Automate deployment across environments using Docker / Docker Compose(local and CI) and Kubernetes (production) — declarative manifests, health-managed rollout, auto-scaling, self-healing and zero / low-downtime release strategies.
3. Own release management acrossthe fleet — semantic versioning, environment promotion (dev → staging

→ production), controlled rollback, and mirroringdev schema changesinto Flyway for the production path.

1. Manage secrets and the separated three-keytrust model withinthe pipeline, and the AES-256-GCM secret-encryption key configuration; enforce that engines fail closed when required keys or secrets are absent.
2. Automate environment provisioning (Infrastructure-as-Code) and consistently wire the data and messaging estate — PostgreSQL per engine, Redis and Apache Kafka / Zookeeper — across environments.
3. Build pipeline and runtimeobservability (logs, metrics,traces, alerts) and embed security and quality gates so a critical finding blocks promotion.
4. Partner with the Platform& Security Engineeron production topologyand with AppSec on pipeline security controls and evidence for audit.

**Qualifications and Experiences**

Bachelor's degree in any discipline with 4+ years of experience in DevOps / DevSecOps for microservice-based systems.

**Required Skill Set**

1. Strong hands-on Docker and Kubernetes; CI/CD pipelines (GitLabCI / Jenkins / GitHub Actions) with integrated security scanning, on self-hosted runners and registries.
2. Secrets management, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / Ansible), and release-management discipline (Flyway-based change control, promotion, rollback).
3. Experience operatingApache Kafka and Redis and deploying SpringBoot + Next.js workloads on sovereign/ government cloud.
4. Observability stacks (Prometheus / Grafana / ELK) and build-time securitytooling.
