title: Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
description:
**Job description:**
We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Platform Engineer to build, operate and improve the cloud infrastructure and shared engineering capabilities used by our customer projects and internal teams. AWS is our primary cloud platform.
  
  
The role combines infrastructure and platform engineering, with a stronger emphasis on hands-on infrastructure. You will use infrastructure as code, automation and AI-assisted engineering workflows to deliver secure, reliable and cost-effective environments, troubleshoot operational and deployment issues, and create reusable platform capabilities that help development teams deliver software safely and independently.
  
  
The role suits an engineer who can work independently on well-defined outcomes, communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and is keen to learn unfamiliar services and systems.
  
  
**Objective of the role:**

* Provision, change and maintain AWS infrastructure across development, test and production environments.
* Use Terraform as the primary infrastructure-as-code tool, while supporting AWS CDK-managed services where appropriate.
* Operate common AWS services covering networking, DNS, CDN and web hosting, identity and access, compute, storage, databases, messaging, secrets and monitoring.
* Maintain and improve CI/CD infrastructure, including GitHub Actions, deployment roles, OIDC integrations, secrets and environment configuration.
* Build and improve reusable platform capabilities, including Terraform modules, deployment patterns, guardrails, templates and self-service workflows for engineering teams.
* Investigate infrastructure, networking and deployment problems; identify root causes, implement safe fixes and verify outcomes.
* Apply practical security controls, including least-privilege IAM, secure secret handling, certificates, access controls and resource governance.
* Improve reliability and observability through useful logs, metrics, alerts, operational checks and runbooks.
* Participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota, responding to infrastructure alerts and incidents, carrying out initial diagnosis and remediation, and escalating or handing over when appropriate.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, capacity changes and cost optimisation.
* Create reusable automation and scripts that reduce manual work and make common changes repeatable.
* Use approved AI coding assistants and agents to accelerate investigation, implementation, testing, documentation and pull-request preparation or review.
* Build safe, auditable AI-assisted workflows for repetitive operational work, with scoped access, appropriate human approval and clear evidence supporting any recommendation or change.
* Work directly with internal customers and project teams to clarify requirements, explain trade-offs and deliver pragmatic solutions.
* Keep technical documentation and handover notes accurate enough for another engineer to operate the service.

**Essential Experience & Skills:**

* Practical commercial experience building and operating infrastructure in AWS.
* Strong working knowledge of Terraform in production environments, including modules, state, plans and safe change management.
* Experience creating reusable infrastructure modules, deployment patterns, templates or other shared capabilities for engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Linux, command-line tooling and core networking concepts such as VPCs, subnets, routing, DNS, HTTP and TLS.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and source control; GitHub and GitHub Actions are preferred.
* Ability to automate routine tasks in at least one scripting language, such as Python, Bash, PowerShell or TypeScript.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or engineering agents in day-to-day work, together with the judgement to challenge, test and verify their output rather than accept it uncritically.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, application deployment and network boundaries.
* Willingness and ability to participate in the team's out-of-hours on-call rota.
* Awareness of cloud security fundamentals, especially IAM, secrets and least-privilege access.
* Ability to take ownership of work, prioritise sensibly and make progress with limited day-to-day supervision.
* Clear, customer-focused communication and a collaborative approach to supporting development teams.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new services, tools and project environments.

**Desirable experience:**

* AWS CDK, particularly with TypeScript.
* Containers and Docker.
* Kubernetes or Amazon EKS, including Helm and cluster add-ons; deep platform-engineering expertise is not required.
* CloudFront, Route 53, WAF, API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, ElastiCache/Valkey or Amazon MQ.
* GitHub OIDC integrations and automated AWS deployments.
* Experience creating reusable AI instructions, prompts, skills or agent workflows for engineering and operational tasks.
* Familiarity with tool-connected AI workflows, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, observability or engineering knowledge systems.
* Exposure to AI-assisted operations, such as telemetry investigation, alert enrichment, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automated reporting.
* CloudWatch, New Relic, SigNoz or similar observability platforms.
* AWS cost analysis, rightsizing and practical FinOps improvements.
* Experience supporting multiple customer or product environments.
* Relevant AWS certification, although demonstrable hands-on experience is more important

**What you’ll need to succeed:**
Within the first six months, the successful candidate should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver routine AWS and Terraform changes independently and safely diagnose and resolve common deployment, access, DNS, networking and service issues.
* Support project teams with clear advice and predictable follow-through.
* Improve a shared infrastructure or deployment capability that makes engineering teams more

self-sufficient.
  
  

* Use approved AI tools effectively while retaining ownership of technical decisions, validation and

security;
  
  

* Improve at least one recurring operational process through automation, an AI-assisted workflow

or better documentation; and contribute confidently to production changes, reviews and incident follow-up with appropriate support for higher-risk decisions.
  
  
*At Accedo, we are committed to fostering an environment of inclusiveness where employees are both valued and heard. Inclusion also means having diverse representation in gender, race, sex, thought, and other personal characteristics to contribute towards the betterment of our commerce and people. We strongly encourage applications from diverse communities to contribute towards our commitment of inclusivity.*

**Role Description :**

The Senior Accounts – ARC role is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida, focused on managing ARC-related accounting and reconciliation processes for TL365. This role is responsible for reviewing and reconciling airline ticketing transactions, ensuring accuracy in sales and refunds, and preparing regular ARC reports and settlements. The Senior Accounts professional will monitor financial controls, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate with internal teams to resolve accounting and customer billing issues promptly. Day-to-day tasks include maintaining up-to-date ledgers, supporting audits, optimizing processes for efficiency, and providing clear communication to stakeholders on financial matters.

**Qualifications:**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, and support accurate ARC reconciliation.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal teams, respond to inquiries, and present financial information clearly.
* Candidates should possess solid Finance skills, including understanding of accounting principles, ARC processes, and airline ticketing financial flows.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Account Management skills to handle stakeholder queries, support travel advisors, and maintain high-quality client relationships.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; experience in travel industry accounting or ARC processes is highly beneficial.
* Experience with travel management systems or GDS.

title: Amazon Marketplace Manager

Wishluck

D2C / E-commerce

Marketplace / E-commerce

About Wishluck

Wishluck is a fast-growing D2C brand focused on screen-free educational toys for children aged 0–7 years. Our product range includes sound books, puzzles, musical toys, and creative learning kits. We are expanding our online presence and looking for an experienced Amazon Marketplace professional who can manage and scale our Amazon business.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**Amazon Marketplace Manager**
with 4–5 years of hands-on experience in D2C and e-commerce businesses. The candidate will be responsible for managing Amazon marketplace operations, driving sales growth, improving product visibility, optimizing listings, managing advertising campaigns, and ensuring smooth marketplace operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Manage and grow the company's Amazon Seller Central account.
2. Develop and execute strategies to increase sales, revenue, and profitability.
3. Manage product listings, titles, descriptions, keywords, A+ Content, and images.
4. Handle Amazon PPC campaigns, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
5. Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and other marketplace KPIs.
6. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and market research.
7. Manage inventory planning, stock availability, pricing, and product catalogues.
8. Handle FBA, FBM, order management, returns, refunds, and account health.
9. Identify opportunities for new product launches and category expansion.
10. Coordinate with internal teams for product images, creatives, packaging, and content.
11. Analyse sales reports and prepare regular performance and growth reports.
12. Resolve account-related issues, listing suppressions, and marketplace compliance concerns.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Amazon Marketplace Management.
* Strong experience working with D2C brands and e-commerce businesses.
* Expertise in Amazon Seller Central and marketplace operations.
* Practical experience in Amazon PPC and campaign optimization.
* Strong understanding of SEO, keyword research, and listing optimization.
* Knowledge of FBA, FBM, inventory management, and account health.
* Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach.
* Proficiency in Excel, sales analytics, and marketplace reporting.
* Ability to independently manage and scale marketplace operations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently working with D2C brands will be preferred.
* Must have experience handling end-to-end Amazon marketplace operations.
* Should have a proven track record of scaling sales and improving profitability.
* Candidates with experience in toys, kids' products, FMCG, or consumer brands will have an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing D2C brand.
* Ownership of marketplace growth and business performance.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion.

title: Senior Digital Strategist

* Drive outcome-based consulting conversations aligned to measurable business KPIs and customer value.

+ Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
+ Adobe Target
+ Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
+ Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
+ Adobe Workfront
+ Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

* Influence consulting growth opportunities, renewals, and executive customer relationships.
* Build trusted partnerships with customers, regional stakeholders, sales teams, and leadership organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA strongly preferred.
* 11–12 years of experience in digital strategy, enterprise consulting, transformation programs, or customer experience initiatives.
* Proven expertise across Adobe Experience Cloud and enterprise MarTech ecosystems.
* Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence senior customer stakeholders.

title: Senior Engineer - Structures
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Structural Steel Engineer is responsible for the review of design, analysis, detailing coordination, and execution support of structural steel systems for industrial, commercial, residential, and infrastructure projects. The role involves leading structural engineering activities, ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and delivering technically sound and cost-effective steel structure solutions. The person should be capable in design of Post Tension, Structural Steel design, Steel to steel connections and steel to concrete connection design.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Engineering & Design
  
  

* Lead the review of structural design and analysis of steel structures, including:

+ Industrial buildings
+ Commercial buildings
+ Pipe racks
+ Warehouses
+ Platforms and support structures
+ Towers and miscellaneous steel structures

* Perform review of structural calculations and design reports.
* review of Developed optimized steel solutions considering safety, constructability, and cost.
* Review and approve structural modelling, analysis, and design documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards (IS, AISC, Eurocode, ASCE, etc.).

International Codes & Standards
  
  

* AISC 360 – Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
* AISC 341 – Seismic Provisions for Structural Steel Buildings
* ANSI/AISC 303 – Code of Standard Practice
* ASCE 7 – Minimum Design Loads and Associated Criteria
* AWS D1.1 – Structural Welding Code
* RCSC Specification – Structural Bolting
* Eurocode 0 – Basis of Structural Design
* Eurocode 1 – Actions on Structures
* Eurocode 3 – Design of Steel Structures
* Eurocode 4 – Composite Steel and Concrete Structures
* Eurocode 8 – Seismic Design
* BS 5950 – Structural Use of Steelwork in Building
* IBC – International Building Code

Analysis & Software
  
  

* Carry out advanced structural analysis using software such as:

+ STAAD.Pro
+ ETABS
+ SAP2000
+ Tekla Structural Designer
+ RAM Structural System

* Conduct:

+ Static analysis
+ Dynamic analysis
+ Seismic analysis
+ Wind load analysis
+ Connection design

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Coordination & Review
  
  

* Coordinate with architects, civil, MEP, and construction teams.
* Review steel detailing and fabrication drawings.
* Resolve design and site-related engineering issues.
* Participate in design review meetings and client discussions.

Construction Support
  
  

* Provide technical support during fabrication and erection activities.
* Review RFIs, shop drawing comments, and site queries.
* Conduct site visits and inspections when required.
* Assist in troubleshooting structural issues during construction.

Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure engineering deliverables meet quality standards and project requirements.
* Support design audits and third-party reviews.
* Maintain compliance with project specifications, safety requirements, and company procedures.

Leadership
  
  

* Mentor and guide junior engineers and designers.
* Review work performed by team members.
* Support resource planning and project scheduling.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (mandatory)
* Master's Degree in Structural Engineering (preferred)

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in structural steel design and engineering.
* Experience in building, industrial, power, oil & gas, or infrastructure projects preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Structural steel design and analysis
* Connection design
* Steel detailing review
* Knowledge of IS 800, IS 875, IS 1893, AISC, Eurocodes, and related standards
* Structural optimization and value engineering

Software Skills
  
  

* ETABS
* SAFE
* SAP2000
* STAAD.Pro
* Tekla Structures
* AutoCAD
* Revit (preferred)
* MS Excel

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Leadership and team management
* Technical report writing
* Client communication and stakeholder management
* Project planning and execution
* Attention to detail and quality focus

**Preferred Certifications**

* Chartered Engineer (preferred) IStructE, ICE, IEI, ASCE, or SEI
* Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent (preferred)
* Relevant structural design certifications

KPIs
  
  

* Timely completion of design deliverables
* Design accuracy and quality
* Reduction in steel tonnage through optimization
* Compliance with codes and standards
* Client satisfaction and project success

title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an
**Agentic Business Process Analyst**
to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
  
  
The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.
  
  
This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

Join a Financial Crime Technology team delivering enterprise solutions for global financial services clients. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability across NICE Actimize, Java, advanced SQL, and cloud platforms, supported by practical Financial Crime Compliance domain knowledge. The successful candidate will contribute to solution design, development, integration, deployment, optimization, and production support while guiding junior engineers and working directly with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with proven experience implementing or supporting NICE Actimize solutions and building Java-based services and integrations. The role involves working with customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud use cases. Cloud and domain experience are mandatory. AI skills are an added advantage for accelerating engineering, analytics, documentation, testing, and investigation-support use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, develop, enhance, and support NICE Actimize solutions and related Financial Crime applications.
* Build and maintain Java applications, microservices, REST APIs, batch components, and integration services.
* Develop complex and optimized SQL for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, alerting, investigation, and reporting use cases.
* Integrate Actimize with upstream and downstream systems, including customer, account, transaction, case-management, screening, and reporting platforms.
* Deploy and support applications and data workloads on Azure, AWS, or GCP using appropriate cloud-native services.
* Translate compliance requirements into technical designs, rules, scenarios, data mappings, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform performance tuning, defect analysis, root-cause analysis, code reviews, unit testing, release support, and production troubleshooting.
* Ensure secure coding, auditability, data protection, logging, monitoring, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, solution architects, data engineers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and take ownership of assigned modules and delivery outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Actimize: Strong hands-on experience with NICE Actimize implementation, configuration, customization, integration, enhancement, or production support. Experience should relate to Financial Crime solutions such as Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions screening, fraud, alerting, or case management.
* Java: Strong hands-on development experience with Core Java, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, multithreading fundamentals, Spring Boot, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, stored procedures, query optimization, reconciliation, and high-volume data analysis.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience must include developing, deploying, integrating, monitoring, or supporting applications and data workloads in a cloud environment.
* Financial Crime domain: Mandatory delivery experience in one or more of KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud, with working knowledge of alerts, cases, investigations, rules or scenarios, regulatory controls, and financial crime data.
* Engineering practices: Git, Maven or Gradle, unit testing, code review, debugging, secure development, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production support.

**Actimize and Financial Crime knowledge**

* Actimize platform: Practical understanding of Actimize solution components, data flows, interfaces, alert generation, case workflows, rule or scenario changes, deployment, and operational support.
* Transaction Monitoring / AML: Scenario logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, false-positive analysis, investigations, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**AI Skills – Added Advantage**

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent for code generation, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with appropriate human review and secure-use practices.
* Understanding of generative AI and large language model concepts, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and API-based integration.
* Exposure to Python-based AI or machine-learning workflows, model evaluation, or analytics for anomaly detection, alert prioritization, investigation support, or false-positive reduction.
* Ability to identify responsible AI use cases while considering explainability, data privacy, security, model risk, auditability, and regulatory expectations.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, or enterprise messaging and event-driven architecture.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with data platforms or processing tools such as Spark, Databricks, or cloud-native data services.
* Familiarity with observability tools, application performance monitoring, and structured production-support processes.
* Strong communication, estimation, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery skills.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 4+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, financial crime technology, Actimize delivery, application development, or production engineering.
* Eligibility: Candidates with less than 4 years of relevant professional experience will not be considered.
* Mandatory combination: Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience are all required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliable Actimize enhancements and integrations delivered with production-quality Java and SQL.
* Clear understanding of the compliance objective, data lineage, operational controls, and regulatory context behind each solution.
* Ownership of design, development, testing, deployment, incident resolution, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Practical use of cloud and AI capabilities without compromising security, explainability, auditability, or maintainability.

**What Working At EY Offers**

* You will work on meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, coaching, collaboration, technical ownership, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to deepen expertise across Actimize, modern Java engineering, cloud delivery, and responsible AI-enabled solutions.
* Apply only if you meet the 4+ years requirement and all mandatory skill and domain criteria.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Brand Outreach Manager
description:
**Company description**
-
  
A Noida-based Talent Management, Influencer marketing and PR agency specializing in influencer collaborations, digital PR, and talent management. The company works with brands and creators to build impactful campaigns, enhance brand visibility, and drive meaningful digital engagement.
  
**EXPERIENCE - 3-7 Years

We are looking for an experienced Brand Outreach & Partnerships Manager who can help us build a consistent pipeline of brand partnerships and outbound business opportunities. title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Company Description**
RWA Noida is a resident welfare association focused on improving the quality of life and community services for residents in Noida. The organization works to ensure well-managed facilities, transparent communication, and effective coordination between residents and local authorities. RWA Noida emphasizes responsible governance, safety, and maintenance of shared spaces. The association values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement in community management. Team members contribute to a supportive environment that prioritizes resident needs and orderly operations.

This is a full-time, on-site Assistant Manager role based in Noida. The Assistant Manager will support day-to-day administration of the RWA office, including handling resident queries, coordinating maintenance activities, and assisting in the implementation of community policies and procedures. Responsibilities include maintaining records, preparing reports, and supporting budgeting and billing processes. The role involves coordinating with vendors, service providers, and local authorities to ensure timely resolution of issues. * Candidates should possess strong administrative and organizational skills, including record management, scheduling, and basic documentation.

* Candidates should possess problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities to address resident concerns and operational issues constructively.

title: Sr. Engineer ||
description:
**Job Description Summary**
To administer the Online Gaming platform and monitor and report as part of a “shift-based operations” team on a 24x7 basis, ensuring optimum performance and availability of such platform, provide second-level troubleshooting support, and liaise with all applicable service providers and third parties. Achieve the goals established internally and follow SLAs and OLAs concerning service delivery to our customers (both external and internal).
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  

* 4-6 years’ experience in a technical support / operational role
* All-round, with broad scope technology knowledge, both windows and Linux.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of gathering and delivering information to both technical and non-technical collaborators.
* A working knowledge of monitoring tools, both event management and metrics. For example – Grafana, Datadog.
* Good problem-solving method and approach
* Evidence of accountability and ownership when managing incidents.
* Ability to analyse logs and solve issues.
* Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
* Docker/Kubernetes experience
* Cloud Platform experience – Google GK, Amazon EKS
* Experience with code repositories GitHub/GitLab
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with relational and non-relational databases. For example MSSQL/MongoDB
* Experience with DNS/HTTPS certificates.
* Experience with orchestration tools Ansible and Ansible Tower.
* Experience with event workflow ticketing systems, for example Freshdesk / Jira

**Responsibilities**

* Produce high-quality artwork that meets project briefs, exploring creative concepts and offering multiple executions.
* 24x7 proactive monitoring and support of the live and staging infrastructure
* Investigate and react to any live issues that occur.
* Prepare and implement periodic releases for both infrastructure and software.
* Act as a point of contact for a partner concern raised through customer channels.
* Partake in the design and improvement of processes and activities related to the role.
* Handle service requests, incident problems and change requests in line with ITIL v4 standard methodology.

Members of our NOC team are standout colleagues. They are passionate about technology and their jobs. They have a proactive and flexible attitude. They can handle daily tasks and projects while constantly learning new skills.
  
  
Sound fault-finding skills and an ability to react to problematic situations in a focused manner are essential in this role. It is essential that the person applying for this position is comfortable with shift work – The NOC offers 24x7 coverage.
  
  
*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

391368

We are currently seeking a Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist\_OKTA\_IGA to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description: OKTA IGA (Identity Governance & Administration) Support Engineer / Administrator
  
  
Position Summary -
  
  
We are seeking an experienced OKTA Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) Support Engineer to provide L4/L3 managed services support for the enterprise OKTA IGA platform. The role involves supporting user lifecycle management, troubleshooting provisioning issues, handling incidents and service requests, supporting access certifications, and ensuring the stability, security, and compliance of the IGA environment.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities -
  
  
Identity Lifecycle Management -
  
  

* Manage and support Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes using OKTA Identity Governance.
* Troubleshoot and resolve user provisioning and deprovisioning issues across integrated applications and systems.
* Monitor and maintain identity synchronization, connectors, workflows, and business rules.
* Ensure timely onboarding, role changes, and offboarding of users in accordance with organizational policies.

Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Provide L4/L3 operational support for the OKTA IGA platform.
* Handle incidents, service requests, change requests, and problem management activities.
* Perform detailed analysis and troubleshooting for identity-related issues.
* Support break-fix activities and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and document findings and corrective actions.

Access Governance & Compliance -
  
  

* Enable and support quarterly and half-yearly access certification campaigns using OKTA IGA.
* Support audit activities by providing access reports, evidence, and remediation actions.
* Ensure compliance with internal security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in remediation of audit findings related to identity governance and access management.

Platform Administration & Maintenance -
  
  

* Maintain existing applications, policies, workflows, and integrations within the OKTA ecosystem.
* Perform regular platform health checks and proactive monitoring.
* Generate and distribute operational, compliance, and governance reports.
* Recommend platform improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
* Support system upgrades, configuration changes, and platform enhancements.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management -
  
  

* Coordinate with OKTA and other vendors for product-related issues, defects, and escalations.
* Work closely with application owners, security teams, HR, and infrastructure teams to resolve identity management issues.
* Provide operational documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Technical Skills -
  
  

* Strong experience with OKTA Identity Governance (IGA) and OKTA Workforce Identity Cloud.
* Experience in User Lifecycle Management (JML processes).
* Knowledge of provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
* Experience with access certification and access review campaigns.
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts including:
* RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
* SSO (Single Sign-On)
* MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication)
* User Provisioning
* Access Governance
* Experience with directory services such as:
* Active Directory (AD)
* Azure AD / Entra ID
* LDAP
* Familiarity with REST APIs, SCIM connectors, and application integrations.
* Experience in incident, problem, and change management processes.

Soft Skills -
  
  

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent documentation and communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* OKTA Certified Professional / Administrator certification preferred.
* Experience supporting enterprise IAM/IGA environments.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and service management frameworks.

title: Content Producer
description:
Job Title: Content Producer

Department: Marketing

Location: Onsite -Noida, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Open Positions: 1

Reporting To: Co-Founder / Marketing Lead

Working Days: 6 days a week

Experience Required: Minimum 2 years of experience in content creation, video production, or a related field.

Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Media, Communications, Filmmaking, or a related field (preferred).

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, independent, and storytelling-driven Content Producer to create engaging video content for SayaCare across Meta, Google, and other digital platforms.

You will be responsible for taking video ideas from concept to execution. This includes researching topics, developing creative concepts, writing scripts, shooting or creating videos, editing, publishing, and analysing their performance.

You should be someone who can independently turn an idea into an engaging video, experiment with different storytelling styles, and make complex healthcare topics simple and interesting for audiences.

The role requires a combination of creativity, storytelling, video production, editing, and an understanding of audience behaviour.

**Our Content Production Process:**

Research → Concept → Script → Shoot/Create → Edit → Publish → Analyse → Repeat

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Research & Concept Development

* Research topics, audience interests, trends, and everyday experiences to identify interesting content ideas.
* Understand healthcare and pharmaceutical topics shared by the research team and convert them into engaging content concepts.
* Develop original video ideas based on human behaviour, culture, healthcare, and audience insights.
* Find creative ways to communicate medicine and healthcare-related topics.
* Simplify complex or technical information into relatable stories.

2. Scripting & Storytelling

* Write scripts for short-form and long-form videos.
* Develop engaging openings, hooks, narratives, and storytelling formats.
* Use humour, emotions, real-life situations, and relatable experiences to make content interesting.
* Identify the most suitable storytelling approach and video format for each concept.

3. Video Production

* Independently shoot and produce videos using cameras, mobile phones, or other suitable equipment.
* Create different types of content, including live-action videos, animations, motion graphics, illustrated stories, and mixed-media videos.
* Handle basic production requirements such as framing, lighting, sound, and composition.
* Use available resources creatively to bring ideas to life.

4. Video Editing & Post-Production

* Edit videos using suitable video editing software.
* Add music, sound effects, transitions, graphics, subtitles, and animations wherever required.
* Maintain video quality, pacing, composition, and visual consistency.
* Prepare videos for distribution across different digital platforms.

5. Publishing & Performance Analysis

* Understand video performance across Meta, Google, and organic digital channels.
* Track metrics such as views, engagement, watch time, and audience retention.
* Identify which topics, hooks, formats, and storytelling approaches perform best.
* Use performance insights and feedback to improve future content.

**Skills & Responsibilities**

* Strong understanding of storytelling, scripting, and video production.
* Ability to independently develop concepts and produce videos from start to finish.
* Working knowledge of editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.
* Understanding of shooting techniques, lighting, framing, sound, and composition.
* Knowledge of animation, motion graphics, or other visual storytelling techniques is an advantage.
* Strong creative thinking and an eye for interesting everyday observations.
* Understanding of audience psychology, emotions, and attention.
* Ability to experiment with different content formats and storytelling styles.
* Basic understanding of content analytics and video performance metrics.
* Ability to learn new topics quickly, particularly in medicine and healthcare.
* Strong ownership, time management, and execution skills.

**Success metrics & KPI's**

* Content Quality: Creativity, relevance, storytelling, and overall production quality.
* Content Output: Number of quality videos produced within defined timelines.
* Audience Retention: Ability to hold audience attention and improve video watch time.
* Content Performance: Views, engagement, reach, and other relevant performance metrics.
* Creative Experimentation: Testing new concepts, hooks, formats, and storytelling approaches.
* Continuous Improvement: Using performance data and feedback to improve future videos.

**What we're looking for**

We are looking for someone who is creative, curious, independent, and passionate about visual storytelling.

You should be someone who:

* Enjoys observing everyday life and turning interesting observations into creative content.
* Can independently take an idea from concept to final video.
* Understands that good content is not just about editing but also about the idea and story behind it.
* Has a strong visual sense and understands what captures an audience's attention.
* Takes ownership of work without requiring constant instructions.
* Is comfortable experimenting, learning from results, and improving continuously.
* Can work across research, scripting, shooting, editing, and performance analysis.

**About the company**

SayaCare is a fast-growing e-health company committed to making healthcare simple, affordable, and accessible across India. We combine technology, healthcare, and customer understanding to build products and services that make it easier for people to take care of their health.

At SayaCare, we value ownership, curiosity, teamwork, and continuous learning.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
To administer the Online Gaming platform and monitor and report as part of a “shift-based operations” team on a 24x7 basis, ensuring optimum performance and availability of such platform, provide second-level troubleshooting support, and liaise with all applicable service providers and third parties. Achieve the goals established internally and follow SLAs and OLAs concerning service delivery to our customers (both external and internal).
  
  
Job Requirements

* 4-6 years’ experience in a technical support / operational role
* All-round, with broad scope technology knowledge, both windows and Linux.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of gathering and delivering information to both technical and non-technical collaborators.
* A working knowledge of monitoring tools, both event management and metrics. For example – Grafana, Datadog.

* Evidence of accountability and ownership when managing incidents.
* Ability to analyse logs and solve issues.
* Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with relational and non-relational databases. For example MSSQL/MongoDB

title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

Daily security operations and control testing

* Perform and document routine security checks across endpoints, servers, cloud/on-premises environments, network devices, applications and security tools according to approved runbooks.
* Review security alerts,
  **SIEM**
  logs, endpoint detection and response (
  **EDR**
  ), anti-malware status, privileged activity, suspicious authentication events and other indicators; triage and escalate anomalies.
* Monitor vulnerability findings, patch status, insecure configurations, exposed services, certificate expiry, backup/security job exceptions and remediation progress.
* Review user access requests, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver controls, periodic access recertification and segregation-of-duties exceptions with system owners.
* Support incident handling, evidence preservation, initial impact assessment, incident documentation, lessons learned and tracking of corrective actions.

Security assessments and technical controls

* Coordinate vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (
  **VAPT**
  ), configuration reviews, application/API security testing, cloud security reviews and remediation validation.
* Support secure configuration baselines, hardening, encryption, key/certificate management, network segmentation, MFA, endpoint security, data-loss prevention and secure remote access.
* Review changes and new technology deployments for security risks; participate in change-management, architecture and release reviews as assigned.
* Support backup restoration tests, disaster recovery and business continuity exercises, and verify that security requirements are incorporated into recovery plans.
* Work with IT, DevOps, cloud, application, infrastructure and third-party teams to resolve security findings within agreed risk-based timelines.

**RBI / CERT-In compliance and audit support**

* Maintain a compliance tracker mapping applicable
  **RBI directions**
  ,
  **CERT**
  -In directions, internal policies and contractual requirements to controls, owners, evidence and remediation status.
* Support evidence collection for internal audits, external audits, regulatory inspections, risk assessments and control attestations.
* Help maintain incident registers, security logs, asset inventories, risk registers, exceptions, VAPT reports, remediation records and security awareness records.
* Support incident reporting and record-preservation processes in line with applicable CERT-In directions and the organization's incident response procedures.
* Assist with third-party risk assessments, security questionnaires, due diligence, periodic reviews and tracking of vendor remediation commitments.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

Must-have

* 3–8 years of relevant
  **information security, cyber security,**
  security operations, IT risk or security compliance experience; fintech,
  **NBFC**
  , banking or payments experience is strongly preferred.
* Active
  **CISSP certification**
  (candidate should provide certification status and validity details).
* Sound understanding of security fundamentals: identity and access management, network security, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, secure configuration, encryption, logging/monitoring, incident response and data protection.
* Practical familiarity with SIEM, EDR/antivirus, vulnerability scanners, ticketing/GRC tools, cloud security consoles and common infrastructure/application security controls.
* Working knowledge of RBI IT/cyber security requirements applicable to the employer’s regulated category and CERT-In incident reporting/log-retention directions.
* Good written and verbal communication; able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and produce clear evidence-based reports.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS/Azure/GCP**
  security, API security, DevSecOps, container security, DLP, PAM, IAM or security automation.
* Experience supporting
  **ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS**
  or other relevant security assurance frameworks.
* Relevant degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related discipline and certification in Information security.

**Success Measures (Illustrative)**

* Completion and quality of scheduled security checks and evidence.
* Timely triage and escalation of security events; remediation of vulnerabilities within approved timelines.
* Reduction in overdue high-risk findings and repeat control failures.
* Audit readiness, accurate compliance mapping and effective coordination with technology/control owners.

Algoworks

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Technical Production Support Engineer**
to provide technical leadership and oversee
**Tier 2/3 production support**
for a cloud-based SaaS platform serving the construction industry.

The role involves serving as the primary technical escalation point for complex production issues, leading incident investigations, driving root cause analysis, and ensuring timely resolution of critical application and infrastructure problems.

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Customer Support, DevOps, and Product teams to maintain platform stability, improve support processes, and reduce recurring production issues. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep troubleshooting expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to guide and mentor other engineers.

**Key responsibilities:**

**1.Technical Production Support**

* Serve as the technical lead and primary escalation point for complex Tier 2/3 production incidents across applications, APIs, databases, and Azure infrastructure.
* Lead end-to-end incident investigation, troubleshooting, resolution, and technical escalation for high-priority production issues.
* Take ownership of critical incidents, ensuring timely diagnosis, stakeholder communication, and resolution within agreed service levels.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications across Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, .NET Core, C#, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, MongoDB, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure.
* Guide and mentor support engineers in troubleshooting techniques, incident management, and technical problem-solving.
* Provide technical direction during complex investigations and coordinate cross-functional efforts to restore service.

**2.Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead technical investigations into recurring, high-impact, and business-critical production incidents.
* Perform detailed root cause analysis (RCA), identify underlying technical issues, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Analyze application logs, telemetry, API responses, database performance, and infrastructure metrics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and related diagnostic tools.
* Investigate data inconsistencies, application errors, performance degradation, authentication failures, and integration issues.
* Write and optimize SQL and MongoDB queries to diagnose data-related incidents and performance bottlenecks.
* Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to implement permanent fixes and reduce repeat incidents.
* Identify incident trends and recommend improvements to application reliability and operational stability.

**3.Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Establish and improve production support processes, troubleshooting standards, escalation procedures, and incident response practices.
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support procedures.
* Monitor production health, identify potential risks, and proactively address emerging issues.
* Support production deployments, release validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
* Track and improve operational performance, including incident response times, resolution times, recurring incidents, and support effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks and improve operational efficiency.

**4.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication**

* Act as the technical liaison between Production Support, Engineering, DevOps, Customer Support, and Product teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering to prioritize production defects, validate resolutions, and track fixes through completion.
* Communicate incident status, technical findings, business impact, and resolution plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication during production incidents, including escalations, updates, and handoffs.
* Collaborate with distributed teams across the US and India, ensuring consistent coverage, availability, and knowledge transfer.
* Demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, and ownership of production support commitments.

**Required technical skills and competencies:**

* 8+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, or Software Engineering within enterprise or SaaS environments.
* 2+ years of experience in a technical lead, senior escalation, or incident management capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting and debugging C#/.NET Core applications, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Strong working knowledge of Angular-based web applications and frontend-to-backend troubleshooting.
* Advanced SQL troubleshooting skills, including complex queries, joins, execution plans, and performance investigation.
* Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including query troubleshooting, data investigation, and indexing concepts.
* Strong production support experience with Microsoft Azure, including application hosting, monitoring, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Experience using Azure Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and log analysis tools to investigate production incidents.
* Demonstrated ability to lead root cause investigations and drive permanent resolutions for recurring production issues.
* Experience with incident management, escalation procedures, and SLA-driven support environments.
* Strong understanding of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multiple application and infrastructure layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong leadership, ownership, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive incident resolution with minimal supervision.

**Must have skills:**

* 8+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, or Software Engineering.
* 2+ years of technical leadership, senior escalation, or incident management experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET Core application troubleshooting.
* Experience troubleshooting REST APIs and microservices.
* Working knowledge of Angular-based applications and frontend-to-backend issues.
* Advanced SQL troubleshooting, query optimization, and database performance investigation.
* Hands-on MongoDB experience, including queries, data investigation, and indexing concepts.
* Production support experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and log analysis.
* Strong root cause analysis and incident management capabilities.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment processes.
* Excellent communication, ownership, and cross-functional coordination skills.

**Good to have skills:**

* Experience supporting large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Next.js, TypeScript, Material-UI, and responsive web applications.
* Experience troubleshooting authentication and authorization using OAuth, JWT, Azure AD B2C, NextAuth.js, or MSAL-Angular.

title: Transmission Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
About the opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Transmission Engineer to join our team. This role requires a strong background in Transmission Assurance, hands-on troubleshooting, and support of telecommunications networks. You will be responsible for managing and ensuring the optimal performance of both SDH and DWDM networks, applying expertise in the field, and delivering exceptional customer service.
  
  
What You Will Do:
  
  

* Transmission Assurance: Provide operational support and assurance for Transmission networks, including SDH (Level 1, 2, or 3) and DWDM networks.
* SDH Network Support: Operate and support SDH networks, preferably those manufactured by Marconi, Ericsson, or GPT.
* DWDM Network Support: Operate and support DWDM networks, preferably from Ciena, Marconi, or Ericsson.
* Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Apply triage and troubleshoot telecommunications network incidents related to transmission infrastructure, ensuring swift resolution of issues.
* Optic Fibre Infrastructure Management: Manage and optimize the optic fibre infrastructure, ensuring its availability and reliability.
* Jeopardy Management: Understand and implement jeopardy management principles to proactively identify and resolve potential network disruptions.
* ITIL & Change Management: Familiarize with ITIL methodologies and Change Management fundamentals, ensuring smooth and efficient processes.
* Team Collaboration: Work effectively within a team, supporting business and customer needs while maintaining a high level of professionalism.
* Trouble Ticket & Change Request Handling: Handle trouble tickets and change requests per SLA/WLA, ensuring timely response and resolution.
* Customer Service Requests (CSR): Analyze, troubleshoot, and provide corrective maintenance for complex faults and customer service requests.
* Emergency & On-Call Support: Handle emergencies and provide on-call support (24/7), ensuring that issues are resolved quickly and effectively.
* Solution Management: Manage customized business object templates/reports and coordinate with cross-functional teams (GSDC, PDU, PLM).
* Coordination with External Suppliers: Collaborate with external suppliers for 3rd Party (3PP) hardware support, ensuring timely resolution of hardware-related issues.

What You Will Bring:
  
  

* Experience: Minimum 3 to 8 years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years spent working in the Ericsson transmission domain.
* Technical Expertise: Solid knowledge and understanding of transmission infrastructure, including SDH and DWDM networks. Experience with optic fibre infrastructure management is highly desirable.
* Support Process Knowledge: Good understanding of support processes and best practices, with a customer-oriented approach.
* Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to contribute to improvements and changes actively.
* Team Player: Ability to work effectively as part of a team and contribute to meeting business and customer objectives under time constraints.

**Why join Ericsson?**
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Startup Ecosystem Partnership Manager
description:
**Purpose of the Role:**

This role will be part of the Strategy Office and be the primary owner of the organization's startup ecosystem engagement — building and nurturing relationships with startups, accelerators, and technology innovators. This role is expected to maintain a wide and early lens on the ecosystem — tracking emerging deep-tech players, building relationships proactively, and develop partner business opportunities. The incumbent will also own the strategic partnership charter with portfolio/investee companies, ensuring synergy goals are defined, tracked, and delivered.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build, own, and continuously expand a mapped view of the deep-tech startup ecosystem relevant to the organization's strategic priorities.
* Proactively engage with startups, founders, accelerators, incubators, and technology communities ahead of formal investment conversations, ensuring the organization has early visibility and strong relationships.
* Own and drive strategic partnerships with existing investor/investee companies, defining clear synergy goals and tracking their realization.
* Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards and scorecards on ecosystem engagement, partnership pipeline, and synergy/value realization.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

* Background in the technology industry either in product development or product management; MBA from a reputed institute is preferred but a strong technology grounding is non-negotiable with 10+ years of experience
* Genuine understanding of and curiosity for the broader technology landscape — able to evaluate deep-tech startups on their technical merit and strategic relevance.
* Prior experience in startup ecosystem engagement, technology scouting, corporate venture capital, innovation/incubation programs, or strategic partnerships is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build and sustain a personal network within the startup and investor community.
* Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting to and working alongside CXOs and senior leadership.

**Interpersonal competencies
:**

* Strong technology acumen combined with business and commercial judgment
* Entrepreneurial mindset with genuine curiosity about emerging technology and startups
* Excellent networking and relationship-building skills within the startup/investor ecosystem
* Ability to operate independently and proactively in an ambiguous, fast-evolving space
* Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills across internal and external audiences
* Excellent verbal, written, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to engage confidently with CXO-level stakeholders and founders alike
* Strong ownership and execution mindset

title: Principal Consultant - Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly capable Individual to provide commercial leadership and delivery oversight for the UK&I Transport & Infrastructure PMO GCC team.
  
  
The role is responsible for managing commercial, contract, and cost management activities across a portfolio of projects, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and data-driven delivery aligned to UK standards.
  
  
This is a strategic, delivery-oriented role requiring expertise in
**commercial management, quantity surveying, contract administration, cost planning, change control, and PMO integration**
, alongside strong leadership capability to develop teams, drive process improvements, and expand GCC workshare.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Commercial Leadership & Team Management
* Lead the GCC Commercial team supporting UK&I T&I projects.
* Drive resource planning, workload allocation, and delivery governance.
* Build and mentor a high-performing team through structured development and coaching.
* Collaborate with PMO Leads, UK Commercial teams, and Project Managers.
* Support recruitment aligned with pipeline and strategic growth.
* Contract Administration & Commercial Management
* Lead contract administration across projects in line with NEC/JCT (and FIDIC where applicable).
* Manage:

+ Change control (pricing, tracking, forecasting)
+ Compensation events, variations, and claims
+ Contractual communications and notices

* Govern and maintain contract registers (EWN, CE, GC, etc.).
* Track contractual deadlines and ensure proactive compliance.
* Draft formal contractual correspondence and entitlement notifications.
* Cost, Risk & Commercial Performance
* Support cost control and financial performance across project lifecycle.
* Manage commercial risks, opportunities, and entitlement claims.
* Support dispute resolution, withheld cost recovery, and claims management.
* Maintain and drive commercial risk registers and escalation processes.
* Contribute to financial forecasting, working capital recovery, and performance insights.
* PMO Integration & Delivery Coordination
* Integrate commercial activities with project controls, planning, and PMO processes.
* Ensure alignment of cost, schedule, and change impacts.
* Coordinate reporting dashboards, commercial trackers, and registers.
* Support cross-functional teams in resolving commercial and delivery challenges.
* Governance, Quality & Compliance
* Establish QA/QC frameworks, checklists, and peer review mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, commercial, and internal governance standards.
* Standardise templates, SOPs, and delivery processes.
* Align with RICS/ APM professional standards and best practices.
* Digital Reporting
* Encourage data-driven reporting using advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivots) and Power BI dashboards.
* Enhance visibility through automated dashboards and digital reporting solutions.
* Business Improvement & Capability Building
* Drive continuous improvement in commercial processes and delivery models.
* Support bid development, mobilisation planning, and workshare growth.
* Develop structured training programmes covering: NEC/JCT contracts, Change & risk management
* Mentor and build next-generation commercial professionals.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as key commercial interface between GCC and UK stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients, PMs, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Support capability showcases and promote GCC value proposition.

**Qualifications**
**Experience & Qualifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of Contract Management / Commercial experience, including :5 years UK project exposure.
* Proven experience in UK–India delivery models and interfacing with UK stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of:

+ NEC, JCT contracts
+ Change order management

* Experience in:

+ Change control, CVRs, forecasting, procurement, and contract management
+ Leading multi-project teams and delivery governance

* Strong commercial acumen and consultancy understanding.

**Tools & Technology**

* Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)
* Power BI (dashboarding and reporting)
* Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word)

**Desirable**

* Professional membership and Professional Qualification (e.g., RICS, APM)
* Experience in Rail, Roads, Civils, Water or Infrastructure projects
* Exposure to ERP systems and structured cost databases

title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role description:**
As an Electrical Graduate Engineer, you will work closely with experienced engineers in a supportive learning environment. We will continue to develop your existing skills to apply electrical engineering principles in real projects, use industry-standard tools, and contribute to high-quality design deliverables.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**
Under the supervision of experienced engineers, your role will include, but not be limited to:
  
  

* Apply technical engineering techniques for design of general lighting, emergency lighting, power distribution, and basic low-voltage systems such as fire detection, CCTV, and security systems.
* Prepare engineering calculations, sketches, schematic designs, 3D models, and working drawings for different project phases.
* Build on existing proficiency in Revit and other electrical design and calculation software.
* Prepare technical reports and presentations.
* Follow company standards, procedures, and design quality-check processes.
* Manage assigned tasks within agreed timelines and budget while working in a structured project environment.
* Apply safety-in-design principles ensuring system accessibility, maintainability, coordination, and buildability are integrated into your design decisions.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Mandatory**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, building services, or a related field.
* Knowledge and understanding of electrical systems for buildings.
* Knowledge of norms and standards related to electrical engineering for buildings.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, AutoCAD.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools, systems, technical skills and ways of working.
* Demonstrates good planning, organization skills, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and analytical thinking.
* Interested in long-term professional growth within an engineering consultancy environment and actively continue to develop personally and technically through regular CPD training.

**Nice to have**

* Master's degree in electrical engineering.
* Knowledge of specialized electrical software such as Dialux, Relux, AGI32, Amtech, ETAP, EPLAN, Generator Selection and Lightning Protection software.
* Ability to show out-of-box thinking to identify opportunities for automation, digital tools and innovative engineering solutions.

**Key attributes**

* Professional attitude toward time, tasks, and deadlines.
* Capable of working within a multi-national team.
* Proactive in asking questions, seeking feedback and having a supportive attitude.

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people.
