title: SAP BTP BPA
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP BPA Automation Consultant to design, develop, and implement intelligent automation solutions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP Build Process Automation (BPA). The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to automate business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support digital transformation initiatives across SAP and non-SAP landscapes

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Design and build automation workflows using SAP BTP Build Process Automation.

• Re-implement automations from other platforms (e.g., UiPath) into SAP BPA.

• Integrate SAP Document Information Extraction (DI) and AI Core for intelligent document processing.

• Develop alerting workflows for compliance and risk monitoring.

• Create dashboards, apps, and workflows using SAP Build Apps and Work Zone.

• Collaborate with business analysts, sustainability teams, and developers to gather requirements and deliver solutions.

• Conduct thorough testing (unit, integration) and ensure quality of automation solutions.

• Document technical specifications, process flows, and best practices.

• Provide ongoing support and enhancements for deployed automation solutions.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

• 3–8 years of experience in SAP BTP and BPA (Build Process Automation).

• Strong knowledge of SAP iRPA / RPA tools and automation frameworks.

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or Node.js.

• Experience with APIs, OData, REST, SOAP, GUI scripting, and BAPI.

• Hands-on experience with SAP AI Core, Document Information Extraction, and sentiment analysis.

• Familiarity with ESG metrics and automation for compliance reporting (preferred).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• SAP BTP or BPA certification.

• Experience in cloud-native development and DevOps practices.

• Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) and event-driven architecture

Highway’ team in Mumbai/Noida/Bengaluru to work alongside our UK discipline.

title: Performance creative strategist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Performance Creative Strategist**
who understands the intersection of fashion, consumer psychology, storytelling, and performance marketing.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop high-performing creative concepts for Meta Ads and other paid digital channels, using data, consumer insights, and creative experimentation to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth.

This is not a media-buying role or a traditional graphic design position. We need someone who can identify
**what makes customers stop scrolling, engage, and ultimately purchase**
, and translate those insights into compelling creative briefs.

You will work closely with our Founder, Creative Team, Content Creators, and Performance Marketing Team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Creative Strategy & Concept Development**

* Develop performance-driven concepts for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), including static ads, carousels, video ads, Reels, and UGC-style content.
* Create compelling hooks, headlines, visual directions, messaging angles, and storytelling frameworks.
* Translate product USPs, customer motivations, and fashion trends into creative concepts that convert.
* Develop creative strategies for product launches, seasonal collections, promotional campaigns, and evergreen bestsellers.
* Balance luxury brand positioning with direct-response marketing principles.

**2. Performance Analysis & Creative Testing**

* Analyze advertising performance using metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and hook/hold rates.
* Identify winning creative patterns, messaging angles, and visual formats.
* Develop structured A/B testing plans for hooks, copy, formats, product positioning, and creative concepts.
* Study creative fatigue and continuously introduce new concepts and iterations.
* Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign performance and scaling opportunities.

**3. Creative Briefing & Production**

* Write detailed, actionable briefs for graphic designers, video editors, photographers, and content creators.
* Provide references, storyboards, shot lists, copy directions, and clear creative objectives.
* Guide the production of performance-focused product videos, lifestyle content, UGC, and editorial-inspired advertisements.
* Ensure creative output is consistent with Perte D’ego's visual identity and premium positioning.
* Manage a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and iterations.

**4. Consumer Research & Competitor Intelligence**

* Research the US fashion consumer, purchasing motivations, objections, and emerging trends.
* Analyze competitors and leading global D2C fashion brands using Meta Ad Library and other creative intelligence tools.
* Study customer reviews, comments, and feedback to identify new messaging opportunities.
* Identify emerging creative formats and advertising trends before they become saturated.

**5. Creative Performance Reporting**

* Maintain a structured creative testing tracker.
* Present weekly insights on winning ads, underperforming concepts, and new opportunities.
* Build a library of proven hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
* Recommend creative priorities based on performance data and business objectives.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in performance creative strategy, preferably with a D2C fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or premium consumer brand.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads and performance marketing fundamentals.
* Proven ability to develop advertising concepts backed by performance data.
* Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and consumer psychology skills.
* Strong visual taste and understanding of fashion aesthetics.
* Ability to interpret creative performance data and turn insights into actionable briefs.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Library, Ads Manager, Motion, Foreplay, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of US consumer behavior and digital advertising trends.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**What we are looking for:**

Someone who:

* Thinks like a marketer but has the eye of a creative director.
* Understands why one advertisement generates sales while another gets ignored.
* Can turn a single product into 10 different compelling advertising angles.
* Is equally comfortable analyzing ROAS and discussing visual composition.
* Understands that premium fashion advertising must build desire, not just push discounts.
* Is proactive, experimental, and constantly looking for the next winning creative concept.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Volume and quality of new creative concepts developed and tested.
* Percentage of new creative tests that outperform established benchmarks.
* Improvement in creative-driven acquisition efficiency.
* Speed of creative iteration and testing.
* Development of scalable winning creative concepts.
* Consistency and effectiveness of creative production briefs.

title: Systems Administration Analyst-App Packaging
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Analyst-App Packaging to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Advanced Application Packaging
  
  

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

Compatibility & Remediation
  
  

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
* Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.

Deployment Integration & Automation
  
  

* Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
* Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
* Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
* Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
* Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.

Quality & Governance
  
  

* Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
* Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

**Required Skills**

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.
  
  
**About NTT DATA**

We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. title: Associate Product Engineer
description:
You take a piece of work all the way: understand the customer's problem, find the root cause, build the fix, prove it works, ship it, and confirm it is fixed in production. This is not a ticket-in, pull-request-out job. The engineer who does this well here investigates before coding, tests their own work on QA, records a short Loom walkthrough so product can accept without a meeting, and stays with the change through staging and deploy until the customer's issue is closed. That is the bar.
  
  
**What End To End Means Here**
01 Understand the problem.
  
  
Read the support escalation, reproduce it on QA, and trace the root cause in code and in production data. Say clearly whether it is a product defect, a data gap, or working as designed, and bring the evidence.
  
  
02 Build the fix.
  
  
In Java (Spring Boot) or Ruby on Rails, with tests. A React change when the fix needs one.
  
  
03 Get it reviewed.
  
  
Open the pull request, answer review comments, keep CI green.
  
  
04 Test it yourself on QA.
  
  
The golden path plus the edge cases from the ticket. Screenshots and the resulting database state go on the ticket.
  
  
05 Record a Loom for acceptance.
  
  
Before and after, in under five minutes. Product accepts from the recording.
  
  
06 Ship it and close the loop.
  
  
Take the change through staging to production, watch the deploy, verify it in production, and update the original support ticket.
  
  
**What You Will Work On**
Customer escalations and product features across accounts payable and bill pay, month-end close, AI transaction categorization, financial reporting and ledger migration. Some weeks it is a two-line fix with a long investigation behind it. Some weeks it is a new feature from a product spec to a working screen.
  
  
BACKEND: Ruby on Rails
  
  

* Java 17 / Spring Boot

FRONT END: React
  
  

* TypeScript

DATA: PostgreSQL
  
  

* MongoDB
* Redis
* RabbitMQ

DELIVERY: Bitbucket
  
  

* CircleCI
* Jenkins
* Kubernetes

AI TOOLING: Claude Code, daily
  
  
TRACKING: Jira
  
  

* Loom
* Slack

**Requirements**

* 0 to 3 years of software engineering, or an exceptional new graduate with shipped projects
* Java and Ruby on Rails. Strong in at least one, with clear evidence you can pick up the other quickly. You will work in both
* SQL you can use to prove a point. You can read production data to confirm or reject a theory before you write code
* Root cause before fix. You are uncomfortable patching a symptom
* You write clearly. Tickets, pull request descriptions, Loom narration. People should be able to follow your work without a call
* Genuine appetite for AI tooling. You have already used Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar seriously, and you want to get much better at it
* Intent and ownership. You want to be the person a delivery depends on, and you show up when it does

**NICE TO HAVE**
React and TypeScript in a production codebase.
  
  
Kubernetes, CI pipelines, or a deploy you have babysat yourself.
  
  
Basic accounting literacy: chart of accounts, journal entries, bank reconciliation.
  
  
Experience on a product team that talks to customers directly.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Full time opportunity with a competitive compensation package
* Great growth potential at a fast-growing startup, we want you to grow with us!
* Company provided laptop and necessary hardware to ensure you are set up for success
* Inclusive and motivating work culture that values team collaboration

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The HCL Now Solution Architect defines and architects customer solutions across the HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud portfolio, guiding engagements end-to-end from initial opportunity through go-live and into steady-state operation. The role combines deep cloud-native architecture expertise with hands-on delivery ownership: understanding stakeholder requirements, designing scalable and secure solutions, maintaining architectural standards, controlling cloud cost and risk, and resolving issues throughout the customer lifecycle. Solution Architects typically support multiple concurrent engagements across the HCL Software product portfolio — including HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL CDP, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL iControl, Mosaic, Mosaic Vibe Studio, and others.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Assess customer IT landscapes and design end-to-end cloud-native architectures meeting business, security, and scalability requirements.
* Define migration roadmaps and architecture blueprints; drive solution standardization and templatization for reuse.
* Architect data and analytics components (pipelines, storage, reporting) to meet customer data-driven requirements.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support Sales in scoping HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud opportunities and lead technical discovery with customers.
* Deliver Product Cloud Workshops and act as the customer's trusted technical contact from opportunity through go-live.

**Delivery, Onboarding & Automation**

* Guide deployments on HCL SoFy; templatize onboarding procedures and drive automation with DevOps/CloudOps.
* Apply AI-driven DevOps practices to automate delivery pipelines, monitoring, and operations.
* Mentor delivery engineers and provide technical oversight to keep implementations aligned to architectural intent.

**Cost, Performance & Risk Management**

* Own cost modeling and FinOps-driven cloud cost optimization; monitor sizing and resolve bottlenecks.
* Support performance, scaling, and DR testing; identify and mitigate architecture risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Feed recurring QC issues and customer learnings back to Product and DevOps teams.
* Stay current on cloud-native trends and HCLSoftware roadmaps; build reusable reference architectures for the practice.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record designing and delivering complex customer solutions in public and hybrid cloud architectures, ideally in a customer-facing or professional-services context.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying workloads on at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), with Architect-level (or equivalent) certification strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes and containerization (Docker), including implementation, setup, infrastructure, networking, and security on cloud.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, DB2, Oracle, or Aerospike.
* Solid, practical understanding of modern networking and interconnection options, security architecture, and global compliance and security standards.
* Deep understanding of design and integration patterns, and of solution standardization and templatization.
* Solid understanding of core AI concepts (ML fundamentals, generative AI, LLMs) and their application to cloud solutions.
* Proven implementation experience with HCLSoftware products — e.g., HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL CDP, HCL iControl, or HCL MyXalytics — or a comparable enterprise software portfolio, including migrating, upgrading, and onboarding these products.
* Understanding of data migration strategy and the ability to work with product teams on execution.
* Business and technically savvy, with big-picture vision and the ability to articulate the solution vision to both internal and external audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and analytical/problem-solving skills, with a keen, continuous-learner mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience with architecture design tools such as Visio, Draw.io, or Lucidchart.
* Prior experience with cloud migration factories, migration tooling, or "as-a-service" delivery models.
* Experience in a presales or solution-consulting capacity, including proposal and estimation support.
* Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability/monitoring tooling.

**Travel**

Approximately 15% travel required (+/-).

Company: BetterHerbs (Lickerish Foods Pvt. Ltd.)

Location: Noida Sec-58

BetterHerbs is a fast-growing D2C health & wellness brand focused on science-backed and Ayurveda-inspired nutrition for mothers, women and children. Our portfolio includes products across pregnancy nutrition, lactation, child nutrition, infant wellness and women’s hormonal wellness.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly creative, research-driven individual who understands what makes people stop scrolling, pay attention and take action.

You'll be responsible for developing high-converting ad concepts, hooks and scripts for our D2C wellness brands across Meta and other digital platforms.

- Develop performance-driven ad scripts for doctors, founders, influencers, B-rolls, AI videos and static ads.

- Excellent Hindi/Hinglish and English scripting skills.

- Someone who can combine creativity, analytical thinking and commercial awareness.

**Consumer Psychology + Research + Creativity + Performance Mindset.**

description:
**Job Title: Senior UX Researcher**

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women's health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

What This Role Is You will be the first dedicated UX Researcher at XpertDox. You will own research across two products: the BI Platform (used daily by client leadership to track coding performance, review CDI feedback, and manage audit trails) and the company website (xpertdox.com, where prospects evaluate and request demos). You will work directly with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You will be expected to move from research to wireframe to recommendation within days, not weeks.

**What You Will Do**

* Own and run NPS and CSAT programs across the client base. Analyze the results by client segment, user role, and product area. Turn findings into prioritized product recommendations.
* Conduct usability testing and discovery interviews with healthcare decision-makers: CFOs, Revenue Cycle Directors, Practice Administrators, and Billing Managers. These are not tech-savvy power users. They need information presented clearly with minimal clicks.
* Analyze behavioral data (session recordings, heatmaps, feature adoption funnels) on the BI Platform to identify where users drop off, which features go unused, and where workflow friction exists. Tools in use or planned: Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity.
* Shadow sales calls with prospects during pre-MSA and post-MSA stages to capture unfiltered buyer needs, objections, and feature expectations. Translate these into research briefs for Product.
* Audit the xpertdox.com visitor journey. Identify conversion bottlenecks in the demo request flow. Test and validate messaging, page structure, and lead capture design. Measure impact on demo request volume and lead quality.
* Work on Conversion Rate Optimization and conduct A/B tests
* Translate research findings into low-to-mid fidelity wireframes in Figma. Improve user flows on the BI Platform and website. Validate prototypes with users before engineering builds.
* Define success metrics for every product release. Track changes in engagement, retention, NPS, and CSAT after launch. Recommend iterations based on data.
* Identify client learning gaps. Recommend training content needs: onboarding sequences, feature walkthroughs, and quick-reference materials for billing staff and practice administrators.

**Requirements**

* 5 to 10 years of UX Research experience, primarily in B2B SaaS products. Must have worked on a business intelligence, analytics, or dashboard-heavy platform.
* Experience running NPS and CSAT programs from design through analysis to action. Not just collecting scores, but using them to drive product changes.
* Experience working with e-commerce or D2C platforms
* Experience in conducting A/B tests for multiple platforms
* Strong qualitative research skills: usability testing, discovery interviews, contextual inquiry. Experience interviewing non-technical business users (finance, operations, clinical administration).
* Working knowledge of behavioral analytics: funnel analysis, retention cohorts, heatmaps, and session recordings. Familiarity with tools like Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalents.
* Hands-on wireframing in Figma. Ability to translate research into user flows and interaction improvements without waiting for a separate design team.
* Experience collaborating with Customer Success teams to reduce churn, increase platform adoption, and improve satisfaction scores.
* Experience working with Marketing on website conversion optimization: A/B testing, landing page design, lead capture flows.
* Comfort operating in a startup with approximately 60 people, limited resources, and fast iteration cycles.
* Clear communicator who can present findings to both technical teams and non-technical healthcare executives.

**Tools**

* Research and Testing: UserTesting, Maze, Lookback, Typeform, Qualtrics Customer Sentiment: Delighted, SurveyMonkey, in-product NPS and CSAT tools Product Analytics: Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity Wireframing: Figma, Miro Data and Reporting: Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI Collaboration: Jira, Notion, Slack

To Apply

Apply at
https://careers.xpertdox.com/

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Change Management Consultant
description:
Manager / Senior Manager | Growth Office | NOIDA, Delhi NCR (2-3 days work from office)

ROLE MANDATE:

Improve front-end effectiveness by driving and sustaining changes in sales processes, behaviors, skills and ways of working, increasingly enabled by AI. This is a business-transformation role with strong organizational change management capability, not a communications-and-training coordination role. The Senior Manager will diagnose what needs to change, shape practical adoption strategies, activate stakeholders, and assess whether changes in process, technology and capability are producing the intended business outcomes.

**Description**

Primary outcomes

1. Front-end transformation and effectiveness

Translate business priorities and AI-enabled opportunities into clear implications for sales roles, workflows, handoffs, behaviors and skills. Diagnose whether gaps arise from process, capability, technology, data, leadership reinforcement or adoption.

2. Process-change impact

Establish current-state baselines, define the intended future state and track whether redesigned processes are improving quality, speed, consistency and user experience. Separate activity measures from evidence of behavioral and operational change.

3. AI tool and workflow adoption

Drive role- and persona-based adoption for platforms used by the sales organization, including Salesforce, Agentforce, SALESpad and the Market Intelligence Platform. Focus on integration into daily workflows, not stand-alone awareness campaigns.

4. Stakeholder ownership and reinforcement

Build sponsor alignment, manager reinforcement, change networks and clear ownership across Sales Leadership, Growth Office, Sales Operations, Capability Development, Technology, Data & AI and solution teams.

5. Scalable change practice

Create reusable diagnostic, impact-assessment, communication, readiness, adoption and measurement approaches that can be applied across multiple Growth Office initiatives.

The person who will succeed

* Business-outcome led: starts with the effectiveness problem, not the change-management deliverables.
* AI-first but human-centered: anticipates how AI changes work while addressing trust, confidence, role clarity and cognitive friction.
* Diagnostic and evidence-oriented: distinguishes symptoms from root causes and tests whether the intervention worked.
* Influential without authority: creates shared ownership in a matrix and constructively challenges one-size-fits-all requests.
* Hands-on and strategic: can shape an enterprise approach and personally facilitate discovery, design a plan, analyze results and brief leaders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: brings structure to evolving tools, processes and stakeholder expectations without waiting for perfect information.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery with sellers, sales leaders and enabling functions to understand pain points, workflow friction, stakeholder needs and readiness for change.
* Map current and future-state journeys, roles, decision points and handoffs across priority front-end processes.
* Conduct stakeholder, change-impact, readiness and resistance assessments; convert findings into a segmented change plan.
* Design persona-based adoption journeys for senior leaders, middle management, sellers, account teams and sales-support teams.
* Partner with process and technology owners to make the new behavior easier within the workflow, rather than relying only on communications or training.
* Create sponsor and manager activation plans, champion networks, listening mechanisms and reinforcement cadences.
* Define leading and lagging measures across awareness, readiness, usage, behavior, process performance and business outcomes.
* Use qualitative feedback, platform data, Salesforce data and process measures to identify friction and adapt the intervention.
* Produce concise, leadership-ready narratives on adoption, risks, decisions required and evidence of impact.
* Work as part of a pod with Sales Transformation & Enablement and Client/Market Intelligence colleagues, while maintaining clear ownership for change and adoption.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of relevant experience, with substantial ownership of enterprise change, workforce transformation, digital adoption, process transformation or human-capital advisory programs.
* Demonstrated work with commercial, sales, account-management or other front-office populations in a complex global organization.
* Experience translating technology or AI implementation into role, process, behavior and operating-model change.
* Hands-on use of change-impact, stakeholder, readiness, resistance, adoption and benefit-realization methods. PROSCI/ADKAR, Kotter, design thinking, Lean or process-improvement credentials are useful but are not substitutes for evidence.
* Comfort using CRM, platform-usage, workflow and employee-listening data to diagnose adoption and assess impact. Salesforce exposure is strongly preferred.
* Working understanding of Data, Analytics, Generative AI and Agentic AI in enterprise settings.
* Excellent facilitation, executive communication, structured problem solving and program management capability.

title: Fashion, PR & Brand Development
description:

**NamiNaya is building a new kind of fashion brand — combining a luxury online women's fashion store**
with AI-powered modeling, virtual try-ons, digital campaigns, and next-generation fashion storytelling.

We're bringing together fashion, technology, creativity, and commerce to create a distinctive shopping and brand experience.

We're looking for a
**creative, confident, fashion-forward personality**
who wants to help build NamiNaya from the ground up.

This isn't just a modeling job. It isn't just a content creation job. And it certainly isn't a traditional desk job.

One day you could be presenting a new fashion collection, the next organizing a fashion event, collaborating with designers, filming a branded short, discovering the next big fashion trend, or brainstorming a launch campaign.

**We're looking for someone who can become a recognizable face, voice, and creative force behind NamiNaya.**

**Freshers with genuine creativity and on-camera experience are welcome.**

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

• Be part of NamiNaya's founding team and help build an emerging luxury fashion brand

• Help shape the identity, style, personality, and public voice of our women's fashion store

• Get involved in fashion collections, product launches, styling, and trend research

• Help conceptualize and organize fashion events, pop-ups, launches, and creative shoots

• Feature in fashion reels, product showcases, campaigns, and branded videos

• Work with emerging AI fashion, virtual modeling, and creative technologies

• Explore opportunities across presenting, acting, modeling, hosting, and brand storytelling

• Collaborate with designers, fashion creators, influencers, photographers, and marketing teams

• Work closely with leadership and contribute ideas that influence the direction of the brand

• Build a strong public portfolio across fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce, events, and digital media

• Opportunity to grow into
**Content Lead, Brand Lead, Head of Fashion & Content, or Creative Director**

**No two weeks will look the same — you'll be helping build the brand, not just creating content for it.**

WHAT YOU'LL DO

**Fashion, Styling & E-Commerce**

**• Help develop the creative identity and visual presentation of NamiNaya's luxury online women's fashion store**

**• Research emerging fashion trends, styles, collections, and consumer preferences**

**• Contribute ideas for new clothing collections, seasonal edits, styling concepts, and product launches**

**• Help coordinate fashion shoots, lookbooks, product showcases, and styling presentations**

**• Collaborate with designers, fashion professionals, models, and creative partners**

**• Help present and promote products through engaging visual storytelling and shopping content**

**Content Creation & On-Camera Presence**

**• Be an on-camera presenter and content creator for NamiNaya**

**• Create and host Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, fashion videos, styling guides, and product showcases**

**• Model or present selected fashion collections and brand campaigns**

**• Act in branded short films, lifestyle stories, and promotional videos**

**• Host interviews, podcasts, designer conversations, and behind-the-scenes content**

**• Develop creative scripts, hooks, storylines, and original campaign concepts**

**Events, Collaborations & Brand Building**

**• Help plan and organize fashion events, brand launches, pop-ups, and promotional activities**

**• Coordinate with fashion influencers, models, designers, creators, and event partners**

**• Participate in photoshoots, promotional events, fashion exhibitions, and brand activations**

**• Identify collaboration opportunities with emerging fashion and lifestyle creators**

**• Bring fresh ideas for growing NamiNaya's visibility and building a loyal fashion community**

**Marketing & Creative Strategy**

**• Collaborate with marketing on social media growth, content calendars, brand positioning, and campaigns**

**• Identify emerging fashion, lifestyle, and social media trends**

**• Help develop launch campaigns for new fashion collections and products**

**• Experiment with AI-generated fashion content, virtual try-ons, and emerging creative technologies**

**• Analyze content performance and help improve engagement, reach, and brand awareness**

**• Occasionally collaborate on creative projects across our wider portfolio of emerging brands**

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong on-camera presence — expressive, natural, articulate, and confident

• Clear, fluent spoken English; Hindi communication skills are a plus

• Genuine interest in women's fashion, luxury brands, styling, and emerging trends

• Good fashion sense and an understanding of what makes a collection or outfit appealing

• Comfortable with presenting, acting, hosting, and fashion-related content

• Creative thinker who enjoys developing original ideas rather than simply following instructions

• Interested in fashion events, brand launches, influencer collaborations, and creative campaigns

• Understands Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and what makes content engaging

• Curious about AI, digital fashion, and emerging technologies

• Organized enough to help coordinate shoots, campaigns, events, and creative activities

• Comfortable working with designers, models, influencers, and creative professionals

• Willing to travel occasionally for fashion shoots, events, and brand activities

• Reliable, enthusiastic, collaborative, and excited by a fast-moving startup environment

**You don't need to be an established influencer or have thousands of followers.**

**We care more about your personality, fashion sense, communication skills, creativity, initiative, and long-term potential.**

FRESHERS WELCOME

Your experience could come from:

• Fashion modeling, commercial shoots, or styling

• Fashion design, fashion communication, or fashion merchandising

• Acting, theatre, or short films

• Instagram Reels, YouTube, or lifestyle content creation

• College fashion shows, cultural events, or event management

• Fashion blogging, styling, or visual merchandising

• Hosting, presenting, or self-produced creative videos

**If you love fashion, enjoy being on camera, and want to help build a brand rather than simply work for one, we'd love to hear from you.**

HOW TO APPLY

We'd also love to see:

• A short self-introduction video

• Examples of your on-camera work, if available

• A fashion brand, trend, or collection you personally admire — and why

**Come help build the fashion, face, voice, and creative identity of NamiNaya.**

description:

**About This Opportunity**
We are now looking for an Alarm Monitoring Engineer to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through proactive alarm monitoring and incident management.
  
  
You will play a key role in identifying network faults, performing first-level analysis, and collaborating with technical and field teams to drive timely fault resolution. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericsson’s vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.

* Identify, analyze, and prioritize network faults using Ericsson and multi-vendor NMS/EMS tools.

title: Dynamics 365 Advanced Warehouse (WMS) Consultant
description:
Dynamics 365 Advanced Warehouse (WMS) Consultant — Senior / Confident Level

**Client:**
UK‑based dairy & chilled food manufacturer/distributor

**Location:**
India — hybrid, with on‑site presence at production/distribution sites ·

**Engagement:**
Full-time Contractor (not working anywhere)/ Permanent ·

**Experience:**
6–12 years, incl. 3+ full‑cycle D365 SCM WMS implementations

About the Role

You will own the Advanced Warehouse Management workstream in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: designing the warehouse model, configuring it, proving it on the floor with mobile devices, and standing it up through go‑live and hypercare. This is a hands‑on senior role — you design it and you build it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Warehouse design & configuration**

* Lead the Advanced Warehouse Management (AWM/WMS) workstream end‑to‑end in D365 SCM — design authority through to hands‑on configuration.
* Configure the core WMS engine: wave templates and wave processing, work templates and work classes, location directives, work pools and work exceptions.
* Build and optimise mobile device menus, menu items, field priorities and device flows for warehouse and yard operatives.
* Configure load templates, load building strategies, shipment workflows, and outbound sortation/consolidation logic.

**End‑to‑end warehouse processes**

* Inbound: ASN/receiving, quality hold on receipt, put‑away strategies and cross‑docking for fast‑moving chilled lines.
* Outbound: picking (cluster, batch, wave), packing, staging, marshalling by dispatch bay and route, and shipping confirmation.
* Replenishment: min/max, demand‑based and wave‑based strategies tuned for high‑throughput pick faces.
* Counting and quality: cycle counting by threshold/spot, inventory adjustments, quality orders and non‑conformance handling.

Sector‑Specific Requirements (Dairy / Chilled)

* Full
  **batch traceability**
  — forward and backward — supporting mock recalls and BRCGS / food safety audit requirements.
* **Temperature‑controlled zoning**
  : chilled, ambient and frozen locations with compliant put‑away and pick logic.
* **Short shelf life**
  : FEFO enforcement, minimum‑shelf‑life‑on‑despatch rules by customer, and residual shelf‑life alerts.
* **Returnable assets**
  : crates, dollies, roll cages and pallet pooling (e.g. CHEP/IFCO) tracking.
* **Allergen and segregation**
  controls across storage and picking.
* **Route‑based dispatch**
  to retail RDCs and multi‑drop rounds, including retailer‑specific labelling (GS1‑128/SSCC) and EDI‑driven despatch.

What You'll Bring

* Deep, demonstrable D365 SCM Advanced Warehousing expertise — not "SCM generalist with some WMS exposure."
* 3+ full lifecycle implementations covering design, configuration, testing, cutover and hypercare.
* Working knowledge of adjacent modules: Inventory Management, Master Planning, Production Control (process/lean), Transportation Management.
* Practical experience with warehouse mobile hardware — RF guns, wearables, voice picking, label/print integration and scale interfaces.
* Comfort with data: warehouse configuration migration, DMF/data entities, and diagnosing wave/work performance issues.
* Confident client‑facing communication — able to hold a design position with a warehouse manager at 5am and a programme board at 2pm.

A cybersecurity engineer is responsible for protecting computer systems and networks from cyber threats, such as hacking, viruses, and other malicious attacks. title: Principal Data Architect
description:
**Principal Data Architect**

**Pay**
: ₹70 to ₹100 lakh per year

**Location**
: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

**Type**
: Full-time

**Hours**
: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST

**Entity**
: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)

**Department**
: Data Analytics

**On-site or remote:**
On-site, Monday through Friday

**Reports to**
: Chief Operating Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

Position Summary

You will be the final decision maker on the company’s data architecture, reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer. Your first job is to lead the move from a batch-oriented, file-based environment to a cloud lakehouse on AWS. The data comes from many healthcare clients, each with its own structure, and all of it is protected health information. It has to support both automated medical coding and natural-language questions from users across the company. You will start hands-on, with no direct reports: you design the architecture, build the critical parts yourself, and set the standards. Within 12 months, you will hire and lead the company’s data engineering team, based in India, which runs the platform you built. This role is not for someone who has moved fully into people management and no longer builds, and it is not for someone who has designed a lakehouse but never carried a production migration through to completion.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own final decisions on data architecture: storage, table design, tooling, and how data moves between systems.
* Own the design and execution of the lakehouse migration, from source ingestion through the query and reporting layer.
* Design schema, partitioning, and table layout that hold up across many client datasets with varying structure.
* Build and harden ETL pipelines, including upsert and merge logic, scheduling, failure handling, and monitoring.
* Own data governance, access control, retention, and quality standards for protected health information (PHI).
* Set and enforce engineering standards for the data platform: code review, testing, deployment, documentation, and cost management.
* Own the data layer for the self-serve analytics platform, so it supports natural-language querying and reporting.
* Define and own the handoff between the analytics team’s existing batch outputs and the lakehouse.
* Hire and build the company’s data engineering team, based in India, within your first 12 months, and set the hiring bar for every data engineer who joins.

Required Qualifications

* Led at least one production migration from legacy or file-based systems to a data lake or lakehouse, carried through to completion.
* Currently or recently in a senior data leadership role (principal, lead, head, or director) at a product company operating at scale, with direct experience hiring and leading data engineers, while still personally designing and building.
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS data services, including S3 and serverless query and ETL tools.
* 10+ years in data engineering or data platform roles, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions.
* Experience making architecture decisions with incomplete information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, and columnar formats such as Parquet.
* Strong Python and SQL skills; PySpark experience strongly preferred.
* Experience designing for multi-tenant or multi-client data where schemas vary across sources.
* Experience with data governance and security in a regulated environment, such as healthcare or financial services.

**Location and Schedule**

This is an on-site role at our Noida office, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST. These hours overlap with our Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters. The role is not remote or hybrid. Candidates who live outside the Noida area must relocate before their start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. The role works with protected health information; all staff complete HIPAA training and follow XpertDox data security policies.

**Compensation**

* Base salary of ₹70 to ₹100 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
* Incentive stock options.
* Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts.

**Benefits**

* Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy.
* Company cab service for all Noida employees.

**To Apply**

https://careers.xpertdox.com/

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Executive – IMS & Quality
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
We are seeking applications for the position of Executive-IMS & Quality for Noida location.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Support Our ISO 37001 & ISO 9001 Management Systems
* Help maintain and update the policies, procedures, SOPs and records required under both ISO 37001 and ISO 9001.
* Track quality and compliance KPIs, objectives and targets across operational teams, and prepare the data for management review meetings.
* Coordinate integrated internal audits across business units, maintain logs of non-conformities and observations, and follow up until corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) are closed.
* Help prepare the organisation for external ISO surveillance and recertification audits for both standards.
* Embed Ethics and Compliance in Daily Operations
* Work closely with project delivery, procurement and proposal teams to build compliance and quality checks into day-to-day project work.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for colleagues on routine ethics questions, conflict-of-interest declarations, and gift and hospitality disclosures.
* Carry out integrity due diligence on third parties such as vendors, sub-consultants, joint-venture partners and associates.
* Perform vendor due diligence before vendor onboarding
* Assess Risk and Report to Leadership
* Help assess compliance, bribery/corruption and quality risks at each stage of the project life cycle, and maintain the risk register.
* Prepare clear dashboards, status reports and presentations for the Compliance & Quality Committee and Senior Leadership.
* Keep audit evidence, policy archives and compliance records organised and audit-ready at all times.
* Build Awareness and Drive Continuous Improvement
* Help organise awareness sessions on anti-bribery, business ethics and quality management procedures.
* Deliver compliance and quality induction briefings for new joiners and maintain training records.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and digitise compliance processes, and suggest practical improvements.
* Travel to site and regional offices to conduct audits, training sessions and management review meetings (up to 20% of your time).

Profile/Skills
  
  
**Education**

* MBA, B. Tech, bachelor’s degree with experience in quality, management systems, Anti-Corruption, Risk management or related field

**Experience**

title: Technical Analyst
description:
**Life on the Team**

We are seeking a hands-on PKI Engineer to operate and improve enterprise Certificate Authority services and manage the complete lifecycle of internal and publicly trusted digital certificates.

This role covers Microsoft AD CS administration, public TLS certificate management, certificate lifecycle automation, and troubleshooting of certificate chains and trust issues. The engineer will collaborate with Cybersecurity, Active Directory, Cloud Engineering, application teams, and support partners to maintain secure, reliable certificate services across production and non-production environments

**What You’ll Do**

**PKI and Certificate Authority Operations**

* Administer Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including offline root CAs and enterprise issuing CAs.
* Maintain CA configurations, certificate templates, enrollment permissions, and auto-enrollment policies.
* Maintain and monitor Certificate Revocation List (CRL) and Authority Information Access (AIA) publication services; support OCSP where implemented.
* Support secure key storage, and documented key ceremonies under approved dual-control procedures.
* Perform CA maintenance, patching, backup validation, and disaster recovery exercises through established change-management processes.

**Public TLS and Certificate Lifecycle Management**

* Manage internal and publicly trusted certificates throughout discovery, request validation, issuance, deployment, monitoring, renewal, replacement, revocation, and retirement.
* Manage public TLS certificates through providers such as DigiCert and Sectigo, including domain and organization validation, issuance, reissuance, and renewal.
* Administer public CA accounts, access permissions, approved certificate profiles, and validation records.
* Operate certificate lifecycle management platforms, including discovery scans, CA connectors, workflows, expiration alerts, and reporting.
* Maintain accurate certificate inventories with application ownership, deployment locations, business criticality, and renewal responsibilities.
* Coordinate certificate installation and replacement with application, server, network, and cloud teams; verify successful deployment.
* Monitor expiration risks and renewal failures, escalate unresolved issues, and drive remediation to prevent certificate-related outages.

**Certificate Automation and Integration**

* Design, implement, and maintain automation for certificate requests, issuance, renewal, deployment, validation, and revocation using PowerShell, REST APIs, ACME, and certificate management platforms.
* Integrate automated workflows with internal and public CAs, web servers, load balancers, cloud services, and application platforms.
* Automate CSR generation and certificate installation while maintaining secure private-key handling and appropriate access controls.
* Implement failure alerts, controlled retries, and post-deployment checks to confirm that renewed certificates are installed and actively served.
* Integrate certificate workflows with ServiceNow, CMDB, monitoring, and security logging platforms.
* Maintain reusable scripts, version-controlled integrations, and documentation to reduce manual effort and operational errors.

**Certificate Tools and Troubleshooting**

* Use OpenSSL to generate private keys and CSRs; create and extract PFX/PKCS#12 packages; and convert certificates between PEM and DER formats.
* Securely package certificates with their private keys and intermediate CA certificates for deployment.
* Inspect certificate subjects, issuers, SANs, validity periods, key usage, extended key usage, and fingerprints.
* Verify certificate chains against trusted roots and confirm that certificates match their private keys.
* Troubleshoot missing or incorrect intermediate certificates, untrusted roots, expired or revoked certificates, and incorrect certificate bundles.
* Diagnose TLS/mTLS handshake failures, hostname mismatches, certificate binding issues, and CRL/OCSP validation failures.
* Troubleshoot AD CS enrollment and auto-enrollment failures, template configurations, and permissions.
* Investigate trust issues across Windows and Linux trust stores, Java keystores, browsers, web servers, load balancers, and cloud services.
* Use OpenSSL, certutil, PowerShell, application logs, and network traces to identify root causes and document corrective actions.

**Operational Support and Governance**

* Maintain operational runbooks, technical documentation, audit evidence, and service metrics.
* Follow privileged-access, separation-of-duties, and secure key-handling requirements.
* Support security reviews, incident investigations, and remediation activities.
* Provide technical guidance to L2 support teams and application owners.
* Participate in an agreed on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance activities.

**What You Will Need**

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 3 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise PKI, Microsoft AD CS, and certificate operations.
* Practical experience administering issuing CAs and supporting offline root CA operations.
* Experience managing publicly trusted TLS certificates through enterprise public CA providers.
* Experience with certificate lifecycle management, including inventory, ownership tracking, monitoring, renewal, deployment, and revocation.
* Strong understanding of X.509 certificates, certificate chains, trust stores, CSRs, SANs, private keys, certificate extensions, and revocation.
* Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, Windows Server, certificate templates, and auto-enrollment.
* Demonstrated ability to automate certificate operations using PowerShell and APIs; familiarity with ACME-based workflows.
* Hands-on OpenSSL experience, including PFX creation and extraction, certificate conversion, chain verification, and TLS troubleshooting.
* Ability to diagnose certificate trust and TLS/mTLS issues across enterprise systems.
* Strong documentation, change-management, incident-management, and cross-team communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Sectigo Certificate Manager.
* Experience with root CA ceremonies, and CA recovery.
* Experience supporting PKI infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience automating certificate deployment to web servers, load balancers, cloud services, or application platforms.
* Familiarity with Certificate Transparency monitoring, and public CA validation requirements.
* Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Reliable internal CA services and public TLS certificate operations.
* Timely renewals and fewer preventable certificate-related outages.
* Accurate certificate inventories with accountable owners.
* Increased automation across the certificate lifecycle.
* Effective troubleshooting and timely resolution of certificate and trust issues.

Documented, tested, and auditable operational and recovery processes

title: Senior Windows Server Administrator - 67153557768
description:
Position : Senior Windows Server Administrator
  
  
Work Hours (Client) : Monday to Friday (iFull night shift covering U.S. business hours)
  
  
Pay Range : $ 1,500 to $ 1,600 / month
  
  
Location of Search : New Delhi, India
  
  
Work Location : In office
  
  
Employment Type : Full-time
  
  
**Company Overview**
Our client is a managed IT and cloud hosting provider built exclusively for tax and accounting firms in America.
  
  
The company operates two lines of business: a hosted cloud environment where accounting firms run their tax and accounting applications on virtual machines, and a managed security and compliance service for firms that need to meet industry regulations. As the client base grows, the company is hiring a Senior Windows Server Administrator to resolve its most complex client machine issues.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Senior Windows Server Administrator to serve as the main escalation point for issues on client machines hosted on the company platform. As their client base grows, the Support team needs one senior engineer who can resolve complex issues end-to-end across networking, the Windows Server operating system, Remote Desktop Services (RDS), and virtualization. This is a hands-on, generalist role working directly with the Manager - IT and the Support team.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Escalation Ownership & Root Cause Analysis
  
  

* Own escalated client machine issues end-to-end, including during peak tax season, isolating the fault across the network, the virtual machine (VM), the operating system, and the application.
* Own all issues on the machine itself, including session host performance, and hand over issues that relate only to Active Directory to the Active Directory administrator.
* Deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for client-facing and repeat incidents, and explain findings to clients in clear, non-technical terms.
* Convert each resolved escalation into a documented known fix so that Support can resolve similar issues at first contact.

Networking & Connectivity
  
  

* Diagnose client connection failures, slowness, and disconnects by measuring latency, packet loss, and routing path, and prove whether the fault is on the client side or the platform side.
* Troubleshoot Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) transport, Domain Name System (DNS) resolution, certificate, and Virtual Private Network (VPN) connectivity issues.
* Review Palo Alto firewall traffic logs to confirm blocked traffic, and raise precise change requests to the security owner.

Windows Server, RDS & Application Hosting
  
  

* Resolve operating system issues on Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025, including performance degradation, crashes and memory dump analysis, failed updates, and system file corruption.
* Resolve RDS issues, including failed logons, user profile errors, stuck sessions, licensing errors, and printer and drive redirection.
* Troubleshoot QuickBooks, Drake, Lacerte, ProSeries, UltraTax, Accounting CS, and Sage at the operating system and SQL Server level, and engage vendors when needed.

Virtualization, Automation & Standards
  
  

* Perform VM-level administration in VMware vCenter, including console recovery, performance analysis, snapshots, and resource changes, and support the planned migration to Hyper-V.
* Build PowerShell scripts for diagnosis and repeat fixes, and deploy them across the fleet through Datto Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM).
* Maintain standards for the golden VM image, fleet health checks, and pre-season readiness, keeping client VMs on the security baseline that supports IRS Publication 4557 and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Safeguards Rule.
* Mentor Support engineers and junior administrators, including the use of AI tools for troubleshooting and documentation.

Role Modeling & Culture
  
  

* Technical mentoring: acting as the team's technical reference and mentoring agents on complex cases through shadowing, troubleshooting together and debriefs after a case is resolved.

Key Performance Metrics
  
  

* Escalation Resolution: Mean time to resolve escalations and share closed without further escalation.
* Repeat Incidents: Number of recurring issues with the same root cause.
* Knowledge Transfer: Known fixes published and reduction in escalation volume from Support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ Years of Windows Server administration experience, including at least 1+ years in an escalation (L3) role at a managed service provider (MSP) or hosting provider.Strong working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewall log analysis, and diagnosis of latency and packet loss.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills in Windows Server and RDS, including performance, crash dump, and event log analysis, user profiles, and licensing.
* Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere and vCenter at the VM level, working knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V, and proficiency in PowerShell scripting for diagnosis and automation.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical clients and to write structured RCA reports.
* Full professional fluency in written and spoken English, as the primary working language with United States-based clients.
* Availability to work a full night shift from the Noida office, covering United States business hours.
* Ability to operate independently with minimal day-to-day oversight during live incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience hosting tax and accounting applications on multi-user RDS servers, including basic SQL Server troubleshooting.
* Experience in MSP or cloud hosting environments, and relevant certifications in Windows Server, VMware, or networking.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Datto RMM, Veeam, Palo Alto, and AI tools such as Claude.

title: Research Scientist (Applied) - IV
description:
Our Company
  
  
Adobe is seeking a highly motivated and versatile Research Scientist to join our Media and Data Science Research (MDSR) Laboratory (https://adobe.mdsr.live/) in the Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) business unit. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to engage in world-class research that will craft the future of digital experiences. As part of our ambitious research team, you will tackle cutting-edge research challenges and develop innovative solutions that transform how businesses operate, engage with customers, market their products, and create impactful advertising experiences. You will have the unique opportunity to see your research evolve into products used by millions of users while also publishing your work at top-tier conferences and journals. Our research and products power the digital experiences of 1,900 of the Fortune 2,000 companies, giving your work the opportunity to create impact at an unparalleled global scale.
  
  
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an outstanding work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe has been consistently listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are dedicated to supporting each other's growth. If you’re looking to make a difference, Adobe's the place for you. Learn more about our employees' career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the valuable benefits we provide.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to craft and deliver outstanding digital experiences. We’re passionate about redefining how companies connect with customers across every screen.
  
  
Our goal is to recruit top talent and provide excellent employee experiences that prioritize respect and equal opportunity. We acknowledge that valuable insights can originate from any team member, including yourself.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead research initiatives in areas such as Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, and Machine Learning.
* Collaborate with product teams to turn research advances into impactful products.
* Design challenging evaluations related to creative intelligence and marketing performance.
* Develop scalable synthetic data generation and evaluation techniques.
* Manipulate and analyze complex, high-volume, and high-dimensional data from diverse sources.
* Train models and run experiments to study data and model quality.
* Iteratively refine research experiments and clearly communicate insights to the team.
* Integrate core machine learning models into the Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Experience Platform.
* Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to rapidly prototype and transition conceptual prototypes from research to production.

**Requirements**

* (PhD degree and 3 years of experience) or (six years of experience) in industrial research in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or other relevant technical fields.
* Hands-on experience and a track record of deploying solutions in production environments.
* Multiple publications in top-tier conferences such as ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, PNAS, Nature, Science, ACL, EMNLP, CHI, WWW, KDD, CVPR, etc.
* Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, Behavioral Sciences, Agentic Workflows, Social Network Analysis, Causal Inference, Recommendation Systems, Multimodal Content Understanding.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:
  
  

* Experience in deriving concrete conclusions and actionable insights from large datasets.
* Ability to take research risks and solve hard problems independently.
* Are a great teammate who is willing to take on a variety of tasks to contribute to the success of the team
* Have a proven track record and an impulse for empirical research, answering complex questions with data.
* Are capable of leading ambitious projects and possessing clear communication skills.
* Have familiarity with crafting quality research experiments and evaluations with rapid iterations.
* Have experience working in complex technical environments and improving research velocity.
* Possess a flexible analytic approach that allows for results at varying levels of precision.

**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**Let’s Adobe together**
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

+ Member/ Constituent experience and engagement
+ Population Health and care management
+ Utilization and cost management
+ Risk and Quality Management

title: Youtube Growth Manager_Noida
description:
**Department:**
Creative / Digital Content

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Sector 142, Noida (Work From Office)

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, analytical and growth-oriented
**YouTube Content & Growth Manager**
who can independently manage and grow our YouTube channels focused on AI-generated content.

The role involves managing the end-to-end YouTube content strategy, including identifying trending content ideas, reviewing AI-generated videos, developing engaging scripts, selecting appropriate music and sound effects, managing uploads and optimising content for maximum reach, engagement and monetization.

The ideal candidate should understand YouTube's algorithm, audience behaviour, content trends and monetization policies, with the ability to turn creative ideas into engaging content that drives channel growth and revenue.

Key Responsibilities (KRAs)

**1. YouTube Channel Management**

* Independently manage and oversee day-to-day operations of YouTube channels.
* Plan and maintain content calendars, upload schedules and publishing strategies.
* Manage video titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists and metadata.
* Ensure consistency in content quality, branding and publishing frequency.

**2. Content Strategy & Ideation**

* Research and suggest creative, engaging and trending content ideas based on the channel's theme and target audience.
* Identify content opportunities by analysing competitors, trends and audience preferences.
* Develop short-form and long-form content strategies for YouTube Shorts and regular videos.
* Suggest new content formats, series and storytelling approaches to improve audience retention.

**3. Scriptwriting & Content Review**

* Develop engaging scripts, storylines, concepts and video narratives.
* Review AI-generated content to ensure storytelling quality, continuity, relevance and overall engagement.
* Decide suitable background music, sound effects, voiceovers and audio treatments.
* Ensure videos have strong hooks, engaging storytelling, smooth transitions and effective endings.

**4. AI Content Creation & Production**

* Generate images, video clips and creative assets using AI tools wherever required.
* Work with AI image and video generation platforms to execute content ideas.
* Develop effective prompts for generating high-quality visual content.
* Coordinate the complete content production process, from ideation to final video approval.

**5. YouTube Growth & Visibility**

* Develop strategies to increase channel reach, subscribers, views and audience engagement.
* Optimise content for YouTube SEO, including titles, descriptions, keywords and thumbnails.
* Improve click-through rates (CTR), average view duration and audience retention.
* Analyse YouTube trends and recommend strategies to improve organic discoverability.
* Experiment with different formats, posting schedules, thumbnails and content approaches.

**6. Analytics & Performance Monitoring**

* Regularly monitor YouTube Studio analytics and channel performance.
* Track views, watch time, impressions, CTR, subscriber growth, engagement and audience retention.
* Identify high-performing and underperforming content and recommend improvements.
* Prepare periodic performance reports with actionable growth strategies.
* Track progress towards YouTube Partner Program eligibility and monetization goals.

**7. Monetization & Policy Compliance**

* Develop content strategies focused on building monetizable YouTube channels.
* Understand YouTube monetization policies, copyright guidelines and advertiser-friendly content requirements.
* Ensure appropriate usage and licensing of music, visuals and other creative assets.
* Focus on creating original, valuable and audience-focused AI content that meets YouTube's monetization standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 1–4 years of experience in YouTube channel management, digital content strategy or social media growth.
* Strong understanding of YouTube algorithms, SEO, analytics and monetization.
* Excellent scriptwriting, storytelling and content ideation skills.
* Hands-on experience with YouTube Studio and channel performance analytics.
* Familiarity with AI image and video generation tools such as Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT, Runway, Kling, Veo, Pika, Higgsfield or similar platforms.
* Understanding of video editing, sound design, background music selection and visual storytelling.
* Ability to research trends, analyse competitors and identify content opportunities.
* Strong creative thinking, ownership and analytical skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Consistency and quality of content publishing.
* Growth in organic views, subscribers and channel reach.
* Improvement in impressions click-through rate (CTR) and audience retention.
* Increase in watch hours and overall audience engagement.
* Effectiveness of content ideas and execution.
* Progress towards YouTube monetization milestones.
* Quality and originality of AI-generated content.
* Improvement in overall channel performance and visibility.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is not just a video uploader but a
**YouTube growth enthusiast**
who understands how to build a channel, create engaging content, attract audiences and convert views into long-term channel growth and monetization.

The candidate must be proactive, experimental, creative and capable of taking complete ownership of the channel's growth journey.

title: Performance Media Buyer – Lead Generation (Meta & Google Ads)
description:
We're Hiring: Performance Media Buyer – Lead Generation (Meta & Google Ads)

Company: Yellow Octo LLP

Location: Remote / Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 Years

Fixed Salary: ₹20,000–₹25,000 per month

Performance Incentive: Up to ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month

About Yellow Octo LLP

Yellow Octo LLP is a performance-driven agency operating at the intersection of media buying, affiliate marketing and digital acquisition. We focus on generating high-intent traffic and scaling lead-generation campaigns across competitive niches.

We are looking for an execution-focused \*Performance Media Buyer\* who can independently manage, optimize and scale lead-generation campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Key Responsibilities

•⁠ ⁠Plan, launch and manage lead-generation campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor and optimize daily ad spends, CPL, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality.

•⁠ ⁠Conduct audience research, keyword research and competitor analysis.

•⁠ ⁠Develop and test different ad creatives, hooks, headlines and copy variations.

•⁠ ⁠Run A/B tests to improve campaign performance and reduce acquisition costs.

•⁠ ⁠Optimize landing pages, pre-landers and lead forms to improve conversion rates.

•⁠ ⁠Manage tracking and attribution using Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI) and UTM parameters.

•⁠ ⁠Analyze campaign performance and make data-driven decisions to pause, optimize or scale campaigns.

•⁠ ⁠Prepare regular performance reports and share actionable insights.

Required Skills & Experience

•⁠ ⁠1–3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or media buying.

•⁠ ⁠Practical experience managing direct-response lead-generation campaigns.

•⁠ ⁠Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, including audience targeting, Lookalike Audiences and Advantage+ campaigns.

•⁠ ⁠Experience running Google Search and Performance Max campaigns.

•⁠ ⁠Understanding of bidding strategies such as Maximize Conversions and Target CPA.

•⁠ ⁠Ability to monitor campaign budgets and optimize CPL, CPA and lead quality.

•⁠ ⁠Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, CAPI and conversion tracking.

•⁠ ⁠Working knowledge of landing page optimization, CRM integrations and automation tools such as Zapier or Make.com.

•⁠ ⁠Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Compensation

•⁠ ⁠\*Fixed:\* ₹20,000–₹25,000 per month, based on experience and demonstrated campaign performance.

•⁠ ⁠\*Variable:\* Up to ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month, linked to lead volume, lead quality and campaign profitability.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with numbers, testing campaigns, optimizing ad performance and taking ownership of measurable results.

If you have hands-on experience in Meta and Google Ads and know how to generate quality leads while maintaining acquisition costs, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now!
