title: Researcher
description:
**About Varahe Analytics:**

Varahe Analytics is one of India’s premier integrated political consulting firms specializing in building data-driven 360-degree election campaigns. We help our clients with strategic advice and implementation, combining data-backed insights and in-depth ground intelligence into a holistic electoral campaign.

We are passionate about our democracy and the politics that shape our world. We draw on some of the sharpest minds from distinguished institutions and diverse professional backgrounds to help us achieve our goal of building electoral strategies that spark conversations, effect change, and help shape electoral and legislative ecosystems in our country.

**About the Role:**

The Economic, Financial & Data Intelligence Team is a specialist wing of the National Research Teampolitical consulting organisation. It will assess government policies, schemes, budgets, public expenditure, investments and projects, and turn its findings into actionable insights for leadership, clients, policymakers and public communication.

As a Consultant, you will be the team’s core execution resource. You will conduct research, build and clean datasets, run economic and financial calculations, and support modelling work under the guidance of senior team members.

**What Would This Role Entail?**

1. Collect, clean and validate data from budget documents, scheme dashboards, official statistics, surveys and other sources.
2. Carry out economic and financial calculations on costs, revenues, expenditure, employment and income effects of policies and projects.
3. Draft, cost and evaluate policy measures across states and at the national level.
4. Build and maintain financial models, cost-benefit analyses and impact estimates under the direction of Senior Consultants.
5. Conduct statistical analysis and forecasting to answer the team’s research questions.
6. Track union and state budgets, policy announcements and economic developments.
7. Prepare research notes, data tables, charts, reports and presentations that are accurate and well-formatted.
8. Verify sources and document methods and assumptions so that every figure can be traced and reviewed.

**Eligibility Criteria**

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelors or Masters in Economics, Applied Economics, Econometrics, Development Economics, Financial Economics, International Economics, Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance, Public Finance, Financial Management, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Operations Research.
* Engineers with a keen eye for Public Policy and Public Policy Researchers with demonstrated data analytics experience are also welcome to apply.

**Experience**
: 1-2 years in economic consulting, financial advisory, corporate finance, investment research, public-policy research, think tanks, programme evaluation, data analytics or economic research.

**Skills Required**

1. Advanced Excel (essential) and working proficiency in at least one of Python, R, Tableau and other current data analysis and visualisation tools/languages.
2. Sound grasp of economic and financial concepts, public finance and budgets.
3. Strong attention to detail in data handling and calculations.
4. Clear report writing, data visualisation and formatting skills.
5. Good awareness of India's economic and policy landscape; understanding of the political context is an advantage.
6. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with time-sensitive deliverables, including flexibility during critical periods, and willingness to travel across India.

Interested professionals looking for a high-impact challenge, capable of working with a team of like-minded and motivated individuals who think strategically, act decisively and get things done, are requested to drop an email at
openings@varaheanalytics.com

title: Cafe Manager
description:
About Lean Life Café

Lean Life Café is a healthy-food café focused on nutritious meals, protein-rich food, salads, healthy bowls, and regular meal subscriptions. We are looking for an Operations Manager who can independently manage daily outlet operations, improve customer retention, increase subscription sales, and ensure smooth coordination between the kitchen, delivery team, and vendors.

Key responsibilities

1. Order Management

\* Manage all walk-in, WhatsApp, phone, subscription, and online orders.

\* Coordinate with chefs to ensure accurate preparation, portion control, packaging, and timely dispatch.

\* Track pending and completed orders and resolve customer complaints.

2. Subscription Sales to Existing Customers

\* Call and follow up with existing customers to sell meal subscriptions and prepaid wallets.

\* Track subscription expiry dates, renewals, inactive customers, and repeat purchases.

\* Convert regular food customers into subscription customers.

\* Achieve weekly and monthly subscription sales targets.

3. Delivery Management

\* Plan and assign daily deliveries for subscription meals and individual orders.

\* Coordinate delivery staff, optimise routes, and monitor on-time delivery.

\* Maintain delivery records and resolve delays or failed deliveries.

4. Inventory Management

\* Maintain stock of chicken, fish, paneer, eggs, vegetables, fruits, dairy, groceries, and packaging materials.

\* Monitor daily consumption, expiry dates, wastage, and stock shortages.

\* Maintain stock registers and ensure proper food storage and FIFO/FEFO practices.

5. Staff Management

\* Supervise chefs, kitchen helpers, cleaning staff, and delivery personnel.

\* Manage attendance, duty rosters, shift allocation, and staff productivity.

\* Ensure food quality, kitchen cleanliness, personal hygiene, and adherence to operating procedures.

6. Vendor and Purchasing Management

\* Coordinate with suppliers for daily raw materials and other café requirements.

\* Prepare purchase lists based on stock and expected subscription orders.

\* Check quality, quantity, rates, and invoices.

\* Control purchasing costs and reduce unnecessary stock, wastage, and emergency purchases.

Performance targets

Area Expected outcome

Orders Accurate processing and timely dispatch

Subscriptions Consistent renewals and new subscription revenue from existing customers

Deliveries On-time delivery and fewer complaints

Inventory Minimal wastage and accurate stock records

Staff Proper attendance, discipline, and productivity

Purchasing Cost control and consistent ingredient quality

Candidate requirements

\* 2–4 years of experience in restaurant, café, cloud kitchen, or food operations preferred.

\* Experience managing kitchen teams, delivery staff, and suppliers.

\* Good communication, customer follow-up, and sales skills.

\* Basic Excel/Google Sheets and inventory management knowledge.

\* Ability to take ownership of daily operations with minimal supervision.

Most important requirement: The candidate must be comfortable handling both operations and subscription sales. This is not just a floor-supervisor role; the person must help Lean Life Café increase recurring customers while controlling daily operating costs.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
The Staff Software Development Engineer role within Clearwater’s Agentic Client Interactions & Orchestration (ACIO) is a senior technical leadership position focused on architecting, designing, and delivering large-scale distributed systems that power critical financial reporting and analytics. This role requires deep expertise in scalable system design, agentic architecture, cloud-native platforms, and high-performance data processing.
  
  
You will play a key role in shaping the technical direction, ensuring architectural excellence, and enabling teams to build robust, maintainable systems that support Clearwater’s commitment to industry-leading financial reporting solutions. Senior engineers at this level are expected to think strategically, lead through influence, and drive innovations that scale across products and teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of Clearwater ACIO systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in large-scale financial data processing.
* Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems.
* Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
* Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps.
* Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery**

* Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater.
* Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation.
* Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks.
* Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development.
* Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies.
* Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency.
* Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven architecture and design expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably in financial or analytics platforms.
* Exceptional leadership skills and ability to lead through influence as a technical architect or senior tech lead.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and data streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including scaling, cost optimization, and multi-region deployments.
* Proficiency in one or more modern languages (Java, Python, Go, or similar) with deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of distributed data storage, database scaling, and query optimization techniques.
* Worked on agentic conversational UX design and architecture.
* Developed and deployed systems with complex SLAs in production environments serving high-volume traffic/data.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly convey architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commitment to continuous technical learning, improvement, and community knowledge sharing.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 15+ years of professional software development experience; 5+ years acting in an architecture or principal engineering capacity.
* Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-grade distributed systems and owning them through full lifecycle (design → build → deploy → maintain).

description:
**Req ID:**
379740
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a ERP Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description – UKG Functional Consultant – AMS**
**Role:**
UKG Functional Consultant
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ Years
  
  
**Locations:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Noida
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office – 5 Days a Week
  
  
**Engagement:**
Application Management Services (AMS)
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**UKG Functional Consultant**
with 8+ years of hands-on experience in UKG Workforce Management solutions to support an enterprise AMS engagement.
  
  
The consultant will play a key role across
**transition, knowledge acquisition, stabilization, steady-state support, and continuous improvement**
. The role requires strong UKG functional expertise, production support experience, business process understanding, and the ability to collaborate effectively with business, HR, Payroll, IT, and technical teams.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring stable application operations, resolving complex functional issues, supporting business-critical workforce and payroll processes, delivering enhancements, and proactively identifying opportunities for service and process improvement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Transition & Knowledge Acquisition
  
  

* Participate actively in transition and knowledge transfer sessions with incumbent teams, business SMEs, and application owners.
* Understand the existing UKG landscape, business processes, configurations, interfaces, integrations, customizations, and dependencies.
* Review and validate SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration documentation, known-error databases, and operational procedures.
* Perform reverse knowledge transfer and demonstrate readiness for independent application support.
* Identify knowledge gaps, operational risks, dependencies, and documentation gaps during transition.
* Support service readiness and transition-to-steady-state activities.

Steady-State Functional Support
  
  

* Provide L2/L3 functional support for UKG Workforce Management applications.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve functional incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
* Support business-critical processes related to timekeeping, scheduling, attendance, accruals, leave, and payroll.
* Investigate complex production issues and collaborate with technical teams and UKG/vendor support where required.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and high-impact incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
* Support incident, problem, change, release, and knowledge management processes.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates and ensure timely communication with business stakeholders.

UKG Functional Expertise
  
  
Strong hands-on experience in relevant UKG modules and capabilities, including:
  
  

* Time & Attendance / Timekeeping
* Scheduling / Advanced Scheduling
* Accruals
* Leave and Absence Management
* Attendance
* Pay Rules and Work Rules
* Labor Levels and Labor Tracking
* Holiday and Overtime Rules
* Employee and Organizational Setup
* Timecard and Payroll Processing
* Workforce Management business processes

Experience with
**UKG Pro Workforce Management (UKG Dimensions)**
and/or
**UKG Workforce Central**
is highly desirable.
  
  
Configuration & Enhancements
  
  

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into UKG functional solutions.
* Configure and maintain pay rules, work rules, accrual policies, schedules, attendance rules, and related functional components.
* Perform impact analysis for configuration changes and enhancements.
* Prepare functional specifications and configuration documentation.
* Coordinate with technical teams for integrations and technically dependent enhancements.
* Support minor enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives through the complete change lifecycle.

Testing & Release Support
  
  

* Prepare functional test scenarios and test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and post-deployment validation.
* Support SIT and UAT and coordinate defect resolution.
* Validate production changes following releases and deployments.
* Support UKG patches, releases, upgrades, and platform changes from a functional perspective.

Payroll & Business-Critical Support
  
  

* Support payroll-critical UKG processes, including timecard validation, approvals, pay-rule processing, accruals, and payroll interfaces.
* Investigate and resolve timekeeping and payroll-impacting issues within critical timelines.
* Coordinate with HR, Payroll, Operations, and technical teams during business-critical processing windows.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Analyze incident trends and identify opportunities to reduce recurring issues.
* Recommend configuration, process, and operational improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation, ticket reduction, shift-left, and self-service.
* Improve knowledge articles, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and support documentation.
* Contribute to service improvement plans and operational excellence initiatives.

Governance & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Participate in operational reviews and service governance meetings.
* Provide clear updates on incidents, problems, changes, risks, and enhancements.
* Work closely with business users, HR, Payroll, IT teams, and other application support teams.
* Ensure adherence to agreed SLA/KPI and service management processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in UKG/Kronos Workforce Management.
* Strong functional expertise in UKG Workforce Management business processes.
* Proven experience in enterprise production support / AMS engagements.
* Hands-on experience in UKG configuration and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Time & Attendance, Scheduling, Accruals, and Payroll-related processes.
* Experience handling P1/P2 and other business-critical production incidents.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Knowledge Management.
* Strong analytical and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder and customer management capabilities.

**Preferred Skills**

* UKG certification(s).
* Experience with UKG Pro Workforce Management / UKG Dimensions.
* Experience with UKG Workforce Central.
* Experience supporting global or large-scale UKG environments.
* ITIL certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies.

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work from the office 5 days a week.
* Must be able to work from Bengaluru, Noida, or Hyderabad.

* Flexibility is required for payroll-critical processing, financial close cycles, production deployments, major incidents, system upgrades, releases, and other critical business events.

title: Cisco Wireless / Aruba Migration - Network Engineering Advisor
description:
**Req ID:**
359375
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cisco Wireless / Aruba Migration - Network Engineering Advisor to join our team in Noida, Bangalore, Hyd, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced L3 Wireless Network Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), Cisco Catalyst Wireless platforms, enterprise WLAN design, troubleshooting, and migration of wireless infrastructure from Aruba to Cisco.
  
  
The engineer will act as a senior technical resource responsible for complex wireless incidents, problem management, design validation, implementation, optimization, and migration activities across large enterprise environments.
  
  
The role requires strong troubleshooting capability across the complete wireless stack, including Wireless LAN Controllers, Access Points, RF, authentication, switching, DHCP/DNS, AAA/RADIUS, Cisco ISE, and client connectivity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cisco Wireless LAN Controller – L3 Support
  
  

* Provide L3 operational and engineering support for enterprise Cisco wireless environments.
* Configure, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize:
* Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless LAN Controllers
* Cisco AireOS WLC platforms where applicable
* Cisco Catalyst Access Points
* Troubleshoot complex wireless connectivity, roaming, authentication, RF, performance, and client onboarding issues.
* Perform detailed root cause analysis for recurring and major wireless incidents.
* Analyse WLC and AP logs, debugs, packet captures, and client connection statistics.
* Troubleshoot issues involving:
* AP registration
* CAPWAP
* Client association
* Authentication
* DHCP
* DNS
* VLAN assignment
* Roaming
* RF interference
* Poor signal / SNR
* High channel utilization
* Client drops
* Throughput degradation
* Configure WLANs, SSIDs, policies, RF profiles, AP groups/tags, VLAN mappings, and mobility configurations.
* Perform software upgrades, controller migrations, AP upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
* Support High Availability and redundancy configurations for wireless controllers.

Aruba-to-Cisco Wireless Migration
  
  

* Lead or support migration of enterprise wireless infrastructure from Aruba Wireless to Cisco Catalyst Wireless.
* Assess existing Aruba environments including:
* Aruba Mobility Controllers
* Aruba Mobility Conductor/Master
* Aruba Access Points
* SSIDs
* AAA profiles
* VLAN mappings
* RF configurations
* Authentication policies
* Translate existing Aruba wireless configurations and policies into equivalent Cisco configurations.
* Develop migration methodologies, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and test plans.
* Perform Aruba-to-Cisco configuration mapping for:
* SSIDs/WLANs

* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.

title: Head of Ecommerce
description:
**FyneHand has been mandated to hire for a Head of Ecommerce for a leading player in the personal care industry. The job location is Noida**

**Role overview:**
The Head of Ecommerce will own the full digital commerce engine: new customer acquisition through organic and inorganic channels, deep retention architecture, global market entry, and a product merchandising experience that reflects the brand's heritage. As Head of Ecommerce, the role will have full ownership of the digital commerce business its P&L, its people, its strategy, and its execution. The role will sit at the intersection of brand, marketing, product, and technology.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Revenue & Growth**

* Own and deliver the ecommerce P&L, revenue, margin, CAC, LTV, and channel contribution
* Define the annual and quarterly growth roadmap across D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce and emerging digital channels
* Build a growth model that reduces CAC over time by increasing organic channel contribution and improving retention economics

**Acquisition - Organic & Inorganic**

* Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google, YouTube, programmatic, and affiliate channels with a rigorous test-and-learn culture
* Own and grow organic acquisition through SEO, content marketing, editorial partnerships, and influencer strategy anchored in brand values
* Drive sampling, trial, and discovery programmes that introduce new customers to the client in a way consistent with its luxury positioning

**Retention & CRM**

* Build a strong CRM and lifecycle marketing capability, email, WhatsApp, push, and loyalty that meaningfully reduces churn

**Site Experience & Merchandising**

* Own the D2C website experience conversion, UX, speed, and storytelling ensuring it reflects a luxury experience at every touchpoint
* Lead digital merchandising strategy: product sequencing, seasonal launches, editorial curation, and online exclusive offerings
* Partner with technology and product teams on continuous CRO informed by data, customer feedback, and brand standards

**Global Expansion**

* Define the ecommerce strategy for international market entry
* Work with client's global network and distribution infrastructure to identify and execute the most efficient path to international ecommerce revenue
* Build localisation frameworks: pricing, content, channel mix, customer service, and logistics for each priority market

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

* Establish a rigorous analytics and reporting framework: dashboards for acquisition, retention, LTV cohorts, channel contribution, and funnel performance
* Make data-driven decisions at pace while retaining the sensibility that brand-consistent qualitative signals matter as much as quantitative metrics

**Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing ecommerce, performance marketing, tech and CRM team

**Qualification & Experience:**

* 15–20 years of progressive experience in ecommerce, digital growth, or performance marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role
* Deep expertise in luxury, premium beauty, skincare, or lifestyle categories a native understanding of why brand equity and customer experience matter more than promotional volume
* Proven track record of scaling D2C businesses with strong unit economics not just topline revenue
* Experience building and executing multi-market ecommerce strategies, global experience is a plus
* Hands-on fluency in both paid and organic acquisition, understands how algorithms work, but also understands brand building
* Strong CRM and retention capability, built lifecycle programmes
* Familiarity with marketplace ecosystems and international platform strategy

**Location:**
Noida

Client details will be shared with shortlisted candidates only.

If this opportunity aligns with your leadership journey, we would be happy to connect.

To apply, please send your profile to
**sahana@fynehand.in or cvtofynehand@outlook.com**
. For a confidential discussion or any queries regarding the opportunity, please reach out via
**sahana@fynehand.in**

title: Lead – Digital Campaign
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

The position requires deep collaboration with IT, marketing, and external digital agencies to ensure a seamless and engaging digital brand experience.

Track and analyze social media performance metrics to continuously refine strategies for higher engagement and conversions.

Channel Partner App – Streamlining interactions and communication with channel partners.
  
  
Virtual Call Center – Enhancing digital customer service experience.

Ensure website integration with CRM systems and marketing automation tools to enhance customer interactions.
  
  
Conduct A/B testing and performance tracking to improve website effectiveness and conversion rates.

Implement mystery shopping initiatives to gather real-time customer insights for refining branding efforts.
  
  
Perform customer segmentation and profiling to develop targeted branding and digital marketing campaigns.
  
  
Monitor emerging digital technologies and best practices to keep Adani Realty at the forefront of digital branding.
  
  
**Digital Brand Asset Management**
Develop digital brand guidelines ensuring brand consistency across all online platforms.
  
  
Oversee the creation and distribution of multimedia assets, including videos, animations, and infographics, for digital campaigns.
  
  
Ensure that all corporate and promotional digital assets align with brand standards and quality benchmarks.
  
  
**Operations & Compliance**
Ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices related to branding initiatives, including payments to agencies and vendors.
  
  
Conduct periodic audits of branding activities to ensure compliance with internal policies and branding guidelines.
  
  
Ensure adherence to approval processes and governance structures for branding budgets and digital campaigns.

Business Head
  
  
Sales and Marketing Head
  
  
HR
  
  
Digital & IT
  
  
Group Brand Team
  
  
Group Social Media Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Agencies - Advertisement, Creative, Media
  
  
Media Houses
  
  
Vendors
  
  
Customers
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
MBA in Marketing or related field.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
7-10 Years
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Experience in digital marketing, digital branding, social media management, or online reputation management (ORM).

title: Early Year Facilitator (128 & 132 Noida)
description:
KLAY is India’s largest company-owned and operated early childhood partner, supporting over 80,000 families across 180+ centres in more than 20 cities. Founded in 2011, KLAY is built on the belief that parents should be able to return to work without guilt while every child’s unique potential is nurtured.

The organization offers a unified, child-first ecosystem for children aged 6 months to 10 years, including preschool, daycare, experiential play zones, and inclusive early intervention support. With 4,500+ trained educators, global safety protocols, and real-time parent updates, KLAY focuses on high-quality care, learning, and wellbeing. Trusted by over 650 enterprises, KLAY also provides turnkey childcare solutions that support employee retention, productivity, and peace of mind.

Role Description

The Facilitator (Early Years Assistant Facilitator) is a full-time, on-site role based at a KLAY centre in Noida.

The role involves supporting lead educators in implementing play-based learning experiences, maintaining a safe and nurturing classroom environment, and assisting with daily routines such as arrival, dispersal, mealtimes, and rest periods. The Facilitator engages children in age-appropriate activities that foster social, emotional, cognitive, and physical development, while observing and documenting their progress. Responsibilities include maintaining hygiene and safety standards, preparing learning materials, communicating with parents and guardians as needed, and collaborating with the centre team to ensure high-quality early childhood experiences.

The Facilitator may also support inclusive practices and early intervention efforts under guidance from senior staff.

Qualifications

Foundational knowledge of early childhood development, child psychology, or preschool education, preferably supported by a diploma or degree in Early Childhood Education or a related field.

* Experience working with young children in preschool, daycare, or similar settings, with the ability to facilitate play-based and experiential learning activities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage children, collaborate with colleagues, and interact professionally with parents and caregivers.
* Ability to maintain a safe, clean, and organized classroom environment, following health, hygiene, and child-safeguarding protocols.
* Patience, empathy, and cultural sensitivity, with a commitment to inclusive education and supporting children where required.
* Basic record-keeping and observation skills to document children’s development and share accurate updates with the teaching team and families.
* Willingness to participate in ongoing training, adhere to KLAY’s curriculum framework, and align with child-first values and professional conduct standards.

title: Lead – Budget & Cash Flow
description:
**Responsibilities**
Budget Planning & Management
  
  

* Lead preparation of annual operating plans, project budgets, business budgets, and financial forecasts.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to consolidate budget inputs and assumptions.
* Develop project-wise and business-unit-wise budget models.
* Monitor budget utilization and analyze variances against approved plans.
* Ensure alignment of budgets with organizational goals and business strategies.

Cash Flow Planning & Monitoring
  
  

* Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts for projects and business operations.
* Monitor fund inflows, outflows, liquidity requirements, and working capital needs.
* Track project cash flow performance and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Ensure adequate availability of funds for project execution and operational requirements.
* Support strategic cash management and treasury planning initiatives.

Financial Analysis & Reporting
  
  

* Analyze financial performance against budget and forecast benchmarks.
* Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management presentations.
* Conduct trend analysis, variance analysis, scenario planning, and forecasting exercises.
* Provide actionable insights to senior management on project and business performance.
* Develop periodic reports covering project profitability, cash flow status, and fund utilization.

Project Finance Support
  
  

* Monitor project expenditures, cost commitments, and revenue projections.
* Support project feasibility assessments, business case reviews, and investment evaluation exercises.
* Coordinate with Project, Sales, Procurement, and Business teams for financial planning and tracking.
* Track project-specific financial KPIs and recommend performance improvement measures.

Cost Control & Financial Governance
  
  

* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and enhanced financial efficiency.
* Monitor adherence to approved budgets and financial control processes.
* Support implementation of internal controls and financial governance practices.
* Assist management in evaluating financial risks and mitigation measures.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Business Development, Projects, Sales, Procurement, Commercial, and Treasury teams.
* Coordinate with auditors, finance controllers, and internal stakeholders for financial reviews.
* Support leadership reviews and budget approval discussions.
* Present financial analysis and budgeting recommendations to senior management.

Process Improvement & Automation
  
  

* Drive improvements in budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
* Support implementation of financial planning and reporting tools.
* Develop automated MIS and dashboard solutions for efficient financial monitoring.
* Promote best practices in budgeting and cash flow management.

**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA), CMA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualification from a reputed institution.
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline.

Experience
  
  

* 8–12 years of experience in Budgeting, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Cash Flow Management, Project Finance, or Business Finance.
* Experience in Real Estate, Infrastructure, Construction, Manufacturing, or Project-driven organizations preferred.
* Strong exposure to budgeting cycles, financial forecasting, management reporting, and project financial analysis.
* Experience in handling project-based financial planning and fund management will be preferred.

title: Principal Engineer/ Lead Process Engineer
description:
**Overview**
The Principal Engineer – Process will provide technical leadership and process engineering assurance across clean water, desalination, wastewater and sludge treatment projects. The role will lead complex studies and designs from strategic assessment and feasibility through outline/detailed design, construction support, commissioning and performance optimisation, while developing engineers and strengthening client relationships.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
*Roles & Responsibilities*
**Technical Experience And Role Requirements**

* Demonstrable experience in the selection, design, review, commissioning and optimisation of clean water, desalination, wastewater and sludge treatment systems across feasibility, outline design, detailed design and operational improvement stages.
* Clean-water experience should include source-water quality assessment; coagulation, flocculation, clarification and dissolved air flotation; rapid gravity, pressure and membrane filtration; activated carbon adsorption; ion exchange; advanced oxidation; remineralisation; disinfection; chemical storage and dosing; and management of treatment residuals.
* Desalination experience should cover seawater and brackish-water reverse osmosis, intake and outfall considerations, pre-treatment selection, membrane configuration and recovery, energy-recovery systems, fouling and scaling control, clean-in-place systems, post-treatment and stabilisation, product-water quality, and brine management.
* Wastewater experience should include preliminary and primary treatment, activated sludge, SBR, MBR and attached-growth biological processes, nutrient removal, tertiary filtration, disinfection, effluent reuse, sludge thickening, dewatering and digestion, and odour control.
* The role also requires capability in process calculations, mass and water balances, hydraulic and process modelling, equipment sizing, pilot and treatability studies, process-control philosophy, performance testing, trend and operational-data analysis, root-cause investigation, troubleshooting, capacity assessment, energy and chemical optimisation, and development of practical, safe and whole-life-cost-effective improvement measures.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Act as Process Lead or Technical Authority on major and technically complex water and wastewater projects, establishing the design basis, process philosophy, key criteria and assurance plan.
* Lead feasibility studies, options appraisal, whole-life-cost evaluation, process selection, pilot/trial planning, risk-based decision making and preferred-option recommendations.
* Prepare, review and approve process calculations and deliverables, including flow and load assessments, mass balances, hydraulic profiles, process flow diagrams, P&IDs, equipment sizing, datasheets, specifications, control philosophies, commissioning strategies and performance-test requirements.
* Undertake plant performance reviews, capacity assessments, process troubleshooting and root-cause analysis; translate operational data into practical improvement measures.
* Lead or support process-safety and design-risk activities including HAZID, HAZOP, SWIFT, DSEAR/ATEX reviews, CDM design-risk management and constructability/operability reviews.
* Develop procurement documentation, evaluate supplier and contractor submissions, undertake technical bid evaluation, manage technical clarifications and confirm compliance with performance requirements.
* Provide construction, commissioning and start-up support, including review of method statements, functional descriptions, operating procedures, sampling plans, performance testing and optimisation.
* Apply and develop digital engineering methods such as automated process-sizing tools, data analytics, process simulation, digital design environments and model-based review.
* Prepare and approve high-quality technical reports, proposals, scope documents, fee estimates and programme inputs across the project lifecycle.
* Maintain effective communication with clients and delivery teams across the UK and other international markets, presenting complex engineering recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent) in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
* Typically, 12–18 years of relevant process engineering experience in the water and wastewater sector, including substantial responsibility for technical leadership, checking/approval and multidisciplinary delivery.
* Proven project experience covering at least two of the three core areas: clean water treatment, desalination/membrane systems and wastewater treatment; broader experience across all three is strongly preferred.
* Experience delivering international projects, preferably for UK, Middle East, Asia-Pacific or North American clients.

title: Accessibility Consultant
description:
**Details:**

INSEAD is seeking an experienced Accessibility QA Engineer (Accessibility) to establish and drive accessibility testing practices across Learning Technology, Student Services, and Enterprise Applications.

This role will lead the adoption of accessibility testing standards aligned with WCAG 2.2 AA, implement an accessibility testing framework, integrate accessibility validation into CI/CD pipelines, and support compliance initiatives across INSEAD's digital services.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining accessibility testing standards, implementing both manual and automated accessibility testing, establishing governance and reporting, and supporting product teams in remediating accessibility issues.

In addition, this role will support the broader Quality Engineering strategy by expanding test automation coverage and automated regression testing across INSEAD's critical applications.

**Accessibility expertise, including designing accessibility frameworks, governance, standards, and compliance processes, is the primary requirement for this role. Knowledge of Tosca and Java-based automation is preferred and will be considered a secondary requirement to support accessibility test automation initiatives.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accessibility Strategy & Governance**

* Define and implement INSEAD's Accessibility Testing Framework.
* Establish accessibility testing standards aligned with WCAG 2.2 AA and accessibility compliance requirements & s hould be able to implement Accessibility automated tests in Tosca.
* Define accessibility testing processes, methodologies, templates, governance, and reporting standards.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, UX Designers, and QA teams to embed accessibility into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Lead accessibility awareness sessions, workshops, and coaching programs.
* Provide expert guidance and recommendations on accessibility best practices and remediation strategies.

**Accessibility Testing & Compliance**

* Design and execute accessibility testing across web and digital platforms.
* Build accessibility test scenarios, use cases, and reusable test assets.
* Conduct accessibility assessments and audits.
* Perform:
* Keyboard navigation testing
* Screen reader testing
* Color contrast validation
* Focus management testing
* ARIA validation
* Workflow accessibility testing
* Evaluate compliance against WCAG requirements.
* Provide accessibility gap analysis and remediation recommendations.
* Work closely with development teams to validate fixes and improvements.

**Accessibility Automation & CI/CD**

* Implement automated accessibility testing using Tricentis Tosca Accessibility capabilities.
* Evaluate and recommend complementary accessibility tools and technologies.
* Integrate accessibility testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build automated accessibility regression test suites.
* Establish accessibility quality gates as part of the delivery process.
* Develop accessibility dashboards, compliance reports, and metrics.
* Promote continuous accessibility testing within Agile and DevOps teams.

**Accessibility Tools & Innovation**

Recognizing that no single tool provides complete accessibility coverage, the Accessibility QA Engineer will:

* Evaluate and recommend accessibility testing solutions beyond Tosca (depends if Tosca is enough)
* Research and recommend open-source and commercial accessibility tools.
* Establish a best-practice accessibility testing toolchain combining automated and manual techniques.
* Benchmark industry practices and continuously improves INSEAD accessibility testing capabilities.
* Support proof-of-concepts and pilot implementations of emerging accessibility technologies.

**Test Automation & Quality Engineering**

* Expand automated testing coverage across critical applications.
* Design and maintain automated regression test suites.
* Improve test automation execution efficiency and reporting.
* Support Quality Engineering initiatives across Digital Delivery.
* Reduce manual testing effort through automation and reusable testing frameworks.
* Drive best practices for automated testing within Agile delivery teams.

**Applications in Scope**

**The Accessibility QA Engineer Will Initially Focus On:**

**Learning Technology Platforms**

* Canvas LMS
* Study
* Intrepid
* Bidding

**Required Experience Essential**

* 10+ years of experience in Accessibility Testing.
* Strong knowledge of:
* WCAG 2.1 / WCAG 2.2
* WAI-ARIA standards
* Accessible User Interface design principles
* Accessibility compliance practices
* Experience implementing accessibility programs and frameworks.
* Experience with automated test frameworks.
* Experience integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience developing accessibility test strategies and testing frameworks.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

**Open-Source Accessibility Tools (if Tosca is not sufficient)**

* axe DevTools / axe-core
* Pa11y
* Lighthouse Accessibility
* WAVE
* Accessibility Insights
* ARC Toolkit

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* CPACC (Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies)
* WAS (Web Accessibility Specialist)
* IAAP Certifications
* ISTQB Testing Certifications
* ISTQB Test Automation Engineer
* Agile Testing Certifications

About the Company
  
We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.

Role Overview
  
We are looking for an experienced IBM MQ Lead / Administrator with strong technical and leadership capabilities to manage enterprise messaging environments and production support operations.
  
The candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership, managing day-to-day MQ operations, handling critical incidents, coordinating with L2/L3 teams, and ensuring timely resolution and closure of issues. The role requires strong client-facing skills, ownership of production activities, and the ability to lead support teams in a 24x7 environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Lead and manage IBM MQ administration and production support activities across multiple environments.
  
Provide technical leadership to the MQ support team and guide team members in troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  
Take ownership of critical and complex incidents and drive them through to resolution and closure.
  
Analyze production issues, identify the impacted areas, and coordinate with relevant technical teams for resolution.
  
Coordinate with L2, L3, application, infrastructure, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve complex issues within agreed SLAs.
  
Act as the primary technical point of contact for MQ-related issues and operational activities.
  
Lead incident calls and ensure clear communication between technical teams, stakeholders, and clients.
  
Provide regular and accurate status updates to clients and management during critical incidents.
  
Coordinate with L2/L3 teams for detailed troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions.
  
Ensure issues are properly tracked, resolved, validated, and formally closed.
  
Review recurring incidents and coordinate with relevant teams to identify permanent solutions and preventive measures.
  
Manage and coordinate shift operations, including shift handovers, pending activities, critical incidents, and operational priorities.
  
Ensure adequate coverage and smooth execution of 24x7 production support and shift activities.
  
Coordinate planned activities, changes, deployments, maintenance, and testing with respective teams.
  
Review and approve operational activities, implementation plans, rollback plans, and troubleshooting approaches where applicable.
  
Participate in client meetings, governance calls, service reviews, and technical discussions.
  
Translate technical issues into clear business-impact updates for clients and stakeholders.
  
Ensure adherence to operational procedures, SLA requirements, change management processes, and support standards.
  
Prepare and review RCA, incident reports, operational reports, and other support documentation.
  
Identify operational gaps and drive improvements in support processes, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.
  
Mentor and guide junior team members and help build technical capability within the support team.
  
Coordinate knowledge transfer and ensure proper documentation of critical systems and operational procedures.
  
Work closely with management to identify resource requirements, operational risks, and support priorities.
  
Leadership & Client Management
  
Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for MQ operations and production support.
  
Lead technical discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.
  
Effectively manage communication during high-priority and critical incidents.
  
Coordinate multiple teams simultaneously to drive issues toward closure.
  
Ensure clear assignment of actions, ownership, and timelines during incident and technical calls.
  
Escalate issues appropriately and ensure timely involvement of L2/L3 teams when required.
  
Follow up with respective teams until the issue is completely resolved and validated.

Build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, and internal technical teams.

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
**Contract Type:**
 Full Time; Permanent
  
**Location:**
 Noida, India
  
  
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Application Support Specialist is responsible for providing support for Study Group applications and addressing end-user requests under the guidance of the Application Support Manager. The position involves responding to support tickets raised through the Service Desk, diagnosing and troubleshooting application-related issues, and delivering timely resolutions. The role also supports the creation and maintenance of user guides, support materials, and process documentation to ensure effective service delivery and continuous improvement.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Application Support**

* Provide end-user support for all Study Group applications, and act as a point of contact and response for end-user issues
* The tasks contained within this responsibility revolve around the use of a service desk system to prioritise and respond to issues, perform troubleshooting, provide support, and escalate issues when required
* The described functions of the responsibility should be undertaken constantly and with a high priority. Response and resolution times are defined as SLAs and should be adhered to

**Learning Systems Administration**

* To ensure end-users have consistent access and functionality across all learning systems, constant administration and monitoring is required. The monitoring of learning systems and infrastructure upon which they reside forms a core part of this responsibility
* The administration component requires careful management of permissions and configuration changes while adhering to change control policies. Monitoring is undertaken using a variety of automatic and manual procedures via both hardware and software

**Incident and Change Management**

* Assistance with IT critical incident communication
* Communicate fully and effectively with colleagues throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring that staff are updated at all stages of the incident
* Assist with managing business communication regarding software change, downtime and upgrades

**Development and Knowledge**

* Build specialist knowledge of Study Group’s applications
* Document and share knowledge and best practise with other IT staff
* Identify trends in application supports and recommend remedial action to address the trending topics and areas, continually improving the user experience and increasing the efficiency of the app support function
* Knowledge sharing within the team and collaborate with other teams to build skills and understanding across new projects and solutions developed

**Audit Compliance**

* Working with the Application Support Manager (or similar), coordinate and assist with regularly scheduled audit activities, including privileged user access review, and access appropriateness review

**Governance**

* Compliance to all relevant data protection, financial, taxation and legal requirements
* Compliance to all relevant education sector requirements
* Compliance to all Study Group policies and procedures
* Champion Study Group’s Corporate Social Responsibility and in particular Building Futures
* Comply with all IT policies and procedures

**ABOUT YOU**

* A Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field is essential; additional diploma-level qualifications and relevant experience are desirable
* Experience in application support
* Experience using service desk tools and processes
* At least 2 years’ experience in the IT industry in a similar/equivalent role
* Experience gathering and presenting detailed information
* Excellent communication, customer service and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
* Experiencing in dealing with customers/end users
* Moodle or equivalent LMS experience would be advantageous
* Salesforce or equivalent CRM experience would be advantageous

**ABOUT US**
Study Group is a leading international education provider that is dedicated and passionate about helping students around the world, creating a brighter future and reaching their full potential. With university partnerships and a variety of face-to-face, online, and hybrid study programmes, we can provide students with the resources and guidance they need to succeed. Our global network of offices and university partnerships ensure that students receive the best educational services available. Additionally, our Insendi platform enables us to deliver innovative, accessible, and intuitive digital learning experiences with the most advanced digital tools available.
  
  

**ORGANISATIONAL COMPLIANCE**
Study Group is proud of its high standards in safeguarding and recognises its importance in enabling the best possible student experience and outcomes. For successful applicants the following checks will be conducted- Criminal Background Check (country specific), x2 References, ID and Right to Work checks as well as Education Verification.
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other factor. We believe that the best person for the job should be selected based on skills and experience alone. Your information will be kept confidential and stored securely. Please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Linux System administator
description:
**Req ID:**
389320
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Linux System administator to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Educational Qualification: Must be a graduate (B. Tech/B.E./B.Sc./MCA or equivalent).
* Experience: 3 to 7 years of experience as a Linux/Unix System Administrator in enterprise environments.
* Core Linux Skills:

+ Strong understanding of Linux OS (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Ubuntu, SUSE).
+ Ability to handle day-to-day administration tasks including user management, file systems, process management, performance tuning, and log analysis.
+ Experience with system hardening and security best practices.

* Patching & Lifecycle Management:

+ Hands-on experience with Linux OS patching, vulnerability remediation, and compliance (e.g., using tools like YUM/DNF, Spacewalk, Satellite, Landscape, or similar).
+ Awareness of security benchmarks (CIS, STIG) is desirable.

* Automation & Scripting:

+ Proficiency in shell scripting (Bash) is required.
+ Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible / Puppet / Chef is highly desirable.
+ Basic knowledge of Python scripting is a plus.

* Cloud & Virtualization:

+ Basic working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) and Linux workloads in cloud environments.
+ Understanding of virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V).

* Containers & DevOps Exposure:

+ Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Podman) and basic understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift.
+ Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is an added advantage.

* Monitoring & Observability:

+ Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar.
+ Ability to analyze system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively.

* Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

+ Strong troubleshooting skills to resolve system outages, performance issues, and incidents within SLA.
+ Experience in handling production incidents and root cause analysis (RCA).

* Installation & Upgrades:

+ Hands-on experience in Linux system installation, configuration, and upgrades.

* UNIX Variants (Optional):

+ Knowledge of other UNIX flavors like AIX, Solaris, HP-UX is an added advantage.

* ITSM & Process Compliance:

+ Well-versed with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Requests).
+ Experience with ticketing tools like ServiceNow, Remedy, JIRA Service Management.

* Certifications:

+ RHCE / RHCSA / LFCS / Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure) preferred.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
+ Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.
+ Quick learner with adaptability to new tools and technologies.
+ Positive attitude, ownership mindset, and customer-focused approach.

**Years of Experience:**

* 3 to 7 Years

**Work Timings:**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts with a 24x7 support model, including on-call support.

title: MS Specialist OSS
description:
**Job Description**
The OSS L2 Engineer acts as the second-level support for Operations Support Systems (OSS) servers including MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS,ZTS,NCP and NCOM. This role involves deeper technical troubleshooting, complex incident management, system administration, and coordination with L3 teams and vendors to ensure network performance, stability, and service continuity.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex incidents related to OSS servers (MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS, ZTS).
* Handle escalations from L1 and ensure end-to-end incident closure according to SLA.
* Manage and administer OSS server environments including configuration, patching, upgrades, and performance tuning.
* Monitor system health, alarms, logs, and automate routine operational tasks for efficiency.
* Collaborate with L3 support teams, vendors, and cross-functional teams for problem resolution and service improvements.
* Maintain documentation including incident records, change management logs, and operational procedures.
* Execute backup, disaster recovery, and failover procedures ensuring data integrity and availability.
* Support integration, commissioning, and administration of OSS network elements and tools.
* Support ITIL-based processes including incident, problem, change, and configuration management.
* Create and update service requests, change requests, and maintain ticketing system accuracy.
* Assist in automation and scripting tasks (Shell, Python, Ansible) to enhance operational efficiency
* Provide L2 support and administration for OpenShift environments, including cluster monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must-have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* Typically, 7-10 years of experience in OSS operations or telecom network support.
* Strong knowledge of OSS systems in telecom, especially MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS, NCOM, NCP and ZTS platforms.
* Proficient in Linux OS (CentOS, RHEL, etc.) administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience in server and network monitoring tools, fault management, and alarm handling.
* Good scripting skills in Shell, Python or similar automation tools
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenShift and Kubernetes environments.

Nice-to-have:
  
  

* Relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* RHCSA and OpenShift/Kubernetes Certificate will be added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Good communication skills for clear interaction with technical teams and stakeholders.
* Experience with ticketing systems, ITIL processes, and incident management workflows.
* Ability to work in shifts and handle critical escalations under pressure.

* Demonstrated experience in operational support, incident management, and problem-solving within an IAM context.

description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
Cloud Automation Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ Years
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly skilled
**Cloud Automation Engineer**
with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
* Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
* Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
* Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
* Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
* Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
* Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
* Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
* Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
* Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
* Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
* Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Microsoft Azure
* Terraform
* Azure Bicep
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
* Azure Virtual Machines
* Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
* CI/CD & Deployment Automation
* Cloud Cost Optimization
* Monitoring & Operations

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  
  
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
  
  
You’ll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI.

* Configure and support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard and Premium capabilities.

* Troubleshoot Microsoft Purview policy behavior, configuration issues, service limitations, and integration-related problems.

* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into appropriate Microsoft Purview technical controls.
* Maintain operational documentation, high-level designs, low-level designs, standard operating procedures, implementation standards, support runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Provide L3 technical support and subject matter expertise for Microsoft Purview-related incidents, service requests, changes, and projects.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to operational and support teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Compliance, Information Protection, Data Governance, or related technologies.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing or administering Microsoft Purview solutions.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto-labeling, and data classification.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention policies across Microsoft 365 workloads and managed endpoints.

* Experience in incident management, change management, service request fulfilment, root-cause analysis, and technical problem resolution.

* Experience producing technical designs, governance standards, operational reports, SOPs, runbooks, and audit evidence.

title: Senior Storage Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
Most storage jobs are console administration: provision a LUN, hand it over, close the ticket. This one is not. We build, own and operate our own private cloud on our own hardware, and storage runs the whole way from the enterprise arrays through Ceph to the persistent volume a container actually mounts. You would own that path end to end, and you would own the thing most organisations only claim to have, which is a restore that has been proven rather than assumed.
  
  
What you would own
  
  

* Kubernetes-native storage. Rook and Ceph, the CSI layer, StorageClasses, and how a persistent volume claim becomes real capacity. This is the centre of the role, not an adjunct to it.
* Provable backup and restore. Not just that backups ran, but that a restore has been performed, timed and witnessed. You would own the evidence, and the schedule that keeps it current.
* The enterprise arrays. Pure Storage and NetApp, including snapshots, replication, provisioning, capacity planning and performance work.
* Disaster recovery. Designing the tests, running them, and fixing what they expose. RPO and RTO you can defend with a number rather than an intention.
* The storage standard. Documentation, monitoring, alerting on failure rather than on absence of success, and the capacity roadmap.

What the first year looks like
  
  

* Establish provable backup and restore across every tenant and platform system, with independently witnessed evidence. This is a stated company priority, and it would be yours.
* Bring Ceph and the Kubernetes storage layer under the same operational standard as the arrays.
* Run at least one full DR exercise end to end and close what it uncovers.
* Remove the single points of knowledge, so no part of the storage estate depends on one person being reachable.

What we need you to have done
  
  
**Two Hard Requirements For This Role.**

* Kubernetes storage, hands-on in production. Rook and Ceph, or a CSI driver you have operated. You should be able to explain what happens between a persistent volume claim and real capacity, and describe a time it did not work and how you found out why. Provisioning storage and handing it to a Kubernetes team does not meet this bar.
* Restores you have personally performed. Not backup jobs you monitored. An actual restore, that you ran, recently, and can tell us how long it took and what came back. A backup nobody has restored is not a backup, and this is the first thing we will ask about.
* Hands-on Kubernetes storage in production. Rook and Ceph, or an equivalent CSI-based platform. Persistent volumes, StorageClasses, and the boundary between cluster storage and physical capacity.
* 8+ years in storage and data protection, across both enterprise arrays and software-defined storage.
* Real protocol depth, not product familiarity. iSCSI, NVMe over Fabrics, Fibre Channel, NFS and SMB. You should be able to explain what each one does and when you would choose it, independently of any vendor's console.
* Backup and restore ownership using Commvault or equivalent, including retention, compliance, and how a failure reaches a human.
* Pure Storage and NetApp, including snapshots and replication such as SnapMirror or FlashArray features.
* Disaster recovery you have designed or led, including the testing, not only participated in.
* Backup and storage for virtualized environments, VMware in our case.
* Performance troubleshooting: the ability to prove whether a problem is the storage, the host or the network, rather than assert that it is not yours.
* Scripting or automation for provisioning, reporting and restore verification.
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

How the team works
  
  

* You would join the IT Infrastructure team and work directly with platform engineering, the database organisation, security and the OEM vendors.
* On-call is a shared rotation, not a permanent state. Major incidents escalate to the whole team, and we would rather fix the cause than staff the symptom.
* We expect ownership rather than ticket-taking. If you find something broken outside your area, we would rather you said so than routed it.
* This role is a step toward storage and data platform architecture ownership as the Noida centre grows.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
  
  
**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
  
  
With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Lead Staff Engineer - IT
description:
**R1 RCM India is proud to be recognized amongst India's Top 50 Best Companies to Work For™ 2023 by Great Place To Work® Institute.
