**Role Summary**
The
**Senior Application Packaging Engineer**
is responsible for the end-to-end enterprise application package lifecycle across
**Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM)**
. The role covers request assessment, source validation, packaging and repackaging, automation, technical testing, UAT support, controlled release, version management, production troubleshooting, upgrade, rollback, and package retirement.
  
  
The engineer must combine strong hands-on skills in
**MSI, MST, MSIX, Win32 packaging, PowerShell, and PSAppDeployToolkit**
with disciplined enterprise release practices. The role supports modern Intune-first delivery while retaining SCCM/MECM capability for existing, imaging, and exception-based deployment workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage packaging requests from intake through closure, validating the business owner, technical contact, application source, vendor, version, license needs, target users/devices, operating-system support, deployment channel, testing requirements, and UAT expectations.
* Analyze vendor MSI, EXE, MSIX, APPX, scripts, prerequisites, services, drivers, registry entries, files, shortcuts, scheduled tasks, certificates, runtimes, user context, and application dependencies.
* Create, repackage, customize, and troubleshoot MSI packages, MST transforms, MSIX/APPX packages, and Intune Win32 packages in accordance with enterprise packaging standards.
* Develop standardized install, uninstall, upgrade, repair, detection, and remediation logic using PowerShell and PSAppDeployToolkit or an approved equivalent framework.
* Create and maintain applications in Microsoft Intune, including metadata, publisher and version details, install/uninstall commands, requirement rules, detection rules, dependencies, return codes, assignments, supersedence, and Company Portal availability.
* Create and maintain applications and packages in SCCM/MECM, including deployment types, detection methods, requirements, global conditions, dependencies, collections, content distribution, Software Center publishing, and deployment monitoring.
* Migrate suitable SCCM applications to Intune by validating current source content and commands, creating the .intunewin package, rebuilding detection and requirement logic, and confirming deployment behavior before transition.
* Support applications used in Autopilot and imaging workflows, including base/day-0 applications, post-login provisioning, task-sequence dependencies, and application readiness across supported Windows builds.
* Perform packaging and quality testing in clean virtual machines and managed test devices across SYSTEM and user contexts, including install, uninstall, upgrade, repair, rollback, reboot, application launch, file association, and dependency scenarios.
* Prepare test evidence, release notes, known issues, support information, and rollback instructions; coordinate UAT and resolve defects before production release.
* Release applications through controlled pilot and deployment rings, follow change-management requirements, monitor deployment results, and validate production readiness before broad assignment.
* Troubleshoot failures using verbose MSI logs, Intune Management Extension logs, SCCM client logs, Windows Event Viewer, ProcMon, registry/file analysis, and endpoint telemetry.
* Improve package diagnostics by producing actionable exit codes, status output, and logging that help Endpoint Operations and Service Desk distinguish download, prerequisite, pending-reboot, installer-busy, detection, and installation failures.
* Manage package versions and lifecycle state, including source preservation, naming consistency, version increments, supersedence, pilot/current/retired status, rollback readiness, and timely removal of obsolete packages and assignments.
* Maintain approved source files, packaging scripts, documentation, release artifacts, signed binaries where applicable, and integrity information in enterprise repositories with traceability between reviewed source and released package.
* Support application retirement and restricted-delivery scenarios by removing obsolete Company Portal or Software Center availability, retiring assignments, preserving auditable records, and enabling request-and-approval-based delivery when required.
* Collaborate with Security, IT Risk, Endpoint Operations, Service Desk, application owners, vendors, and change approvers to resolve packaging, compatibility, vulnerability, licensing, deployment, and support concerns.

**Enterprise Packaging & Release Lifecycle Ownership**

* Intake and assessment: review request completeness, source authenticity, business need, ownership, compatibility, licensing, support model, risk, and packaging complexity.
* Build and automate create a silent, repeatable, idempotent package with reliable installation, uninstallation, detection, upgrade, and logging behavior.
* Validate: complete technical QA on clean systems, supported Windows versions, and relevant endpoint scenarios before UAT.
* Pilot and approve: support UAT, pilot groups, change records, security validation, and release readiness decisions.
* Release and monitor: deploy through Intune or SCCM/MECM, monitor installation status and endpoint logs, and address failures before wider rollout.
* Version and maintain: introduce new revisions using consistent naming and version metadata, configure supersedence or replacement, preserve rollback capability, and keep documentation current.
* Retire: remove obsolete assignments and self-service availability, confirm the replacement or approved request path, and archive the package record.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in enterprise Windows application packaging, repackaging, deployment, and lifecycle maintenance.
* Proven expertise with Windows Installer technology, MSI tables, MST transforms, custom actions, merge modules, product codes, upgrade codes, ICE validation, repair behavior, and installation contexts.
* Strong experience creating Intune Win32 applications (.intunewin) with robust, version-aware detection rules, requirements, dependencies, supersedence, assignments, and Company Portal configuration.
* Hands-on experience creating and managing SCCM/MECM applications and packages, deployment types, global conditions, collections, content distribution, Software Center releases, and client-side troubleshooting.
* Advanced PowerShell skills for installer automation, prechecks, post-install validation, registry/file operations, process handling, reboot control, logging, exit-code normalization, and remediation.
* Hands-on knowledge of PSAppDeployToolkit, AdminStudio, InstallShield, Advanced Installer Experience packaging EXE-based vendor installers into silent and supportable enterprise deployments.
* Strong understanding of application prerequisites and dependencies, including .NET, Visual C++ runtimes, certificates, services, drivers, scheduled tasks, environment variables, and file-system/registry redirection.
* Experience with clean-VM testing, UAT coordination, pilot releases, phased deployment, rollback, change management, and production validation.
* Ability to troubleshoot application delivery issues involving download, content distribution, network interruption, installer contention, pending reboots, requirement/detection logic, and application compatibility.
* Strong technical documentation skills covering package configuration, source and version details, install/uninstall commands, detection logic, test evidence, release notes, known issues, support procedures, and retirement history.

**Knowledge / Exposure (Good to Have)**

* Git-based source control, release branches/tags, pull-request review, CI/CD build validation, artifact checksums, code signing, and package integrity practices.
* Microsoft Graph API automation for Intune application creation, upload, assignment, reporting, and lifecycle management.
* Autopilot, Enrollment Status Page behavior, SCCM task sequences, Windows imaging, and post-login provisioning workflows.
* Nexthink Remote Actions or similar endpoint automation platforms for package deployment, upgrade, removal, validation, and telemetry.
* Application control, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, security review, and enterprise software governance.
* Microsoft Store, winget, LOB, MSIX/AppX, and controlled servicing models for applications that cannot rely on store-based updates.
* Automation-assisted packaging that can generate detection logic, documentation, release notes, test plans, validation, rollback, and compliance evidence.

**Key Success Measures**

* Packages install, upgrade, repair, and uninstall silently and consistently across supported endpoint scenarios.
* Detection and requirement logic is accurate, version-aware, and avoids false success or repeated installation.
* Releases are traceable from approved source and version through testing, change, pilot, production assignment, and retirement.
* Deployment failures provide sufficient logs and status information for rapid diagnosis and support handoff.
* Current packages remain maintainable, while obsolete versions and assignments are retired without leaving duplicate or conflicting deployments.

**Why Join This Role**

* Own the complete enterprise application packaging and release lifecycle across Intune and SCCM/MECM.
* Work across modern application delivery, automation, Autopilot readiness, security governance, deployment quality, and operational support.
* Help standardize and automate how enterprise applications are packaged, versioned, released, monitored, updated, and retired.

Key Skills

* Strong follow-up, stakeholder coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint.

Qualification & Experience

A proactive, detail-oriented HR professional with a strong recruitment background and the willingness to build broader HR expertise. The candidate should be comfortable with coordination, documentation and employee interaction.

Talent Acquisition (target: 2 offer rollouts per month): 60%

Policy & SOP Management, Employee Engagement & Festivities, Orientation & Onboarding : 40 %

description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a skilled Data Consultant with 3-5 years of experience in building and developed enterprise-grade applications. You will work within the Digital Solutions team to build scalable, secure, and high performing business applications used across major global infrastructure and environmental projects.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to support the ongoing development of digital solutions for our client’s, unlocking solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. This includes the delivery of future net zero, renewable energy, transport and water infrastructure solutions in the UK and globally. The role is a blend of development, operations & system administration to assist in expanding the deployment of our templated solutions.

* 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Python and SQL, with strong expertise in data modeling, query optimization, and developing scalable data solutions.

* Strong expertise in SQL Server database design, relational data modeling, schema architecture, query optimization, and efficient management of large-scale datasets.

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with the ability to translate business requirements into efficient data and AI-driven solutions.
* Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps, and modern software development practices, including version control, CI/CD, and application lifecycle management.
* Good understanding of Power BI integration with Python, SQL Server, APIs, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse to deliver intelligent and scalable business solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise data governance, security, deployment pipelines, row-level security (RLS), workspace management, and data refresh strategies.
* Ability to leverage Generative AI, Python, and SQL to automate business processes, enhance productivity, and develop innovative data-driven solutions.
* Skilled in extracting, transforming, modeling, and analyzing complex datasets using Python, SQL Server, and AI technologies, enabling continuous process improvement and advanced analytics.

**Qualifications**
**Education / Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field (or equivalent experience)
* With at least 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Power BI Platform Technology.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
**Department:**
Sales & Business Development
  
  
**Experience:**
5–10 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, and Haryana)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Frequent field travel across Delhi NCR and Haryana, with occasional pan-India travel
  
  
**About The Company**
Our client operates in the recycling and resource recovery sector, focusing on responsible e-waste management, recycling solutions, and environmental sustainability. The organization works with businesses to support responsible electronic waste disposal, resource recovery, and applicable Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance requirements.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and confident
**Senior Key Account Manager**
to manage corporate client relationships, develop strategic accounts, and identify new business opportunities.
  
  
This is a senior, field-based role requiring regular face-to-face meetings with corporate clients, business partners, and key decision-makers. The selected candidate will be responsible for strengthening existing relationships, acquiring new accounts, negotiating commercial terms, and driving business growth.
  
  
The candidate must be comfortable representing the organization in person and travelling extensively across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, and Haryana, with occasional pan-India travel.
  
  
Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to telecalling, inside sales, or virtual client management will not be suitable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Key Account Management
* Manage and strengthen relationships with existing corporate clients and strategic accounts.
* Conduct regular face-to-face meetings to understand client requirements and identify business opportunities.
* Build long-term partnerships with corporate stakeholders, procurement teams, sustainability professionals, and senior decision-makers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts.
* Ensure client satisfaction through proactive engagement, timely follow-ups, and effective issue resolution.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts and increase revenue.
* Client Visits and Field Engagement
* Conduct frequent in-person client meetings across Delhi NCR and Haryana.
* Independently plan and execute client visits, business discussions, presentations, and follow-up meetings.
* Represent the organization professionally during client interactions and commercial discussions.
* Travel to other cities across India when required for important client meetings and business development.
* Develop strong business relationships through direct, face-to-face engagement.
* Business Development and New Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop new business opportunities among corporates, manufacturers, electronics producers, importers, institutions, and other relevant organizations.
* Generate leads, qualify prospects, arrange meetings, and convert potential clients into active accounts.
* Promote e-waste recycling, resource recovery, EPR compliance, and sustainability solutions.
* Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients.
* Explore new markets, industries, and corporate partnerships.
* Achieve agreed business development, client acquisition, and revenue targets.
* Sales Presentations and Commercial Negotiations
* Conduct client presentations and explain the organization's services and solutions.
* Understand client requirements and propose suitable commercial and operational solutions.
* Prepare and discuss proposals, quotations, pricing, and commercial terms in coordination with internal teams.
* Lead commercial negotiations and work toward mutually beneficial agreements.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from initial engagement and client meetings to negotiation and account development.
* Industry and Market Development
* Develop an understanding of the e-waste recycling, waste management, environmental services, and EPR compliance markets.
* Identify corporate clients and industry segments that could benefit from the organization's services.
* Monitor market developments, competitor activities, and emerging business opportunities.
* Build professional networks with corporate organizations, industry stakeholders, and business partners.
* Internal Coordination and Account Reporting
* Coordinate with operations, logistics, recycling, and compliance teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Follow up on client requirements, collection arrangements, documentation, and service-related concerns.
* Maintain accurate records of client meetings, sales opportunities, proposals, and account activities.
* Prepare regular reports on client engagement, account performance, business development progress, and sales pipeline.
* Ensure timely communication between clients and internal teams throughout the account lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in key account management, corporate sales, B2B sales, enterprise relationship management, or business development.
* Proven experience managing corporate clients and conducting face-to-face business meetings.
* Strong experience in client relationship management, commercial negotiations, and account development.
* Ability to independently manage client meetings, develop business opportunities, and build relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and a results-oriented approach.
* Willingness to undertake frequent regional travel and occasional pan-India travel.
* Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools, and client reporting.

**Preferred Industry Background**
Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:
  
  

* E-waste recycling and electronic waste management.
* Waste management and recycling services.
* Environmental services and sustainability solutions.
* Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance.
* Reverse logistics and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD).
* Electronics manufacturing and related B2B services.
* Industrial sales, enterprise sales, and corporate service solutions.

Direct experience in recycling or EPR-related services will be an advantage. Candidates with strong corporate B2B sales and key account management experience in related industries may also be considered.
  
  
**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Based in Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, or Haryana.
* Confident and articulate, with strong face-to-face communication skills.
* Experienced in managing corporate accounts and interacting with senior-level decision-makers.
* Comfortable with frequent client visits, fieldwork, and extensive travel.
* Capable of independently planning client meetings, managing accounts, and developing new business.
* Professional in conduct, relationship-oriented, commercially aware, and proactive.
* Able to represent the organization effectively in client meetings and negotiations.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager – Civil (Hydropower)
description:
We are looking for a high-performing
**Manager / Sr. Manager – Civil**
to join our team at our Corporate Office in Noida.
  
  
  

In this role, you will be key to managing and assessing hydropower projects. While based at headquarters, you will conduct periodic visits to active hydroelectric power project sites during their execution and production phases. You will oversee civil execution, evaluate project feasibility, ensure design standards, and manage contractor performance on-site.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

**1. On-Site Inspection & Execution Oversight**

* Travel to operational and construction project sites as required to inspect ongoing progress, quality, and safety.
* Oversee site execution for key civil structures including Dams, Weirs/Barrages, Intakes, Desilting Basins, Pressure Shafts, and Powerhouses.
* Supervise underground works such as tunneling, rock bolting, shotcreting, rib installation, and vertical shaft lining.
* Maintain pour cards, conduct joint measurements, verify BOQ, and review/approve contractor progress bills.

**2.**
**Corporate Project**
**Management & Monitoring**

* Track daily project milestones, review Daily Progress Reports (DPR), and prepare Management Information Systems (MIS) reports for executive leadership.
* Verify that site activities strictly align with project timelines, construction methodologies, and safety guidelines.
* Manage contract documentation, scope variations, and vendor relationships.

**3. Feasibility & Engineering Review**

* Evaluate upcoming hydropower opportunities regarding hydrology, power potential, and overall cost estimation.
* Review and interpret detailed structural engineering drawings and site survey procedures.

Requirements
  
  
  

* **Education:**
  B.Tech / B.E. or M.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* **Core Experience:**
  12 to 18 years of strong experience in the Hydropower sector (Consultancy, EPC Contracting, or Project Execution).
* **Technical Skills:**
  Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel, survey instruments, and reading complex civil drawings.
* **Domain Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of hydrology, tunneling, rock excavation, and heavy civil construction sequences.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to travel to power project sites on a need basis (all travel, lodging, and site accommodation expenses fully covered by the company).
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Benefits
  
  

* Competitive package.
* Fully paid company accommodation and travel allowances for all site deployments/visits.
* Opportunity to lead critical infrastructure projects in a growing hydro power organization.

title: Travel Accounts Executive
description:
**Job Title:**

Travel Accounts Executive

**Department:**

Accounts & Finance

**Industry:**

Travel & Tourism

**Experience:**

1–2 years (preferred)

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organised Travel Accounts Executive to manage the company’s financial records, accounting operations, cash flow, and taxation-related activities. The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of Tally, financial statements, ledger management, and coordination with Chartered Accountants (CAs), along with an understanding of taxation policies applicable to the travel industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Statements & Balance Sheet**

* Assist in preparing and maintaining balance sheets and other financial statements.
* Ensure accurate recording of assets, liabilities, income, and expenses.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.

**2. Ledgers & Accounts Management**

* Maintain general ledgers, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
* Track accounts payable and receivable, including payments to vendors, hotels, airlines, and other travel partners.
* Verify invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting financial documents.
* Ensure accurate and timely bookkeeping of all financial transactions.

**3. Cash Flow Management**

* Maintain daily cash flow records, including all cash inflows and outflows.
* Monitor incoming client payments, vendor payments, refunds, and operational expenses.
* Reconcile bank statements and cash balances regularly.
* Prepare cash flow reports to support financial planning and liquidity management.

**4. Tally & Accounting Software**

* Maintain accounting records and enter financial transactions using Tally.
* Manage purchase and sales entries, payment and receipt vouchers, journal entries, and bank reconciliations.
* Generate financial reports and ensure that accounting records are accurate and up to date.

**5. Coordination with Chartered Accountant (CA)**

* Coordinate with the company’s CA for accounting, audit, and compliance-related requirements.
* Provide financial statements, invoices, bank statements, and other supporting documents as required.
* Assist in preparing records for statutory audits, tax filings, and financial reviews.
* Ensure timely submission of accounting data and compliance documentation.

**6. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Assist with taxation and statutory compliance in accordance with prevailing Indian tax laws and applicable policies.
* Maintain records required for GST, TDS, and other applicable tax obligations.
* Assist in preparing tax-related reports, reconciliations, and documentation for timely filing.
* Stay updated on relevant changes in taxation rules and accounting compliance requirements, in coordination with the CA.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* Practical knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, and financial statements.
* Working knowledge of Tally or Tally Prime.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, and applicable taxation requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic financial reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organisational skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and meet financial reporting deadlines.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in accounts or finance, preferably in the travel and tourism industry.
* Familiarity with travel-related transactions, vendor settlements, customer collections, refunds, and advance payments.
* Experience coordinating with CAs and supporting audit and tax compliance activities.

**Key Expectations**

* Accurate and timely maintenance of financial records.
* Regular monitoring of cash flow and outstanding payments.
* Timely reconciliation of ledgers, bank accounts, and vendor accounts.
* Proper documentation and readiness for audits and tax filings.
* Adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies.

This hire will resolve customer service requests (CSRs), troubleshoot complex virtualized infrastructure and container issues, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and maintain high network availability.
  
  
**What you will do:**
To investigate, troubleshoot, deliver remedy & restorations, and produce solutions to customer support tickets, CSRs (Customer Service Requests).
  
  
To work within well-defined system support guidelines.
  
  
To participate in software upgrades and updates.
  
  
Should be able to use support tools for ticket handling.
  
  
To ensure customer satisfaction with the performance of installed systems by successfully handling all reported technical problems.
  
  
Provide regular progress updates in the support system for each assigned support issue.
  
  
Through contact with external customers and internal support functions, gather data and information about any specific problem that has been reported.
  
  
Actively engage in communication with other engineers for the purpose of knowledge sharing etc.
  
  
Escalation of support tickets to next level of competence units if the CSR cannot be answered/solved within the time limit.
  
  
Evaluation of answers and solutions received from higher competence units to verify that the answer/solution will clear the problem reported by the customer.
  
  
In the line of supporting our products, identify possible improvements that make them more maintainable and user-friendly. Document these as Requirement Specifications as input to the design of new generations of the products.
  
  
Registration of new known solutions and updating of existing known solutions based on answers/solutions developed within own line organization or received from elsewhere.
  
  
Providing suggestions in developing Operation & Maintenance instructions.
  
  
Isolate product faults and raise them to Product Design. Support design unit to reproduce the fault and evaluate the final fix provided.
  
  
May need to work in shifts and Emergency Support rota.
  
  
To lead and execute the implementation of new software releases on test labs.
  
  
Writing documents for fault analysis/RCA along with required preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Strong analytical skills.
  
  
24×7 availability as per support guidelines.
  
  
**The skills you bring :**
Relevant experience of 2-8 years .
  
  
Deep knowledge of Linux (SUSE/SLES, Red Hat/RHEL or Ubuntu) including extensive hands-on administration and troubleshooting (systemd, journald, networking, storage, performance).
  
  
Virtualization technologies (KVM/QEMU, libvirt).
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash/Shell).
  
  
OpenStack knowledge and hands-on experience, OpenStack distribution (core services: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Heat).
  
  
Understanding of NFV/NFVI architecture and ETSI MANO concepts; VNF/CNF onboarding and VIM integration (e.g. with orchestrators such as EVNFM).
  
  
High-availability clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing and virtual IP management (HAProxy, keepalived/VRRP).
  
  
Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting (control plane, kubelet, scheduling, RBAC, workloads) with hands-on operational experience.
  
  
Container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and image/registry handling.
  
  
Cluster lifecycle management on bare metal using Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3, and cluster lifecycle tooling (e.g. ccdadm).
  
  
etcd operation, backup/restore and recovery fundamentals.
  
  
Kubernetes networking (Calico/CNI, Multus, kube-proxy) and policy enforcement (e.g. Kyverno).
  
  
Solid IP networking fundamentals (L2/L3, routing, VLANs, static routes, MTU, TLS/PKI troubleshooting).
  
  
Virtual machine and container internetworking concepts.
  
  
Open vSwitch (OVS) and OVS-DPDK.
  
  
SR-IOV functionality and DPDK-based high-performance networking.
  
  
Host network configuration tooling (NetworkManager/nmstate).
  
  
CEE: software-defined and cloud storage – OpenStack Cinder, Ceph, Nexenta, Dell Powerflex.
  
  
ECCD: Ceph and NetApp (CNIS deployments); ScaleIO/PowerFlex and Nexenta (NFVI-based deployments).
  
  
General block/object/file storage concepts.
  
  
Configuration management and automation (Ansible).
  
  
Orchestration templating (Heat/TOSCA).
  
  
Monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana; log aggregation such as Fluentd/Fluent Bit).

title: Lead Generation Marketer (B2B, AI-first)
description:
**About GoodSpace AI**

GoodSpace AI is an AI-powered hiring platform. It helps companies find verified, high-quality talent fast, using AI interviews, peer-vouched Goodness Scores and smart matching. We're a lean team that uses AI in everything we do, and we want someone who works the same way.

**The role**

You'll be the senior owner of the lead pipeline for hirers: founders, HR heads, TA teams and recruiters who need to hire. Today lead gen runs through interns and ad hoc campaigns; we need one person to own it and make it work. You'll keep good employer leads coming in and hand them to sales ready to close. You're measured on hirer leads, demos booked and revenue, not on how many posts you publish.

- Reports to the Head of Sales / Revenue.

- Solo contributor role: you own the channels end to end.

- You'll manage a paid media budget of ₹1–3 lakh a month across Google, LinkedIn and Meta.

**What you'll do**

Cold email and nurture (core of the role)

- Run cold email campaigns to founders, CHROs, HR heads and TA leads end to end: lists, copy, sequences, follow-ups.

- Build nurture flows for hirers who sign up, post a job or attend a demo but don't convert yet.

- Own deliverability: domain and inbox setup, warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, staying out of spam.

- Track open, reply and meeting rates; A/B test subject lines, copy and offers every week.

**Google Ads (core of the role)**

- Plan, launch and manage Search and Performance Max campaigns aimed at hirers looking for hiring solutions.

- Keyword research, ad groups, ad copy, negative keywords and bids.

- Conversion tracking with Google Ads, GA4 and Tag Manager, so every rupee can be traced to a lead.

- Watch cost per lead and return on spend weekly; move budget to what works.

**Also part of the job**

- SEO and AI search: hirer keywords, hiring guides, role-wise and comparison pages, on-page SEO, showing up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

- LinkedIn and Meta lead campaigns aimed at HR heads, recruiters and founders.

- LinkedIn outreach (Sales Navigator), hiring-signal prospecting, webinars and lead magnets, HR and founder communities, WhatsApp follow-ups for warm leads.

- Build target lists with Apollo, Clay, Sales Navigator; keep the CRM clean; agree with sales on what a good hirer lead is and report weekly on cost per lead by channel.

- Use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools daily for research, personalisation and copy. Automate anything you do more than twice.

**Must-haves**

- 2–5 years in B2B lead generation, growth or performance marketing (startup, SaaS, HR-tech, recruitment firm or agency).

- Hands-on cold email: you have run cold and nurture campaigns yourself (Smartlead, Instantly, Lemlist, Apollo, Brevo, HubSpot or similar), including deliverability setup.

- Hands-on Google Ads for leads: you have run Search and/or Performance Max campaigns yourself, with conversion tracking set up.

- You already use AI tools in your work and can show a real example: a workflow, prompt system or automation you built.

- Strong writing: a cold email or ad a busy HR head or founder actually answers.

- Comfortable with numbers: reply rate, CTR, CPC, cost per lead, ROAS.

- Based in Delhi NCR, able to work full-time from our Noida Sector 32 office, and able to join within 30 days.

**Nice-to-haves**

- Hands-on SEO that grew organic traffic and leads; ranking in AI search is a big plus.

- LinkedIn and Meta lead ads.

- Apollo, Clay or Sales Navigator list building and automation.

- LinkedIn outreach, webinars, partnerships or community-led lead gen.

- Marketing or selling to HR teams, recruiters or founders.

**Interview process**

- Two conversations, completed within one week. Final decision by a founder with the Head of Sales.

**Why join us**

- Use the latest AI tools freely. We'll pay for the ones that work.

- Direct impact on revenue, visible to leadership.

- A meaningful incentive on top of fixed pay - more than 30% of fixed at target.

- Fast growth in a small, ambitious team.

Apply in a minute: upload your CV and the form fills itself.

We are looking for a highly organized, tech-savvy and proactive
**Operations & Technology Intern**

This is a unique hybrid role combining
**executive support, startup operations and hands-on technology/product work**

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**Email Security Engineer – Job Description**
**Job Title**
**Email Security Engineer**
**Job Summary**
The Email Security Engineer is responsible for the administration, security, availability, monitoring, and operational management of enterprise email security platforms. This role ensures the protection of corporate email systems against phishing, malware, spam, business email compromise (BEC), spoofing, and other email-based threats while maintaining platform stability and service availability.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with Account Security Team, NTT Operations Teams, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues, implement security controls, enforce security policies, and provide operational and security reporting. The role also supports continuous improvement of email security capabilities, threat protection, and service reliability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Email Security Platform Management**

* Administer and maintain enterprise email security platforms and services.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and operational health of email security infrastructure.
* Monitor email security gateways, cloud email security solutions, and supporting systems.
* Manage platform configurations, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle activities.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational optimization.

**Platform Availability & Operational Management**

* Monitor platform availability and service health to ensure compliance with agreed SLAs.
* Investigate service outages, mail flow issues, delivery delays, and system performance concerns.
* Coordinate incident resolution activities across multiple operational teams.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity processes related to email security platforms.
* Maintain operational runbooks and standard operating procedures.

**Email Threat Protection & Security Operations**

* Monitor and respond to:

+ Phishing attacks
+ Business Email Compromise (BEC)
+ Malware campaigns
+ Spoofing attempts
+ Email-borne threats

* Investigate email security incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
* Support implementation of:

+ SPF
+ DKIM
+ DMARC
+ Anti-phishing controls
+ Email encryption controls

* Analyze email security trends and recommend improvements.

**OEM Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM vendors to resolve product defects, technical issues, software bugs, and platform-related security concerns.
* Manage vendor escalations for critical incidents and service disruptions.
* Review vendor advisories, product updates, and security bulletins.

* Track vendor action plans and remediation timelines.

**Security Policy Enforcement**

* Enforce security policies, standards, and controls as requested by the Account Security Team.
* Implement email security controls in alignment with organizational security requirements.
* Ensure compliance with approved security baselines and governance requirements.
* Support security exception reviews and risk mitigation activities.
* Validate policy compliance across email security environments.

* Generate security and operational reports mutually agreed with the Account Team.
* Develop dashboards and metrics related to:

+ Email threat activity
+ Phishing detection rates
+ Malware detection statistics
+ Platform availability
+ SLA performance
+ Incident response metrics
+ Mail flow performance

* Present operational and security posture reports to stakeholders.

* Identify opportunities to improve email security controls and operational efficiency.
* Support automation initiatives for email threat investigation and response.

* Recommend enhancements to platform resilience and monitoring.
* Contribute to Email Security Program maturity initiatives.

Experience with one or more:
  
  

* Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Microsoft Exchange Online Protection (EOP)
* Proofpoint
* Mimecast
* Cisco Secure Email
* Barracuda Email Security Gateway
* Google Workspace Security

Strong knowledge of:
  
  

* SPF
* DKIM

* SMTP
* Email routing and mail flow

**Security Operations**

* Phishing investigation
* Malware analysis
* Threat detection
* Incident response
* Security monitoring
* Email threat hunting

* Microsoft 365

* Google Workspace
* Hybrid Email Environments

**Security Certifications**

* Review and implement email security policy updates.

* Track remediation activities and service restoration efforts.

**Interview Questions for This Role**

description:
**Job Description**
WSP is currently seeking an Principal Engineer – Pedestrian Modelling to join our Rail and Transit Division in Bengaluru, with 8 to 14 years of experience in developing, calibrating and analysing pedestrian and crowd simulation models for railway stations, metro, LRT systems, and large transit facilities. The role involves applying advanced modelling tools and data-driven techniques to optimise passenger flow, station design, and crowd management strategies across various transportation projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop, calibrate, and maintain advanced passenger behaviour simulation models across multiple transportation modes, including rail, bus, air, and urban mobility systems.
* Apply both static and dynamic modelling techniques, integrating data-driven insights such as demographics, user preferences, and crowd dynamics to improve accuracy and realism.
* Validate, test, and document simulation models to ensure quality, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—such as data scientists, software developers, and project managers—to integrate models into products and project deliverables.
* Prepare clear technical reports, visualizations, and presentations to communicate modelling results and insights to clients and stakeholders.
* Engage directly with clients to understand requirements, tailor simulation approaches, and provide technical support throughout implementation.
* Monitor emerging trends and research in passenger behaviour and modelling techniques to continuously improve methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior team members, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional development.
* Foster collaboration across WSP within India and globally.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Other duties as assigned/required.

* Proven experience in developing passenger behavior simulation models within transportation, urban planning, or related industries.
* Direct experience in both static and dynamic passenger modelling, such as Legion, Viswalk, CAST and MassMotion will be an asset.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and/or Excel with VBA.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work on complex mathematical models and algorithms.
* Knowledge of data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., MATLAB, R) is a plus.
* Familiarity with transportation systems, crowd dynamics, and human factors is highly advantageous.
* Previous involvement in the development of the Crowd Control Plan (CCP) will be an asset.
* Previous experience in performing passenger movement analysis in major transit facilities will be an asset.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Passion for innovation and a desire to contribute to the future of passenger experience in the transportation industry.
* Exposure to international delivery models and remote collaboration.

description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
  
  
Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
  
  
**We connect. We inspire.**
Pay Band: 5
  
  
Country/Location: Noida, India
  
  
Department: GSS English & Exams (IELTS Online)
  
  
Contract Type: Fixed term contract
  
  
Contract Duration: 1 year
  
  
**Role Description/Purpose**
The responsibilities of this role include assessing process knowledge and skills during interviews, conducting training needs analyses for existing staff (including new hires), developing process training materials, facilitating on-the-job language coaching, and assessing the outcomes of coaching sessions.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
We are seeking a skilled and passionate
**Communications Trainer**
to join our Business Process Services (BPS) team in Noida (NCR). Supporting a 24/7 operation across multiple business processes, this role is critical in developing the communication and language capabilities of employees working in both back-office and customer-facing environments across voice, chat, and email channels. With a workforce of approximately 300–400 employees, you will play a key role in enhancing communication effectiveness, improving customer interactions, and supporting overall business performance. Employment is subject to successful background verification, and the role operates within a secure environment where personal belongings, mobile phones, and other electronic devices are not permitted in operational areas.
  
  
As a Communications Trainer, you will partner with hiring managers to assess candidates’ communication and language proficiency during the recruitment process, developing assessment materials and providing recommendations to support hiring decisions. You will identify training needs across the business, design and deliver engaging communication and soft-skills training programmes, and create relevant learning content and training frameworks. The role also involves conducting coaching sessions, evaluating communication quality, and measuring training effectiveness through performance indicators such as quality scores, customer satisfaction results, and sales conversion outcomes. Working closely with process trainers, quality analysts, and team leaders, you will provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to accelerate employee development and performance improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator with a strong passion for learning and development, capable of building meaningful relationships across teams and influencing positive behavioural change. You will be responsible for managing training logistics, maintaining training records, and ensuring all activities align with organisational compliance and information security requirements. A commitment to upholding company policies, promoting a culture of continuous learning, and ensuring adherence to information security standards will be essential for success in this role.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree
* Excellent English communication skills.
* 3–5 years of overall experience, including a minimum of 2 years' experience as a Voice and Accent Trainer, preferably in a call centre environment.
* Experience in delivering training improvement initiatives related to NPS, CSAT, upselling, and similar performance metrics.
* Knowledge of and experience with Training MIS and reporting.
* IELTS certification at an advanced level or an equivalent industry-recognized certification.
* Knowledge and understanding of customer service principles and practices across voice, email, and chat channels.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proactive approach with strong problem-solving, analytical, and resolution skills.

**Further Information**
Right to Work: Locally recruited
  
  
Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work.
  
  
Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided.
  
  
**India (OCI)**
Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
  
  
Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in
  
  
Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position and it requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
  
  
**Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement**
We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.
  
  
**Safeguarding Statement**
The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.

title: Market Place Ads Manager-PAM
description:
**Marketplace Ads Manager – Paid Account Management**

**Location: Noida (Work from Office)**

*Drive advertising success for a portfolio of sellers — where your PPC expertise, playbooks and data-driven optimization help sellers grow profitably on Amazon.*

New Trends Commerce Private Limited is a Poddar Group Company with Amazon Investment. Our vision is to be the most trusted go-to-market partner for businesses, empowering them to establish and grow their digital ventures efficiently and cost-effectively — through a customer-focused approach, sales expertise, a high-performance culture, and tech-powered sales strategies. We provide end-to-end go-to-market solutions: identifying the right customer segments, data-driven sales strategies, sales training and automation, on-ground execution, and client retention.

We hire and develop the best talent through rigorous hiring & talent management mechanisms anchored in our Leadership Principles. Our teams invent & reinvent for customers, simplify execution, and deliver the key inputs of the business with the right quality and at speed.

**About the role**

We are building a Paid Account Management business that helps sellers launch, grow and scale their online business. The Marketplace Ads Manager owns end-to-end ads management on Amazon for all sellers in the program — a portfolio of 80–100 sellers at any given time. This is an in-house expert role: you design the campaigns, run the optimizations, work directly with sellers on their advertising, and partner with Account Managers to make ads a growth lever for every seller.

**Responsibilities**

1. Own each seller's growth through advertising and the ads goals for every seller — end-to-end ads management for a portfolio of 80–100 sellers, planning, launching, managing and scaling campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display
2. Set up ads for every newly onboarded seller within defined timelines — account audit, campaign structure, keyword research, targeting and budget allocation
3. Optimize every account on a fixed weekly/fortnightly cadence — bid and budget management, keyword harvesting, negative targeting, wasted-spend reduction and budget pacing — to deliver each seller's ACOS, ROAS and sales goals with full budget utilization
4. Use ads platforms, bulk operations and automation tools to run the portfolio efficiently
5. Work directly with sellers on their advertising — ads plans, budget recommendations, performance reviews and query resolution — alongside the Account Managers
6. Partner with Account Managers on each seller's aligned growth plan — build the ads goals of the seller's Joint Business Plan (JBP) with the AM and deliver progress against them through the year
7. Champion seller success — identify sellers where ads investment can unlock growth, and drive budget and campaign expansion with sellers
8. Support the business development team with ads audits and inputs during seller pitches
9. Build the ads playbook for scale — standard campaign templates, category-level strategies, SOPs and checklists — so quality stays consistent as the portfolio grows
10. Publish ads performance reports on a monthly cadence — portfolio-level dashboards and seller-level summaries — and keep track of the latest trends in Amazon Ads, bringing them into the program

**Basic qualifications**

1. 3–6 years of hands-on Amazon Ads (PPC) experience managing multiple seller accounts — agency, SPN or seller-services background preferred
2. Previous experience of managing marketplace brands and sellers is mandatory
3. Proven command of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display — campaign structures, keyword research, bid strategies — and fluency with ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CVR and CPC
4. Strong working knowledge of the Amazon Ads console and Seller Central; comfort building and uploading bulk sheets to manage campaigns at portfolio scale
5. Hands-on experience with ads automation and research tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools
6. Experience handling sizeable monthly ad budgets across multiple categories
7. Excellent Excel and analytical skills
8. Strong written and oral communication; ability to explain ads performance simply to sellers and internal teams
9. Bachelor's degree mandatory; MBA preferred; Amazon Ads certification preferred

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I ( Noida)**
Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.
  
  
**About The Role**
Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.
  
  
Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.
  
  
You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.
  
  
**What You Will Actually Do**

* Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

title: OpenStack Administrator
description:
**Join our Team**

We are looking for a skilled OpenStack Engineer with strong Linux administration and Ansible automation experience to manage and support OpenStack private cloud infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for OpenStack operations, Linux system management, automation, and providing production support.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Install, configure, and manage OpenStack environments
* Support OpenStack components including:

+ Nova (Compute)
+ Neutron (Networking)
+ Cinder (Block Storage)
+ Glance (Image Service)
+ Keystone (Identity)
+ Horizon (Dashboard)

* Manage controller and computing nodes
* Support VM provisioning, migration, and lifecycle management
* Troubleshoot OpenStack service and VM-related issues
* Perform OpenStack patching, upgrades, and maintenance

**The skills you bring:**

* Experience in working on Redhat Enterprise Linux 7/8/9 and Redhat Openstack/Nokia CBIS /Ceph storage
* Added advantage worked in HPE/Dell bare metal servers replacing the faulty spares.
* Good hands-on experience of managing Linux/Redhat OpenStack/Ceph cluster environment.
* Added advantage basic understanding of OpenShift or RHOSO18.
* Good hands-on experience on undercloud and overcloud nodes includes director/controller/compute/storage.
* Good hands-on experience on different types of computes like OVS, SRIOV.
* Experience in host aggregation groups and migration of VMs both live and cold.
* Good hands-on experience with Ceph Storage operations like OSD recreate, Ceph storage flags.
* Troubleshooting and upgrade of OpenStack/Linux/Ceph using manual and automated approach.
* Leverage on automation tools (Ansible, Bash Shell) Added advantage.
* Experience in docker and container technology.
* Good knowledge on troubleshooting and operations skills mandatory in Linux,OpenStack infra.
* Understanding & troubleshooting the issues via available system logs.
* Understanding of network technologies (DNS, SNMP, HTTP, TCP/IP,VLAN)
* Produce clear documentation for delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills and business orientation
* Work closely with members of Support and Engineering teams to quickly resolve any client issues
* Analyze customer improvement areas and challenges related to technology and processes
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, ITSM guidelines, and industry best practices

description:

Virtualization Infrastructure Management

Manage RBAC, hardening guidelines, and patch management.
  
  
Support audit and compliance requirements.
  
  
Support & Troubleshooting

Perform root cause analysis and incident resolution.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotation (if applicable).

5–10+ years of experience in VMware administration.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with:
  
  
VMware vSphere (6.x / 7.x / 8.x)
  
  
ESXi host management
  
  
vCenter Server
  
  
HA, DRS, vMotion
  
  
**Experience With Storage Technologies (SAN/NAS, VSAN Preferred).**
Good understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs).
  
  
Experience in patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  
  
Experience with Windows/Linux VM environments.

VMware certifications (VCP-DCV / VCAP preferred).
  
  
Experience with VMware SRM.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:
Pegasus, part of the B. Jain Group, is an established children’s publishing brand with a wide portfolio of books, educational products and screen-free learning experiences.

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

About HisVitals

HisVitals is a preventive healthcare company focused on metabolic health, obesity management, nutrition and wellness. We help people understand their metabolic health and identify possible contributors to weight-related concerns through comprehensive blood panels covering 72 and 119 parameters, followed by personalized guidance.

Role Overview

We are hiring a qualified Nutritionist to work with clients after they complete their blood tests. You will review health information, hold detailed consultations, identify potential nutrition-related and metabolic concerns, and prepare personalized nutrition and lifestyle recommendations. The role combines nutritional science, metabolic health assessment, one-on-one consultation and AI-assisted planning. This is a science-led clinical-nutrition role, not a wellness-influencer or fitness-coaching position.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct detailed one-on-one nutrition consultations (approximately 30–45 minutes) after clients complete their blood tests

• Review blood test results and relevant health information

• Understand each client's eating habits, weight management challenges, lifestyle, exercise habits, metabolic health concerns, and relevant medical and dietary history

• Evaluate clinical and nutritional information to identify possible contributing factors to metabolic and weight-related concerns

• Document consultation findings in comprehensive notes

• Develop personalized recommendations covering diet, nutrition, exercise, lifestyle changes, and supplements where appropriate and within professional scope

• Consider contraindications, existing medical conditions and potential supplement interactions

• Use HisVitals' proprietary AI model to help prepare detailed diet and exercise plans, then review and personalize them using your professional judgment

• Explain recommendations clearly so clients understand the reasoning behind them

• Collaborate with appropriately qualified medical professionals when needed

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Formal educational background in nutrition, dietetics or a closely related field (mandatory)

• Strong understanding of nutrition science

• Knowledge of metabolic health and weight management

• Ability to interpret nutritional and metabolic information within professional scope

• Good communication and consultation skills

• Ability to prepare structured diet and lifestyle plans

• Understanding of dietary and supplement contraindications

• 0–5 years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in clinical nutrition, metabolic health, obesity management or preventive healthcare

• Familiarity with blood test reports and metabolic biomarkers

• Experience preparing personalized diet plans

• Comfort using AI-assisted tools for nutrition planning

How to Apply

If you are a qualified nutritionist who values evidence-based, personalized care, we'd like to hear from you. Apply on LinkedIn.**
