description:
Job Title: Mechanical Design & Development Engineer

Company: Protexia Systems Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Employment Type: Full-time, on-site

Preferred Experience: 3–7 years in mechanical design, product development or electromechanical systems

About the Role

Protexia Systems is looking for a hands-on Mechanical Design & Development Engineer to develop advanced mechanical systems for aerospace, defence and energy applications. The role involves taking products from concept and engineering calculations through detailed design, prototyping, testing and production.

The ideal candidate should have experience with precision mechanical assemblies, pressure-containing components, fluid handling, thermal management and integration of mechanical hardware with electronics and sensors. Experience in composite design and manufacturing will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, bills of materials and technical specifications.

- Design compact mechanical assemblies, pressure-containing components, manifolds, valves, piping, sealing arrangements and equipment enclosures.

- Perform engineering calculations for strength, pressure, flow, heat transfer, tolerances and component sizing.

- Conduct or coordinate structural, thermal, vibration and fatigue analysis, supported by physical testing.

- Integrate sensors, actuators, control electronics, wiring and fluid connections into reliable, serviceable mechanical assemblies.

- Select materials, seals, coatings and manufacturing processes based on operating conditions, fluid compatibility, weight and durability.

- Develop prototypes, test rigs, fixtures and assembly tooling; support fabrication, assembly, troubleshooting and design improvements.

- Prepare test plans and support pressure, leak, functional, endurance and environmental testing.

- Work closely with electronics, embedded systems, manufacturing, quality and procurement teams.

- Coordinate with suppliers and machining vendors to ensure component quality, manufacturability and timely delivery.

- Maintain design documentation, revision control, test records and engineering change documentation.

- Support transition from prototype development to repeatable production through assembly procedures, inspection criteria and process improvements.

Essential Qualifications & Skills

- B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.

- Proficiency in SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, Siemens NX or an equivalent 3D CAD platform.

- Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and design for manufacturing and assembly.

- Sound fundamentals in mechanics, machine design, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics and heat transfer.

- Practical understanding of machining, sheet metal fabrication, joining, sealing and mechanical assembly.

- Experience developing and testing physical hardware, including investigating failures and implementing corrective actions.

- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and work independently while coordinating with a multidisciplinary team.

Preferred Experience — Composites & Advanced Manufacturing

Experience in one or more of the following will be particularly valuable:

- Carbon fibre, glass fibre, aramid and UHMWPE composite materials.

- Filament winding of composite cylinders, tubes or structural components, including liner interfaces, tooling and winding-process considerations.

- High-pressure and elevated-temperature composite consolidation, including hydroclave, autoclave, compression moulding or matched-die processing.

- Prepreg lay-up, vacuum bagging, resin infusion, adhesive bonding and controlled curing.

- Design of lightweight composite structures, sandwich panels, inserts and composite-to-metal joints.

- Development of moulds, mandrels, fixtures and tooling for composite manufacturing.

- Manufacturing process control, including resin content, fibre orientation, void reduction, dimensional consistency and inspection.

Additional Experience That Would Be Useful

- High-pressure gas systems, pressure vessels, regulators and leak-tight assemblies.

- Compact fluid delivery systems, pumps, valves and flow-control hardware.

- Thermal management of electrochemical or electrical equipment.

- Aerospace mechanisms, rotating equipment, hose-handling assemblies or actuator-driven systems.

- Hardware designed for vibration, shock, temperature variation and demanding operating environments.

- Design reviews, failure mode and effects analysis, root-cause analysis and qualification testing.

title: Senior Consultant – Technology Risk & Internal Controls
description:

We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
The
**Technology Risk and Controls Senior Staff**
professional is experienced contributor who supports client projects by performing IT control testing, documentation, and compliance review activities. This position is a key execution resource to internal audit and advisory engagements by supporting risk assessment, IT process and control walkthrough and testing via evidence evaluation.
  
  
You’ll develop a deeper understanding of how technology supports business objectives and learn to identify and mitigate risks that impact security, compliance, and performance. You’ll gain exposure to diverse clients, industries, and technologies while building a strong foundation for advancement into internal audit leadership or risk consulting roles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Independently execute detailed testing procedures over access management, change management, IT operations, and system interfaces in accordance with firm methodologies and regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, SOC, NIST, ISO 27001).
* Able to identify and document key IT risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities across enterprise systems, cloud environments, and digital platforms.
* Proactively analyze and clearly articulate the design and effectiveness of automated controls, system configurations, and data flows that support financial, operational, and compliance objectives.
* Prepare clear, well-supported documentation and workpapers in accordance with firm and regulatory standards.
* Work closely with business, risk, and technology stakeholders, including management, IT leadership, and occasionally regulators, to communicate findings and recommendations clearly and professionally.
* Contribute to the development of reports and client deliverables that summarize observations, root causes, and practical recommendations for risk mitigation and process improvement.
* Build foundational skills in areas such as cybersecurity, cloud computing, identity and access management, data analytics, automation tools, and industry-specific regulations (e.g., HIPAA, SEC, FFIEC).
* Approach new challenges with curiosity and a critical-thinking mindset, learning from diverse projects and client environments.
* Participate in team collaboration, coaching, and knowledge-sharing to foster a supportive and high-performance culture.
* Support coaching and review of Staff work, providing feedback and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Chartered Accountant, MBA, CMA, bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in IT internal audit, risk management, or consulting.
* Basic understanding of IT controls, IT SOX, system development lifecycle (SDLC), and IT governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, Workiva, Audit Board, Archer, Teammate, ServiceNow, or other internal audit management software.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
* Foundational understanding of risk and control concepts.
* Ability to learn technical systems and IT processes quickly.
* General interest in the Information Technology field (emerging technologies, software development processes, computer networking, and authentication technologies).
* An industry accepted certification in progress (e.g., CIA, CISA) preferred.
* Experience with both business process and ITGC control experience a plus

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

description:

to work closely with the Founders and senior leadership team on strategic priorities and critical business initiatives. This is a

that will involve working across business strategy, operations, process improvement, project management, analytics, and cross-functional execution.

.

* Work closely with the Founders and leadership team on strategic business priorities and initiatives.

* Conduct market, competitor, and business analysis to identify opportunities and potential risks.
* Translate business objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

title: Learning and Development Manager
description:
Full-time, six days a week, fully onsite at WTF's Sector 9, Noida office. No remote or hybrid arrangement. Apply only if the working week and daily commute are practical.

This is a business-wide capability-building role—not a gym-only trainer position and not a job measured by the number of sessions conducted.

Work with business managers to find the skill or behaviour behind a performance gap. Turn that into practical learning, job aids, coached practice and an assessment that shows whether people can perform the work. Follow through after training to see what transferred to the job and what needs to change.

The remit spans sales, service, gym operations, academy, product/technology and support functions. You do not need to be the technical expert in every department. You must know how to work with the right subject-matter owner for technical sign-off and turn their knowledge into usable learning.

Show us a programme you personally built and deployed: the business problem, cohort, dates, baseline, proficiency test, observed result and later performance check. Explain your direct contribution separately from trainers' delivery. Attendance, completion certificates and generic engagement scores are not enough.

The assessment includes a short practical learning-design case for an unfamiliar function, using safe fictional information, plus a discussion of one redacted or recreated job aid or assessment rubric. Do not disclose confidential employer or learner data.

Please be ready with current or last-drawn CTC, notice period, current locality and earliest realistic start. Compensation is discussed after evidence review. No package, title escalation or interview slot is promised by applying.

**Company Description**
Indiana Commerce is a specialized E-Commerce solutions provider offering end-to-end services tailored to the needs of modern businesses. Since 2022, the company has partnered with emerging and mid-level retailers, wholesalers, and manufacturers to drive growth through account management, marketplace integration, brand development, marketing strategies, and logistics optimization. Indiana Commerce operates as an extended team for its clients, focusing on strong, collaborative relationships and measurable results. Leveraging deep expertise in the E-Commerce landscape and the latest tools and software, the company delivers efficient, secure, and scalable solutions. Applicants can expect to join a dynamic, growth-oriented environment dedicated to building impactful digital commerce experiences.
  
**Role Description**
The Community & Brand Relations Manager is a full-time remote role responsible for strengthening Indiana Commerce’s presence across online and offline communities while enhancing brand awareness and trust. This role involves engaging with partner communities, customer groups, and industry networks through social platforms, forums, and direct outreach. The Manager will plan and coordinate community initiatives and events, support brand campaigns, and collaborate with sales and marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging and positioning. Daily tasks include managing community communication channels, responding to inquiries and feedback, nurturing strategic relationships, and preparing reports on engagement metrics and brand sentiment. The role also includes identifying collaboration opportunities, supporting public relations activities, and contributing ideas to improve overall brand visibility and reputation.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Community Engagement skills, including building, nurturing, and moderating online and offline communities.
* Candidates should demonstrate excellent Communication skills, with the ability to convey clear, consistent, and inclusive messages across multiple channels.
* Candidates should have Sales-related skills, such as relationship building, lead nurturing, and supporting revenue-generating initiatives in collaboration with sales teams.
* Candidates should possess Public Relations skills, including media outreach support, reputation management, and coordination of brand communications.
* Candidates should have Event Planning skills for organizing virtual and in-person community events, webinars, and brand activations.
* Relevant qualifications include experience in E-Commerce, marketing, or community management; familiarity with social media platforms and CRM tools; and strong analytical capabilities to interpret engagement data.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred, along with the ability to work independently, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a remote environment.

title: GMS-Senior-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts supporting global operations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations.
* Ability to support critical production incidents outside standard business hours when required.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on business requirements.
* Ability to work effectively within a Managed Services delivery model.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Escalation Engineer – Client Services
description:
Location: Noida, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Global Support Organization and provide World class Support for all Thales products.
  
  
Thales is a leading global provider of data protection solutions with more than 40 years’ experience securing the world’s most sensitive information. Our customers—businesses, governments, and technology vendors with a broad range of challenges use Thales e-Security products and services to improve the security of applications that rely on encryption and digital signatures.
  
  
By protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive information that flows through today’s traditional, virtualized, and cloud-based infrastructures, Thales helps organizations reduce risk, demonstrate compliance, enhance agility, and pursue strategic goals with greater confidence.
  
  
Position Scope
  
  
As a member of a collaborative Client Services team, the Escalation Engineer will provide product escalation support to the Client Services Tech support team, for specific product, in constructing complex customer deployments, analyzing for root causes, recommending remediation procedures or best practices and documenting test methods, processes and knowledge bases. In addition, this position is responsible for validating proper interoperability of Thales products with other third-party vendor software/Solutions
  
  
This is a multi-disciplined role; the successful candidate should be able to perform hardware/software setup in a variety of lab configurations. This will include various OS platforms, storage products, databases, file systems, security protection software, HA clustering software, etc. The candidate must be a strategic thinker, well organized and able to work within fast-paced engineering environments and is also expected via collaboration with the broader Technical Support, QA and Developer teams to drive continual improvements to our processes and methodologies, all with the goal of continually improving the product quality and customer experience.
  
  
This is a dream job for an individual who likes to develop and maintain proficiency across a wide variety of enterprise-class hardware and software products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**

* Work closely with global support engineers on customer escalation issues to ensure timely resolution
* Configure and duplicate the customer’s environment where necessary to replicate the issues for diagnosing
* Identify the root causes and use this information to improve continuously within support & field service teams
* Work closely with global development teams to diagnose issues and validating fixes
* Given the critical nature of the customer issues supported, some after-hours/weekend work will be required. Pparticipation in the 24 x 7 telephone support Rota is mandatory for this position
* Serve as a Thales product support expert who will work closely with other department as required to facilitate training on new product and features and maintaining a database of training videos for support review.
* Work closely with our engineering and product management teams to communicate customer needs, issues, and trends to successfully use Thales products.
* Identify and champion product enhancement requests as customer advocates.
* Create knowledge and support articles, webinars, white papers, and other materials that help customers use Thales products.
* Other duties as assigned

**Technical Knowledge/Skills & Experience Required**
**Essential:**

* Operating Systems & Infrastructure Strong Linux & Windows Server administration skills System performance analysis (CPU, memory, disk, processes, services) Log analysis and troubleshooting Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V) Basic cloud exposure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Networking fundamentals TCP/IP, DNS, routing, NAT, VPN concepts Packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump) Load balancer concepts
* Database Knowledge Strong understanding of databases (Oracle, MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, MySQL) SQL query analysis and troubleshooting Database performance fundamentals Understanding of DB connectivity/authentication Replication and HA concepts
* Security & Compliance Fundamentals Vulnerability and risk concepts Encryption fundamentals Compliance standards awareness (PCI-DSS, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR)
* Diagnostic Tools Wireshark, tcpdump, curl/Postman, Fiddler, Splunk/Kibana basics, Database tracing tools

**Good to have**
Basic scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, REST API fundamentals, JSON/XML parsing)
  
  
Automation mindset for repetitive diagnostics
  
  
Basic Git familiarity
  
  
**Troubleshooting & Escalation Skills**

* Analytical & Troubleshooting skills
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Complex log correlation
* Crisis Management
* Reproducing customer issues in lab environments
* Performance bottleneck identification
* Clear technical documentation skills
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset
* Ability to independently lead P1/P0 customer escalations
* Mentorship and enablement of Support teams
* Trend analysis and recurrence prevention
* Contribution to KBs, tooling, automation, and process improvements
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments and deployment patterns

**Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science /engineering or technical field or equivalent experience.

**Professional Attributes**
**Demonstrates the Thales Values:**

* Focus on Customers
* Perform through teaming
* Innovate, decide and act quickly
* Develop our people
* Proactive - Develops practical solutions, takes ownership, has a ‘can do' rather than ‘won’t do’ approach
* Technically curious – Regards technology problems as challenges
* Teamwork - Connected to the business, communicates openly, shares information and knowledge, networks internally and externally, persuades rather than pushes, involves colleagues, respects colleagues
* Creative – Connects the technical dots with a goal of building customer value
* Responsive - Always reacts quickly and with a sense of urgency to requests, issues, e-mails or other events in a timely and flexible fashion

**Work Environment**

* The working environment is generally indoors in environmentally controlled conditions where lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous conditions. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Sr. Network Analyst
description:
****Description****
IP Network Assurance Team Member
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
Technical
  
  

* Perform detailed trouble analysis (remote testing, fault isolation, and resolution) for IP network elements using logs, alarms, operational metrics and tools
* Perform break fix activities due to network failures. (due to any of the following: hardware, software, and firmware upgrades, network element commissioning, and product change upgrades).
* Conduct preventive maintenance routines on IP network elements to maintain and improve network reliability.
* Implement service and network element changes as directed to ensure the smooth functioning of the network.
* Knowledge of core / distribution / access concepts and their troubleshooting and break/fix (includes NAT, GPON / DSLAMs, routing, hardware troubleshooting).
* Work with vendors for issues

Communications
  
  

* Work closely with team members to resolve network issues efficiently and effectively.
* Coordinate with on-site technicians who require assistance or are providing “hands and feet” support for IP network assurance tasks.
* Engage with stakeholders and team members to discuss network issues, troubleshoot details, and confirm resolutions.
* Provide regular updates on issue progress, next steps, and any roadblocks.

Administration
  
  

* Maintain accurate documentation of all maintenance routines, changes, and incidents related to IP network assurance.
* Update corporate systems with real-time status updates, logs, and detailed information about ongoing issues and resolutions.
* Submit time and expense reports promptly.

**Results Or Outcomes:**

* Work is completed within time constraints to meet defined quality standards, ensuring overall network reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain clear communication standards with stakeholders through appropriate channels (phone, email, chat).

**Qualifications:**
Education and Certifications
  
  

* Diploma in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (equivalent combination of education and experience is acceptable).
* Industry Certifications (nice to have): (more imp than Bachelors)
* Juniper Networks Certified Associate/Professional (JNCIA/JNCIP)
* Nokia Certification
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) (Optional)
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) (Optional)
* CompTIA Network+ (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation certification (Optional)

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of IP network protocols such as OSPF, BGP, ISIS, segment routing, etc.
* Proven ability to isolate and resolve issues in LAN, MAN, and WAN environments.
* Familiarity with command-line interface (CLI) and GUI tools from vendors such as Juniper, Nokia etc
* Expertise in working with automated provisioning, network telemetry, circuit documentation, ticketing, and testing/dispatch systems.
* Able to understand IP networks using existing documentation and understanding of the system.
* Able to perform IP Surveillance activities without any assistance

Problem Solving and Decision Making
  
  

* Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to quickly identify problems and implement effective solutions.
* Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
* Committed to continuous learning, including completing certifications and passing relevant exams.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to follow and adhere to published work plans, processes, and procedures.
* Normal color vision to work with color-coded diagrams and tools.
* Willingness and ability to work in a shift-based environment, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in English (French is an asset).
* Strong interpersonal skills to handle both positive and challenging customer interactions.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
* Maintain performance under time constraints and in rapidly changing situations.

Security Requirements
  
  

* Must meet applicable security clearance requirements

title: Service Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
We are now looking for a
**Service Monitoring Engineer**
to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through jeopardy management of the incidents.
  
  
You will play a key role in tracking, and driving timely closure of incidents, service requests, and operational tasks to ensure network availability is maintained at the target levels. This will require coordination with the Field, 3PP & Internal Ericsson team. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericsson’s vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.

* Continuously track incidents, service tickets, and operational activities.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with responsible teams to ensure progress towards timely closure.
* Initiate recovery actions when timelines slip or risk indicators arise.
* Validate updates and ensure all incidents have clear actions, owners, and deadlines.

* Provide regular status updates to stakeholders regarding jeopardy items and escalated issues.
* Prepare incident summary reports, escalation logs, and closure metrics for leadership review.
* Track and report KPIs such as aging incidents, SLA compliance, escalation count, and closure rate & blockers/reasons for slow progression.
* Maintain dashboards or trackers that highlight jeopardy status and follow-up progress.
* Support audit requirements with proper documentation and data accuracy.
* Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to reduce incident occurrence and impact.

**The Skills You Bring**

* 2–6 years of experience in Network Operations / Alarm Monitoring in a telecom or IT network environment.
* Strong understanding of general network technologies and concepts across access, transport, and IP domains (vendor-agnostic).
* Hands-on experience with Ericsson OSS/NMS tools or other multi-vendor management systems (e.g., Netcool, HP OpenView, SolarWinds, etc.).
* Knowledge of fault management processes, ITIL best practices, and SLA-driven operational models.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly interpret incidents and determine probable actions needed to resolve the same.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective collaboration across global teams.
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Skilled in handling escalations and managing political dynamics in high-stakes scenarios.
* Hands on analytical tools like MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Power Bi.
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift environment (rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays).

title: Senior Configuration and Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Configuration and Delivery Manager would be responsible for configuration control, release coordination, deployment governance, and delivery readiness across current and upcoming WSP Digital Products. The role would ensure that product configuration, environment readiness, version control, release packages, deployment approvals, and production releases are managed through controlled, traceable, auditable, and repeatable processes across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Configuration Management**
Define and maintain configuration management standards across applications, environments, release packages, and deployment artefacts.
  
  
Maintain traceability for product versions, configuration items, environment variables, dependencies, release baselines, and deployment records.
  
  
Coordinate configuration changes across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and environment layers.
  
  
Ensure configuration decisions are documented, controlled, and auditable.
  
  
**Release & Deployment Management**
Plan, coordinate, schedule, and govern product releases across current and upcoming digital products.
  
  
Maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, release notes, release scope, deployment checklist, and rollback plans.
  
  
Coordinate release readiness reviews, QA sign-offs, DevOps readiness, CAB inputs, and production deployment approvals.
  
  
Track release risks, deployment issues, defects, rollback outcomes, and post-release validation status.
  
  
**Environment & Delivery Readiness**
Coordinate environment readiness across Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production, and support environments.
  
  
Ensure environment consistency, access readiness, dependency readiness, and deployment sequencing before release execution.
  
  
Support environment refresh, configuration updates, smoke-test coordination, and deployment troubleshooting.
  
  
Work with DevOps and engineering teams to improve repeatability and reliability of deployment practices.
  
  
**Compliance, Metrics & Continuous Improvemen**
t
  
  
Maintain release evidence, approval records, deployment logs, release decisions, and audit-ready documentation.
  
  
Track release metrics including deployment frequency, failed deployments, rollback frequency, defect leakage, and release predictability.
  
  
Identify recurring release and configuration issues and drive preventive improvements with engineering, QA, DevOps, and support teams.
  
  
Contribute to release SOPs, configuration playbooks, governance checklists, and operational documentation.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
**Configuration Management |**
Advanced — software baselines, version control, configuration item traceability, environment configuration, and audit records
  
  
**Release Management |**
Advanced — release planning, deployment coordination, CAB inputs, release readiness, rollback planning, and sign-offs
  
  
**DevOps / CI-CD Awareness |**
Proficient — Azure DevOps, GitHub, branching, tagging, pipelines, deployment controls, and release artefacts
  
  
**Environment Governance |**
Proficient — Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production readiness, environment refresh, and deployment sequencing
  
  
**ITIL / Change Governance |**
Proficient — change, release, configuration, risk-based approvals, governance documentation, and auditability
  
  
**Stakeholder Coordination |**
Advanced — coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, business, support, and leadership teams
  
  
**Required Experience**
Minimum 8 years of professional experience in configuration management, release management, DevOps coordination, IT operations, or software delivery governance.
  
  
Experience managing enterprise release cycles across multiple environments and product teams.

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:**
392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**POSITION DETAILS**
Job Title: SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
  
Location: India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)
  
  
Experience: 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
  
Compensation: Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
  
Work Hours: IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
OS Deployment & Image Management
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test & Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline & Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application & Software Management
  
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure & Platform Management
  
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

**Required Skills**

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

**MINIMUM EDUCATION**
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

𝗝𝗼𝗯 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆

We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead – Confluent Kafka & Apache Flink to lead the design, development, and implementation of real-time data streaming and event-processing solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Apache Kafka, Confluent Platform, Apache Flink, distributed systems, and stream-processing architectures, along with proven technical leadership and stakeholder management skills.

The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant streaming platforms, leading engineering teams, and ensuring the performance, reliability, and security of real-time data pipelines.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of real-time data streaming solutions using Confluent Kafka and Apache Flink.

Design and develop scalable, low-latency, high-throughput event-driven architectures and distributed data-processing systems.

Implement Kafka producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, replication, and message-delivery strategies.

Develop and optimize Apache Flink applications for real-time stream processing, stateful computations, event-time processing, and complex event processing.

Design and implement Flink jobs with appropriate checkpointing, savepoints, state management, and fault-tolerance mechanisms.

Manage Kafka clusters, including configuration, performance tuning, monitoring, security, and high availability.

Work with Confluent Platform capabilities such as Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, and stream-processing integrations.

Establish best practices for data governance, schema evolution, data quality, and reliable event delivery.

Troubleshoot complex production issues related to streaming pipelines, data consistency, latency, throughput, and distributed-system failures.

Collaborate with architects, product owners, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Lead code reviews, technical discussions, design reviews, and engineering best practices.

Mentor developers and engineers, manage technical deliverables, and ensure timely project execution.

Implement observability, logging, alerting, and performance-monitoring strategies for streaming applications.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards, access controls, and operational requirements.

Required Technical Skills

Experience: 13+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in data engineering, distributed systems, and technical leadership.

Confluent Kafka: Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform.

Apache Flink: Expertise in real-time stream processing, stateful processing, event-time semantics, windowing, and fault tolerance.

Kafka Architecture: In-depth understanding of brokers, topics, partitions, replication, consumer groups, offsets, and delivery semantics.

Programming: Proficiency in Java and/or Scala for developing Kafka and Flink applications.

Kafka Connect: Experience with source and sink connectors and integrating Kafka with databases, APIs, and enterprise systems.

Schema Management: Experience with Confluent Schema Registry and Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema.

Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, concurrency, consistency, and high availability.

Performance Optimization: Ability to tune Kafka and Flink applications for throughput, latency, resource utilization, and reliability.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Monitoring & Operations: Experience with metrics, logging, alerting, and production support for distributed streaming platforms.

Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical teams, drive architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and coordinate with stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience implementing enterprise-scale event-driven architectures and real-time analytics platforms.

Knowledge of Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, or other stream-processing frameworks.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices.

Familiarity with data lakehouse platforms, data warehouses, and downstream analytics integrations.

Experience designing disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-cluster streaming strategies.

Relevant certifications in Confluent, cloud platforms, or data engineering are an advantage.

Leadership & Soft Skills

Strong technical leadership and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to make architecture and technology decisions independently.

Experience managing technical risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.

Strong documentation, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Engagement Details

𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲: 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 – 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗹𝘂𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗞𝗮𝗳𝗸𝗮 & 𝗔𝗽𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸

𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱: 𝟭𝟯+ 𝗬𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁: 𝟭𝟮 𝗠𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀

𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: 𝗡𝗼𝗶𝗱𝗮, 𝗨𝘁𝘁𝗮𝗿 𝗣𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗵

𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: 𝗢𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗲

title: Security Analysis Specialist Advisor - Delivery/Ops, CISSP/SSCP
description:
**Req ID:**
386932
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Security Analysis Specialist Advisor - Delivery/Ops, CISSP/SSCP to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
"Role Overview
  
  
The NTT DATA Services Security Analysis Specialist Advisor works to ensure the seamless delivery of all information security services that NTT DATA provides to the customer.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role in which the person acts as a trusted information security partner with the customer and works collaboratively to understand, anticipate and recommend risk mitigation while promoting the overall information security protection for the customer’s information assets. You will partner with client to align information security with the customer’s business strategy, security policies and regulatory and compliance requirements resulting in increased protection and reduced risk.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities (high Level Summary Of Key Duties)**
The responsibilities of the Security Analysis Specialist Advisor include:
  
  

* Ensure the delivery of information security services to the customer in compliance with the contract and any applicable standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., PCI, SOX)
* Assist client in the definition and implementation of information security policies, strategies, procedures and settings to ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of client’s environment and data
* Participate with customer in the strategic design process to translate security and business requirements into processes and systems; evaluating new / emerging security products and technologies and making recommendations to customer leadership in regards to the security posture impact on the organization
* Identify, review and recommend information security improvements as they relate to the achievement of the customer’s business goals and objectives
* Participate in internal and external audits for the customer (e.g., SOX, PCI) and coordinate information security services activities
* Drive remediation efforts related to information security; remediation may be from incidents, penetration tests, vulnerability scans, internal/external audits and Critical Practice assessments
* Identify information security weaknesses and/or gaps in the customer’s current operations and work with the customer to bring information security operations up to standards
* Participate and represent IT Security in Delivery/Operational meetings
* Review service management reports to ensure tickets (i.e., incidents, problems, requests, changes), related to information security, are being acknowledged, worked and Service Level Agreements are being met; provide direction on ticket remediation and ensure remediation is complete

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of relevant experience
* Knowledge of standards / regulations impacting information security (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, SOX)
* Applied knowledge of risk management concepts
* Experience with information security internal & external audits, contract compliance, and quality initiatives

Preferences:
  
  

* At least one of the following certifications: CISSP, SSCP, CISM, CEH
* Undergraduate or graduate degree
* Customer relationship management experience at the senior level
* Strong knowledge of systems and network administration (i.e., desktop, server)
* Knowledge and application of Globally Accepted Information Security Principles
* Strong knowledge of network security that pertains to communications, computer system environments and related infrastructures
* Thorough knowledge of server and desktop configurations that will protect systems from unauthorized access and software invasion

"

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. title: Assistant Engineer - Roads
description:
**Job Description**
Road Safety Audit Engineer: Responsible for supporting and undertaking independent Road Safety Audits, road safety assessments and collision analysis for highway and transport schemes. The role includes reviewing highway designs, undertaking site inspections, analysing STATS19 collision data, identifying road safety problems, preparing audit reports and developing proportionate safety recommendations. The engineer will work in accordance with DMRB GG 119 and applicable highway-authority requirements, while considering the needs of all road users, particularly pedestrians, cyclists and other vulnerable users.
  
  

* Degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in highways, transport planning, road safety or traffic engineering.
* Previous experience supporting or undertaking Road Safety Audits is desirable.
* Knowledge of UK highway standards and road safety practices.
* Progress toward an appropriate professional qualification such as ICE, CIHT or equivalent would be advantageous.
* RSA-specific competency requirements should be matched to the role and the overseeing authority rather than stated generically, because GG 119 contains dedicated requirements covering RSA team structure, audit-team approval and specialists.

**Responsibilities**

* Quality checks of data and model outputs;
* Research and review design options for both technical and economic impact;
* Support Project Managers for on time completion of tasks assigned and to WSP’s expected standards;
* Take ownership of tasks assigned and search for solutions where required;
* Support seniors in maintaining healthy contact with different UK offices for modelling and design rask;
* Zeal to grow self and dedication towards working independently/ with minimal guidance where required;
* Ensure that Health & Safety is embedded into all work practices in line with company policies;
* Clear communication (verbal and written) with colleagues in India and the UK on all matters – project related technical communication and day-to-day matters;
* Work within project constraints; such as time, budget and resource; and
* Attend and contribute in team and project meetings;

Key Competencies/ Skills
  
  
Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and engineering judgement
* Ability to identify safety risks from the perspective of different road users
* Attention to detail
* Clear technical writing
* Independent and objective thinking
* Effective communication with multidisciplinary design teams
* Ability to explain safety concerns and recommendations clearly
* Good understanding of the interaction between road geometry, human behaviour and collision risk
* Desired Skills
* Understanding of fundamental modelling and design techniques, traffic signals operation and CAD standards, including modelling guidelines and CD / Local authority codes and standards.
* Previous experience and capability in Junction modelling, swept path analysis, parking design, signals and junction improvement scheme
* Paper presented at / published in recognised national / internal journal(s)/ conference(s) will be highly desirable;

Qualifications required
  
  

* Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering;
* Masters in Transport or equivalent; and
* Good understanding of MS-Office skills.

Years of experience
  
  

* Postgraduate with to up to 2+ years’ experience.

title: Senior Admissions Counselor
description:
**We're Hiring | Senior Education Counsellor (Sales) / Career Development Advisor (CDA)**

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office

**Experience:**
1–3 Years

**Industry:**
Online Higher Education / EdTech

**About College Vidya**

Established in 2017 and headquartered in Noida, Blackboard E-Learning Private Limited's trademark, College Vidya, is a leading platform in India's online education ecosystem. College Vidya provides authentic, neutral, and unbiased guidance to help learners choose the right universities and online degree or certificate programs aligned with their academic backgrounds and career aspirations.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for motivated and result-oriented professionals for the position of Senior Education Counsellor (Sales) / Career Development Advisor. The role involves providing personalized educational guidance to prospective learners, understanding their career goals, recommending suitable online degree programs, and supporting them throughout the admission process.

The ideal candidate should have experience in sales, academic counselling, or online higher education counselling, along with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. The candidate will be responsible for nurturing leads, converting prospective learners into admissions, and achieving assigned sales targets while ensuring a positive learner experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Connect with prospective learners through calls, emails, and other communication channels to understand their educational backgrounds, career aspirations, and learning requirements.
* Provide accurate and personalized guidance on online degree programs, universities, course structures, eligibility criteria, fee structures, and career opportunities.
* Recommend suitable programs based on learners' professional goals, academic qualifications, and individual preferences.
* Manage the complete counselling and sales cycle, from initial enquiry and lead engagement to follow-ups and final enrolment.
* Convert qualified leads into successful admissions by using consultative selling techniques, effective objection handling, and persuasive communication.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly admission targets while maintaining high standards of counselling quality and learner satisfaction.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective learners through timely follow-ups and consistent communication.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, follow-ups, lead status, and enrolment details using CRM tools such as LSQ, Salesforce, or Zoho.
* Address learner queries and concerns professionally and ensure a smooth admission experience.
* Stay updated on university offerings, online education trends, competitor programs, and industry developments.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of learner queries and smooth completion of admission formalities.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; candidates with backgrounds in Business, Marketing, Education, or Psychology may be preferred.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in sales, academic counselling, student advisory, or online higher education counselling.
* Candidates with specific experience in online degree counselling and online university admissions will be preferred.
* Strong verbal communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand learner requirements and recommend appropriate educational solutions.
* Experience in handling sales targets, lead conversion, and customer relationship management.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as LSQ, Salesforce, or Zoho is an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Office and the ability to maintain accurate records and reports.
* A proactive, customer-focused, and target-oriented approach with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

**Core Competencies**

* **Communication Skills:**
  Ability to explain program details, benefits, and career outcomes clearly and confidently.
* **Relationship Building:**
  Establish trust and rapport with prospective learners to support informed decision-making.
* **Program Knowledge:**
  Understand online degree offerings, university options, eligibility requirements, and career pathways.
* **Sales Effectiveness:**
  Demonstrate strong lead conversion, objection handling, negotiation, and closing skills.
* **Customer Centricity:**
  Understand learner needs and provide personalized, empathetic, and professional guidance.
* **Time Management:**
  Manage multiple leads, prioritize follow-ups, and meet deadlines efficiently.
* **Problem-Solving:**
  Address learner concerns and provide practical solutions throughout the admission journey.
* **Team Collaboration:**
  Coordinate effectively with internal teams to deliver a seamless learner experience.

**Benefits and Growth Opportunities at College Vidya**

* On-the-Job Training to strengthen product knowledge, counselling techniques, and sales capabilities.
* Shadow Buddy Policy to support learning, guidance, and professional development.
* Internal Job Policy (IJP) to explore internal career growth opportunities.
* Employee Education Policy to encourage continuous learning and development.
* Lucrative Incentive Policy offering performance-linked earning opportunities.
* Monthly and Drive Rewards & Recognition (R&R) to appreciate and reward performance.

**Interested in building your career with College Vidya?**

If you have a passion for sales, enjoy guiding learners, and are motivated by performance-driven opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Share your updated resume or apply directly through LinkedIn.

Monitoring & Observability

Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.

* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
* Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
* Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
* Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
* Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
* Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
* Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
* Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
* Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership.
