title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**Company:**
Innovatiview India Ltd.

**Location:**
Noida (On-Site)

**Function:**
Human Resources

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Director

**Experience:**
18+ Years

**Role Type:**
Full-Time | Leadership Role

**About Innovatiview**

Innovatiview is a technology-driven organization providing examination security, surveillance, Smart City, ITMS, Safe City, education technology, and other technology-enabled solutions across large-scale government and enterprise projects.

**Job Overview**

As Innovatiview continues to scale, we are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) to build a high-performance organization, strengthen leadership capability, institutionalize people processes, and align the people agenda closely with business objectives.

We are high growth organization and maturing in most of our HR functions. The CHRO will be responsible for developing and executing the overall People & Organization strategy aligned with Innovatiview's growth plans. The role will have end-to-end ownership of Talent Acquisition (TA), HR Business Partnering (HRBP), HR Operations, and Learning & Development (L&D).

The CHRO will partner closely with the Director’s / CXO’s to build the right organization structure, leadership pipeline, talent strategy, performance culture, employee experience, and organizational capabilities required to support rapid business growth.

**1. People Strategy, Organization Development & Business Partnering**

* Own the people strategy and translate business objectives into workforce, talent, and capability priorities.
* Drive organization design, manpower planning, and productivity, and support organization changes and workforce transitions.
* Establish an HRBP model aligned to business functions, with HRBPs acting as strategic partners to business leaders.
* Surface talent risks, attrition trends, and capability gaps to leadership, and advise the Directors on people and organizational matters.
* Build an accountability-driven, high-performance culture.

**2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Lead hiring across leadership, critical, niche, and volume roles, backed by a workforce planning framework.
* Improve time-to-hire, cost and quality of hire, and offer-to-joining ratios through hiring governance and analytics.
* Build talent pipelines, succession readiness, and employer branding.

**3. HR Operations & Governance**

* Provide oversight of HR operations, employee lifecycle, payroll, policies, and HR systems.
* Drive digitization, dashboards, and MIS for data-driven decisions.
* Ensure labour law compliance, controls, audits, and process discipline.

**4. Learning & Development**

* Build a structured capability framework based on organization and function-level gaps.
* Design leadership development, succession readiness, onboarding, and functional learning interventions.
* Measure training effectiveness and business impact.

**5. Performance Management & Culture**

* Own the performance framework — goal setting, KRAs/KPIs, reviews, calibration, and improvement plans.
* Partner with leadership on high performers and underperformers.
* Build a culture of ownership, meritocracy, and recognition.

**6. Employee Engagement & Retention**

* Develop engagement and retention strategies with structured employee listening.
* Build targeted retention interventions for critical and high-potential talent.
* Strengthen employee experience across the lifecycle.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 18+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with min 5 yrs. of exp leading a HR function l
* Experience as
  **CHRO / Group CHRO / HR Head / Senior HR Director**
  in a mid-to-large organization.
* Proven experience in building HR functions and processes in a rapidly growing organization.
* Strong business orientation with the ability to connect people strategy with business outcomes.
* Experience in organization design, workforce planning, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive presence.
* Demonstrated ability to manage both strategic HR initiatives and execution at scale.
* Strong analytical and data-driven approach to HR decision-making.

At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the world’s most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology.

  
  

Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control.

  
  

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

  
  

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**SENIOR HR MANAGER – MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS**

**Tributum Power Private Limited**

*An Accel1 Inc. Joint Venture | AtmosPOLE™ Manufacturing & Assembly*

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Administration

**Experience:**
Minimum 15 Years

**Qualification:**
MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management or Industrial Relations

**Reporting To:**
JV CEO / Senior Management

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Industry:**
Climate Engineering | Intelligent Infrastructure | Advanced Manufacturing

**ABOUT TRIBUTUM POWER**

**Tributum Power Private Limited is a joint venture of Accel1 Inc.**
, established to manufacture, assemble, deploy and scale AtmosPOLE™, Accel1's flagship intelligent environmental infrastructure platform.

AtmosPOLE™ integrates environmental monitoring, air treatment, smart lighting, IoT connectivity, digital communication, public safety and AI-powered environmental intelligence into multifunctional urban infrastructure.

Tributum Power is establishing advanced manufacturing and assembly capabilities to support large-scale deployment of intelligent climate infrastructure.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on
**Senior HR Manager with 15+ years of experience**
to establish and lead the Human Resources and Administration function for our manufacturing operations in Noida.

The selected candidate will build HR operations from the ground up, recruit approximately
**48 manufacturing and operational professionals**
, establish HR policies, implement digital systems, manage statutory compliance and develop a high-performance organizational culture.

The role requires strong expertise in manufacturing recruitment, industrial relations, workforce planning, payroll, performance management and employee development.

**We seek an HR leader who can build an organization, not simply manage an existing department.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Building**

* Establish the HR and Administration function, organizational structure, policies and procedures.
* Develop scalable HR systems aligned with manufacturing growth.
* Define employee grades, compensation structures and reporting hierarchies.
* Advise senior management on workforce strategy and organizational development.
* Build a culture of accountability, safety, productivity and operational excellence.

**2. Workforce Planning & Recruitment**

* Lead recruitment and onboarding for approximately 48 manufacturing and operational positions.
* Recruit engineers, production managers, mechanical/electrical technicians, electronics and IoT specialists, QA/QC personnel, supervisors and administrative staff.
* Develop manpower plans, recruitment budgets and hiring schedules.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, technical assessments and offers.
* Build partnerships with ITIs, polytechnics, engineering colleges and recruitment agencies.
* Develop talent pipelines across Noida, Greater Noida and Delhi NCR.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, costs, offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Plan future staffing requirements for manufacturing expansion.

**3. HR Policies & Employee Administration**

* Develop employee handbooks, HR policies, appointment letters and employment agreements.
* Establish attendance, leave, shift, overtime, holiday and disciplinary policies.
* Implement onboarding, probation, confirmation, appraisal and exit processes.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation and administrative controls.
* Ensure consistent HR policy implementation across departments.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Industrial Relations**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and Uttar Pradesh labor laws and employment regulations.
* Manage applicable EPF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, overtime and statutory benefits.
* Maintain factory-related employment records, statutory registers and compliance documentation.
* Oversee applicable contract labor, apprenticeship and outsourced workforce requirements.
* Establish grievance, disciplinary, employee welfare and workplace harassment prevention procedures.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, labor consultants, auditors and government authorities.
* Resolve employee disputes and maintain compliance calendars.

**5. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies and employee benefits.
* Coordinate payroll, attendance reconciliation, overtime, statutory deductions and settlements.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing with Finance.
* Develop increments, incentives and employee recognition programs.
* Prepare manpower budgets and compensation reports.

**6. Performance Management & Development**

* Establish performance appraisal systems and role-specific KRAs/KPIs.
* Implement probation reviews, evaluations and performance improvement plans.
* Develop performance-linked incentives and recognition programs.
* Support promotions, career progression and leadership development.
* Partner with department heads to improve productivity and accountability.

**7. Training & Technical Skills**

* Establish induction, orientation and employee development programs.
* Coordinate training in mechanical assembly, electrical systems, electronics, IoT and quality control.
* Develop competency matrices with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and EHS teams.
* Coordinate safety awareness and workplace training.
* Maintain training records and develop institutional skill-development partnerships.

**8. Employee Relations & Retention**

* Build a professional, inclusive and performance-oriented workplace.
* Establish grievance-resolution and employee communication processes.
* Develop engagement, welfare, recognition and retention programs.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism and workplace satisfaction.

**9. Manufacturing HR & Shop-Floor Operations**

* Work closely with Production Managers, Supervisors and Engineering leadership.
* Establish shift-wise manpower planning and workforce allocation.
* Monitor attendance, overtime and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate technical staffing based on production requirements.
* Support production ramp-up, workforce readiness and operational expansion.
* Reinforce workplace discipline, safety and quality expectations.

**10. HRMS, Digital Systems & Analytics**

* Implement HRMS and biometric attendance systems.
* Digitize recruitment, onboarding, employee records, payroll and performance management.
* Develop dashboards for headcount, recruitment, attrition, payroll, training and compliance.
* Ensure employee data confidentiality and reporting accuracy.
* Present HR analytics and management reports.

**11. Administration, Budgeting & Leadership**

* Oversee assigned factory and office administration and employee facilities.
* Coordinate workplace welfare and safety induction with EHS personnel.
* Prepare HR budgets, manpower forecasts and training plans.
* Report recruitment progress, compliance and workforce costs.
* Build and mentor the HR team as operations expand.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations or related discipline.
* **Minimum 15 years of HR experience**
  , preferably in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven experience establishing or scaling HR functions.
* Strong technical recruitment and industrial workforce planning capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial relations, payroll and compliance.
* Experience implementing HR policies, HRMS an

**FIRST 90 DAYS – EXPECTED DELIVERABLES**

**Days 1–30: Establish**

* Finalize manpower plans and recruitment priorities.
* Establish essential HR policies, documentation and onboarding processes.
* Begin hiring critical manufacturing and technical personnel.
* Assess statutory compliance, payroll and HRMS requirements.

**Days 31–60: Mobilize**

* Accelerate recruitment against agreed staffing milestones.
* Implement employee records, attendance and payroll coordination.
* Establish induction, safety awareness and training programs.
* Introduce HR dashboards, compliance tracking and departmental KPIs.

**Days 61–90: Operationalize**

* Progress toward completion of the initial recruitment plan.
* Stabilize HR administration, payroll and employee relations.
* Implement employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Conduct an initial compliance assessment.
* Present a scalable HR roadmap for future expansion.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Success will be measured through recruitment completion, time to hire, workforce readiness, employee retention, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, training completion, KRA/KPI implementation, HRMS adoption, employee engagement and manpower budget adherence.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated résumé to
**careers@accel1.com**
with the subject line:

**Application – Senior HR Manager – Tributum Power**

Please include your current designation, total HR and manufacturing experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

**Apply Now:**
**careers@accel1.com**

description:
**Job Description**
At WSP, we're continuing to grow and develop our expertise in Earth and Environment, operating as a trusted advisor and technical expert on engineering design challenges for our clients across multiple industries. Our team is growing, and as a result we're adding a Data Scientist and Visualization Lead to our water quality group. As part of the team in Prairies and North, you'll be responsible for driving forward our ambitious plans to enhance our Earth and Environment service offering in the province through your work with a close-knit team of engineering specialists, professionals, and technical staff.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
A day in the life…
  
  

* Day-to-day, you will work with the water quality team to expand and strengthen our data processing and visualization tools, with opportunities to collaborate with other environmental digitization and database teams within WSP;
* You’ll be part of a company wide initiative to grow our environmental digitization tools to become a market leader in the way that we visualize and analyze large environmental datasets;
* You’ll be proficient in python, VBA, R, and other coding languages, with the ability to interpret and update code from existing tools. You will troubleshoot/update tool functions with support from the technical team;
* You’ll be a leader and innovator in the development of Power BI dashboards used to visualize environmental data on mining projects throughout Canada;
* You’ll be working with a focus group who track water quality guideline updates in Canada, and you will support the team with managing these updates and issuing new versions of our data processing tools based on these guidelines;
* You’ll train and mentor our team in the use of our tools, and present learning opportunities to other groups to expand your professional network;
* Working closely with project teams, you’ll help identify new opportunities to expand the use of our water quality and environmental digitization tools, presenting to clients as needed, and helping troubleshoot and develop tools for project work.

**Job Summary:**

Futuresafe Technologies, having a long-term agreement with US-based SiteRecon Inc, requires Jr. Cartographer (GIS) for the night shift.

**About Siterecon:**

SiteRecon is helping property maintenance contractors in the US to automate property mapping and site visits through our mapping platform, giving back time, speeding up their sales process, and increasing their profitability. We are building the next-generation property intelligence platform and looking for people to help out on our mission to revolutionize how businesses make decisions in North America.

To learn more about the team & our origin story - https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

To learn more about what we do for our customers - https://order.siterecon.ai

**About the team:**

Started by IIT Delhi alumni who have worked with multinationals in satellite imaging, e-commerce, and edtech sectors.

**Meet our team:**
https://order.siterecon.ai/team

**About Product:**

SiteRecon is the Amazon + Google Docs combination for maps. Users place an order to create a map. State-of-the-art AI does our data delivery with a humans-in-the-loop pipeline. This becomes the basemap to create survey notes, operations plans, cost estimates, and so on.

**About the Market:**

Although our technology applies to many applications especially related to the site-based operations industry, our Primary market is the landscaping industry in the United States, Canada, and Australia. The combined size of Industry in these 3 countries alone makes up a staggering $140B.

We are looking for individuals who have done graduation in Geo informatics Science, and also have an experience of about 0 to 1 year of experience with expertise in GIS software i.e. QGIS/ArcGIS to fill the position at Futuresafe Technologies. Exposure to IT/Software start-ups /industries will be an added advantage

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Create, edit, and update digital maps and spatial data using QGIS.
* Perform digitization of geographic features from satellite imagery, aerial photography, and other data sources.
* Ensure accuracy and precision in map creation, maintaining high-quality standards.
* Collaborate with team members to integrate geospatial data for various projects and reports.
* Perform data conversion and analysis, transforming paper maps into digital formats.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize geodatabases for efficient data management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve GIS-related issues, ensuring smooth workflow.
* Stay updated with advancements in GIS technologies and incorporate them into the work process.
* Flexibility to adapt and manage within a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.
* History of teamwork and willingness to support the team to get the job done.

**Qualifications**
:

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (Geography, Cartography, GIS, or related field will be preferred)
* Basic experience in GIS mapping and digitization, with strong proficiency in ArcGIS/QGIS.
* Familiarity with GIS data formats and data management.
* Experience with spatial analysis, map projections, and coordinate systems.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in cartographic work.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

If your skills and interests align with the job posting, we encourage you to apply to the job posting!!!

**Job Description**
WSP is currently initiating a search for a Full Time Principal Detailer - Transmission Tower Details (High Voltage) for our Noida / Bengaluru / Mumbai office. * Serve as a Principal Detailer for high-voltage HVAC lattice transmission towers, supporting new tower designs, modifications, upgrades, rebuilds, and asset replacement projects.

title: Senior IGA Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an
**IGA Engineer**
to design, build, operate, and sustain the enterprise Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) platform that serves as the control plane for how identity and access are governed across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and enhancing IGA capabilities—connectors, workflows, roles, and integrations—while keeping the platform healthy, reliable, and audit-ready, and executing the SOX ITGC controls that make it a trusted, compliant system of record for access.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role spanning both build and run: configuring and developing new capabilities, integrating target systems, and enhancing governance workflows on one side, and sustaining platform health, change management, vendor-coordinated migrations, incident resolution, and control execution on the other. The engineer turns requirements into working configuration and code, keeps the platform available, and ensures every SOX-relevant activity is performed on schedule with complete, clean evidence. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on experience with an enterprise IGA platform (SailPoint, Saviynt, or equivalent) combined with strong ITGC/SOX discipline and an operations-and-audit mindset.
  
  
The IGA platform is a business-critical, SOX-scoped security capability. Operational lapses translate directly into two kinds of failure: disruptions that block provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews, and control failures that produce audit findings and compliance exposure. This position is critical to ensuring the platform is stable, well-instrumented, and rarely surprises the business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IGA Development & Engineering**

* Design, develop, and enhance IGA capabilities—connectors, integrations, joiner/mover/leaver (JML) and access-request workflows, roles, entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules—to meet evolving governance and business requirements.
* Build and maintain integrations between the IGA platform and target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Translate governance and access-model requirements into working configuration and code, following engineering standards and design patterns.
* Test, document, and promote changes through the appropriate environments with quality and maintainability in mind.

**Platform Operations**

* Operate, administer, and sustain the IGA platform so it runs reliably day to day, resolving sync, provisioning, and workflow failures as they arise.
* Execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes through disciplined change control, with validated cutover and rollback plans.
* Maintain and enforce environment segregation between non-production and production.

**Observability, Monitoring & Reliability**

* Configure and continuously tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards for the platform, its connectors, and its governance workflows.
* Establish leading-indicator alerting (connector health, provisioning failures, job/queue depth, workflow errors) so degradations are caught before they disrupt users.
* Ensure failures generate alerts and that recurring errors are escalated into incidents per defined procedures.
* Define and track availability and health metrics for the platform and its critical workflows.

**Incident & Problem Management**

* Investigate and resolve incidents affecting the IGA platform and its governance workflows, restoring service and following the incident management process.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring platform issues and implement durable preventive fixes.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to support consistent incident handling.

**Change & Release Management**

* Execute changes through the standard change management process—documented change requests, testing, and appropriate business/IT approvals before production migration.
* Enforce segregation of duties between developers and operations on production migrations; ensure any developer activity in production is monitored, logged, and reviewed.
* Support periodic change reviews and emergency-change post-implementation reviews.

**Vendor & Migration Coordination**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for platform and managed-service vendors during upgrades, migrations, and platform changes.
* Plan and execute migration/upgrade cutovers—scheduling, pre-checks, validation testing, rollback plans, and go/no-go decisions—and hold vendors accountable to SLAs.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and cloud teams on environment or backup dependencies.

**SOX & ITGC Compliance Execution**

* Own timely, accurate execution and evidence collection for the IGA platform's SOX control set, working within the broader IAM SOX program's governance and cadence.
* Execute access-administration controls: provisioning and account changes, terminations/deactivations, administrative and user-account revalidations, SoD/role matrix maintenance, and privileged account activity reviews.
* Execute change-management controls in line with the segregation-of-duties requirements above, and support SOC 1/SOC 2 report review and periodic governance and risk reviews.
* Investigate exceptions, assess impact, document results, and drive deficiencies to remediation; ensure no self-review on any revalidation control.
* Operate in a continuous audit-ready posture and support internal and external audit requests with complete, on-time evidence.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Use scripting to make configuration and control execution repeatable, reviewable, and auditable, reducing operational toil and tightening the loop between operations and evidence collection.
* Maintain knowledge continuity through documentation and runbooks so no single control or activity depends on one individual.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–7 years in IAM/IGA engineering and operations, with hands-on experience configuring and developing on an enterprise IGA platform.
* Proven experience building and operating an enterprise IGA platform in production (SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on IGA development and administration: connectors/integrations, JML and access-request workflows, roles/entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules.
* Solid grounding in IAM fundamentals: authentication, SSO (SAML/OIDC), provisioning/SCIM, RBAC, JML, and SoD concepts.
* Experience building and integrating with target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Experience with observability and monitoring for application platforms—building meaningful alerts and dashboards, not just consuming them.
* Experience with incident and change management via ITSM tooling.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of platform tasks and evidence collection.

**Compliance Skills And Experience**

* SOX compliance and ITGC control testing experience.
* Ability to think, review, document, and challenge evidence from an auditor's perspective.
* Experience managing internal and external audit engagements.
* Strong understanding of IAM processes, access controls, and evidence validation.
* Ability to assess compliance risks and identify control gaps.
* Strong documentation and communication skills for auditor interactions and compliance reporting.
* Hands-on experience executing and evidencing core ITGC control types—access provisioning/deprovisioning, periodic user and privileged access reviews/recertification, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
* Change-management control experience—change request tracking, testing, approvals, and dev-to-prod segregation of duties.
* Experience with deficiency and exception management—investigating exceptions, assessing impact, and tracking remediation to closure.
* Discipline to execute recurring controls on cadence and sustain audit-ready evidence.
* Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports, including complementary user entity controls (CUECs).
* Familiarity with GRC/compliance tooling for evidence and control management.
* Experience working with enterprise IAM platforms such as AD, SailPoint/Saviynt, etc. is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant IGA platform certification or equivalent platform-specific training.
* Deeper experience developing and troubleshooting IGA connectors and integrations.
* Experience leading IGA platform migrations or major version upgrades.
* Prior experience partnering with GRC, Internal Audit, and External Audit in a regulated enterprise.
* General awareness of the cloud environment the platform runs in—enough to coordinate effectively with infrastructure and vendor teams (deep cloud engineering not required).

Why This Role Is Critical
  
  
The IGA platform is where access is governed and where a significant set of SOX ITGC controls are executed. Without dedicated engineering, operational, and compliance ownership, the platform is exposed on two fronts at once: reliability and audit.
  
  
**This Role Directly Protects The Organization From**

* Platform and workflow disruptions that block onboarding, delay deprovisioning, and stall access reviews.
* SOX control failures and audit findings—missed revalidations, broken change/SoD discipline, incomplete evidence.
* Failed or delayed platform migrations and upgrades due to a lack of internal accountability.
* Incident-handling and control-coverage gaps that threaten compliance and continuity.
* Over-dependence on premium-priced vendor and contractor support.

This position is for an engineer who builds, runs, and keeps a business-critical, SOX-scoped platform effective—someone who understands that in a regulated identity platform, engineering, reliability, and compliance are the same job.

WSP is a global consulting firm assisting public and private clients to plan, develop, design, construct, operate and maintain thousands of critical infrastructure projects around the world.
  
  
Reporting into the SailPoint Lead Analyst, Identity Access Operations; the SailPoint IIQ Operations Analyst will be responsible for performing the day-to-day operations and maintenance of our SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) platform. The Mentors Circle has been sending Indian students to universities in Ireland and the UK since 2014. We’ve placed more than 15,000 students, our visa success rate is 98%, and we’re endorsed by Enterprise Ireland. We’re hiring a specialist to own each student’s file from university application to visa approval.

**About the role**

Once a counsellor has finalised a student’s university shortlist, the file is yours. You’ll prepare and submit university applications, manage offers, deposits and CAS documents, and then prepare and file the student visa. You’ll be the single owner of each file and give a clear
**file / don’t file yet**
decision before any visa is submitted. Students and parents will deal with one person they trust, and counsellors can concentrate on counselling.

**What you’ll do**

*Applications and offers*

* Prepare and submit applications to Irish and UK universities through university portals and partner platforms
* Check transcripts, degree certificates, English test scores, LORs, CVs and SOPs for completeness and consistency before submission
* Follow up with university admissions teams on application status, conditions and decisions
* Manage conditional and unconditional offers, acceptances, deposits, CAS requests and confirmation documents
* Track deadlines and intakes, and make sure no application is late or incomplete

*Visa*

* Prepare, review and file Ireland Long Stay (D) study visas and UK Student visas from start to finish
* Assess funds and sponsors early, ideally while the offer is still being processed, and flag gaps months before filing: unexplained deposits, funds that haven’t been held long enough, missing proof of income or weak sponsor documents
* Check that the SOP, cover letter, financial statements and sponsor affidavits are consistent with each other and with the student’s history
* Check every file against current Irish immigration and UKVI requirements before submission
* Manage VFS and UKVCAS appointments, biometrics, TB tests, medical insurance and tracking
* Prepare students for credibility interviews

*Refusals, after arrival and quality*

* Analyse every refusal, prepare appeals or reapplications, and share what we learn with the counselling team
* Support students after arrival with residence permit registration, eVisa questions and renewals
* Keep our application and visa checklists up to date as rules change, and train counsellors every quarter
* Keep each student’s stage in our CRM accurate, from application through offer and deposit to visa

**What we’re looking for**

* A graduate in any discipline
* 2–5 years in study abroad applications and student visas, including
  **Ireland and/or UK visa files you’ve prepared and filed yourself**
* Hands-on experience with university applications, offers, deposits and CAS or confirmation documents
* A solid understanding of financial evidence: bank statements, education loans, sponsor income, ITRs and the rules on how long funds must be held
* Exceptional attention to detail. One mismatched date or unexplained deposit can cause a refusal
* Strong written English for applications, cover letters, appeals and correspondence with universities
* The confidence to tell a counsellor or a family that a file isn’t ready, and hold that position
* Organised under seasonal pressure, especially in June–August and November–December

**What we offer**

* A competitive fixed salary, plus an annual bonus linked to our visa success rate
* Full ownership of each student file from application to visa
* A direct reporting line to the Founder & Director
* Exposure to Irish and UK university partners, admissions teams and immigration updates
* A path to Head of Applications & Visa as we grow

**How to apply**

Applications through LinkedIn Easy Apply.

The Senior Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online Engineer provides day-to-day platform engineering and operational ownership across the Microsoft 365 tenants supporting the Enterprise 1099 population. This role supports a dedicated engineering function responsible for governing and securing the Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments for USHealth Group, HealthMarkets, and First Family Insurance. * Plan and execute mailbox onboarding, migration waves, coexistence activities, cutover tasks, and post-migration support

* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for repeatable administration, validation, reporting, and bulk operations
* Troubleshoot service incidents, mail delivery issues, client connectivity, permissions, and configuration defects
* Execute changes through approved ServiceNow and enterprise change-management processes
* Coordinate with identity and email security engineers to deliver integrated, secure tenant services

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online in a large or complex environment
* Experience executing migrations and supporting production cutovers and hypercare
* Demonstrated experience with recipient management, transport configuration, migration, mail flow, and service troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of identity dependencies, security controls, DNS, SMTP, and enterprise monitoring

* Experience using Rally or comparable Kanban/work management tools for project, operational task, and dependency tracking
* Experience supporting globally distributed or offshore operational models
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Graph

**Measures of Success**

* Microsoft 365 services meet agreed availability, configuration, and operational standards
* Changes, incidents, and service requests are completed through controlled, auditable processes
* Automation reduces manual effort and improves administrative consistency and evidence quality

**Key Partnerships**

India’s Future Investors (IFI) is India’s Money Entertainment Reality Show where real-world money scenarios, time-bound challenges, and rising pressure reveal how people think and make financial decisions. We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with

**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.

* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: eCommerce Growth Manager
description:
**Company:**
Transverse Solutions

**Location:**
Noida

**Work Mode:**
Full-time | On-site / Hybrid

**Experience:**
2-4 years

**Compensation:**
₹25,000–₹35,000 per month + performance incentives

**About Transverse Solutions**

Transverse Solutions is an eCommerce consultancy helping brands build, launch and grow their businesses online.

We work with D2C brands across Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart and other digital commerce platforms - bringing together eCommerce strategy, technology, performance marketing and conversion optimisation.

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing & Marketplace Manager who can take ownership of the digital growth of our clients and, most importantly, help turn marketing activity into measurable sales.

**The Role**

This is not a social media management role.

And it is not a role where success is measured by how many campaigns were launched or how many reports were prepared. You will be responsible for growing sales for assigned eCommerce brands across: Shopify + Meta Ads + Google Ads + Amazon + Flipkart + Other Marketplaces.

You will independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise campaigns and marketplace operations for your assigned clients.

You will typically own 4 major client accounts at a time, with the possibility of supporting a few additional accounts on smaller requirements.

Your core question every day should be:
*“What can we do today to sell more profitably than yesterday?”*

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Performance Marketing - Meta Ads

* Independently plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns for D2C brands.
* Develop acquisition, retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Manage campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers and campaign approaches.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns.
* Monitor key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and revenue.
* Manage and optimise campaigns based on agreed client objectives.

2. Google Ads

* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns.
* Work across Search, Shopping and Performance Max as relevant.
* Manage keyword strategy, search terms, budgets and bidding.
* Monitor product/feed-related issues in coordination with the relevant team.
* Optimise campaigns based on conversion and revenue data.
* Identify opportunities for profitable scaling.
* Track and analyse Google Ads performance alongside Shopify sales data.

3. Shopify eCommerce Growth

While you will not be responsible for Shopify development, you will be responsible for understanding the sales funnel and identifying where marketing performance is being affected. You should be comfortable analysing: Ad → Landing Page → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase

You will:

* Monitor Shopify sales and conversion metrics.
* Identify funnel drop-offs.
* Analyse product-level performance.
* Identify products that should be promoted or deprioritised.
* Recommend improvements to offers, promotions and campaigns.
* Work closely with our eCommerce/Shopify team when website or CRO issues are identified.
* Connect advertising performance with actual business revenue.

4. Amazon & Flipkart Management

Take end-to-end ownership of assigned marketplace accounts. Responsibilities include:

Marketplace account management.

Product catalogue management.

Listing optimisation.

Keyword optimisation.

Search visibility improvement.

Sponsored Ads / marketplace advertising.

Product-level sales analysis.

Campaign optimisation.

Promotions and deal planning.

Pricing and offer recommendations.

Identifying high-potential SKUs.

Identifying underperforming products.

Monitoring account health and operational issues.

Monitoring inventory-related issues and coordinating with clients.

Regularly analysing marketplace reports and identifying growth opportunities.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

You should be comfortable working with numbers.

You will be expected to:

\* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly performance.

\* Analyse advertising and sales data.

\* Track ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and revenue.

\* Identify trends and anomalies.

\* Prepare concise performance reports.

\* Translate data into actionable recommendations.

\* Explain why performance changed, not simply report what changed.

We don’t want dashboards full of numbers.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and say:

*“Here’s the problem. Here’s why it’s happening. Here’s what I’m going to do about it.”*

**Working With Our Internal Team**

You will work closely with:

Head – Digital Marketing

For digital strategy, SEO, marketplace expertise and overall marketing direction.

eCommerce / Shopify Team

For website, CRO, tracking and technical requirements.

Creative & Content Team

For ad creatives, content and campaign briefs.

Founder / Leadership

For client strategy, commercial priorities and growth planning.

You will be responsible for translating strategy into execution and measurable performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

*Must Have*

\* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing/eCommerce.

\* Proven experience managing client brands, preferably D2C/eCommerce.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads.

\* Experience managing Amazon and/or Flipkart accounts.

\* Good understanding of Shopify and the D2C sales funnel.

\* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and other performance metrics.

\* Ability to independently launch and optimise campaigns.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable taking ownership of client performance.

\* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage deadlines.

*Strong Advantage*

\* Experience scaling D2C brands.

\* Experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets.

\* Experience with Amazon Sponsored Ads.

\* Experience with Flipkart Ads.

\* Experience with Google Shopping / Performance Max.

\* Experience with GA4, Google Merchant Center and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

\* Experience with quick-commerce platforms.

\* Experience working with fashion, beauty, food, toys, lifestyle or other consumer brands.

**The Person We’re Looking For**

*You could be a great fit if you:*

\* Think about sales, not just campaigns.

\* Enjoy looking at data and figuring out what’s wrong.

\* Don’t need to be told what to optimise.

\* Can independently manage an account from strategy to execution.

\* Are comfortable experimenting and testing.

\* Know that a campaign being “live” doesn’t mean it is successful.

\* Can explain performance in simple business terms.

\* Take ownership when numbers aren’t working.

\* Are curious about why customers buy - and why they don’t.

*You may NOT be the right fit if:*

\* Your primary experience is social media posting/community management.

\* You have only executed campaigns based on someone else’s instructions.

\* You primarily create reports without taking action on them.

\* You have never independently managed ad accounts.

\* You consider “campaign launched” to be the end of the job.

\* You are uncomfortable being accountable for measurable performance.

**How We Measure Success**

Your performance will ultimately be evaluated on the growth and efficiency of the accounts you manage. Key metrics may include:

* Revenue Growth
* ROAS / CAC
* Conversion Rate
* Paid Traffic Quality
* Marketplace Sales Growth
* Marketplace Advertising Efficiency
* Account Health

Execution Quality & Timeliness

The exact targets will vary by client depending on their category, product, pricing, margins, inventory, website and stage of growth.

**Compensation**

₹25,000-₹35,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Additional performance incentives may be offered based on account-level performance and achievement of agreed targets.

**Why Join Transverse Solutions?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work on real eCommerce businesses, not just isolated advertising campaigns.

You’ll work across:

Shopify → Meta → Google → Amazon → Flipkart → Quick Commerce

and understand how all these channels come together to build an actual eCommerce business.

If you’re someone who gets excited when a client’s numbers move from:

₹5L → ₹8L → ₹12L

rather than simply getting excited about a campaign going live… we’d like to meet you.

**Apply**

Please share your CV along with a brief note highlighting:

title: Global Enterprise Support
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
Job Details
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As an Incident & Support Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for end users, providing hands-on technical support for laptops, desktops, peripherals, and office IT infrastructure. You will handle hardware troubleshooting, laptop imaging, software deployment, and endpoint management through Microsoft Intune to ensure employees have reliable, secure, and well-configured devices.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Desktop & Laptop Support
* Provide hands-on (deskside) and remote technical support for hardware, software, and peripheral issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues on Windows and macOS, business applications, printers, and other office equipment.
* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, monitors, docking stations, and meeting room AV equipment.
* Laptop Imaging & Device Provisioning
* Perform laptop imaging, reimaging, and OS deployment using standard build images and provisioning tools.
* Set up and configure new devices, including hardware, OS, applications, and security configurations.
* Manage device lifecycle: deployment, refresh, and secure decommissioning, with accurate asset records.
* Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management
* Manage endpoint devices via Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) — enrollment, compliance, and configuration profiles.
* Deploy applications, security updates, and patches through Intune and Microsoft endpoint management tools.
* Troubleshoot Intune enrollment, conditional access, and compliance issues; support Autopilot zero-touch provisioning.
* Hardware Expertise
* Diagnose and repair hardware faults; coordinate vendor warranty replacements where required.
* Perform component-level troubleshooting (RAM, SSD, motherboard, battery, display, keyboard, etc.).
* Manage hardware spares inventory and support office network basics (Wi-Fi, switches, cabling, printers).
* Contribute to IT projects such as office moves, new site setups, hardware refreshes, and security rollouts.
* Incident Management & Ticketing
* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets in line with defined SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper documentation and follow-through to closure.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, requests, and resolutions in the ticketing system.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 3–5 years' experience as an Incident & Support Analyst, Desktop Support Engineer, or similar hands-on end-user support role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in laptop and desktop hardware — installation, troubleshooting, and component replacement.
* Experience with laptop imaging tools such as MDT, SCCM, or Windows Autopilot.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune for endpoint management and policy configuration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 administration; macOS support a plus.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure AD / Entra ID, and Active Directory.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi troubleshooting).
* Experience with IT ticketing/ITSM tools.
* Strong customer service orientation with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft MD-102, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, or ITIL Foundation.
* PowerShell scripting experience for automation of routine tasks.
* Exposure to mobile device management for iOS and Android.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, and antivirus management.

Work Conditions
  
  

* Primarily on-site role to provide hands-on support at office locations.
* Occasional travel between sites and after-hours support for critical issues or deployments.
* Physical ability to lift and move IT equipment as part of routine duties.

**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
  
  
With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Campaign Manager – YouTube Expert
description:
**JOB TITLE**

**Campaign Manager – YouTube Expert**

**Location**
: Headquarters – Noida, India

**Experience**
: 7–8 Years (exclusively in YouTube advertising)

**Department**
: Ad Operations – Branding Department

**Segment**
: Pulse (https://pulsevid.ai/)(Contextual Targeting & Brand Safety)

**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global ad-tech leader providing AI-driven, programmatically unified advertising

solutions across branding and performance channels. Operating across key global markets including

India, UAE, Russia, Singapore, Indonesia, US, UK, and Germany, Xapads empowers agencies and global

brands with privacy-first, cookie-less targeting and advanced campaign activation. Through intelligent

platforms like Pulse and Xaprio, Xapads seamlessly bridges audience engagement and brand safety

across video, connected TV (CTV), display, and mobile ecosystems.

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

Pulse (https://pulsevid.ai/) is Xapads’ proprietary AI-powered contextual targeting and brand safety/suitability platform built for YouTube advertising. By analyzing video frames, audio, emotions, and metadata in real time, Pulse delivers GARM-compliant brand protection and contextual placement precision across Google Ads and Display & Video 360 (DV360).

**THE ROLE**

The Campaign Manager – YouTube Expert exists to strengthen and scale YouTube campaign execution

across global markets for Xapads' Pulse product. Sitting within the Ad Operations - Branding team, you

will own end-to-end strategy, setup, pacing, optimization, and measurement across Google Ads and

DV360. The role bridges brand awareness with direct performance outcomes (ROAS, conversions, app

installs), utilizing Pulse’s contextual intelligence capabilities to achieve client key performance indicators

(KPIs) while maintaining strict brand safety standards.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

● Campaign Delivery: Own campaign setup, daily run rates, pacing, budget allocation, and delivery

quality across assigned YouTube accounts.

● Performance & Optimization: Own campaign performance diagnosis, bidding strategies, and

multi-KPI optimization across both branding and performance objectives.

● Pulse Integration: Own the execution and tactical implementation of Pulse’s contextual

targeting, brand safety, and brand suitability layers within live campaign workflows.

● Measurement & Reporting: Own campaign reporting, attribution analysis, and post-campaign

insights across Google Ads and DV360.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

● Campaign Setup & Activation: Plan, configure, and launch complex YouTube campaigns through

both Google Ads and DV360, utilizing line items, insertion orders, and ad groups.

● Format & Inventory Management: Execute campaigns across diverse YouTube ad formats

including skippable in-stream, non-skippable in-stream, bumper ads, in-feed, YouTube Shorts,

connected TV (CTV), and high-impact placements.

● Performance Driving: Implement visual-first Demand Gen and cross-channel Performance Max

(PMax) strategies to drive performance outcomes such as cost per acquisition (CPA), return on

ad spend (ROAS), and app installs.

● Contextual & Brand Safety Execution: Deploy Pulse’s AI-powered contextual filters,

GARM-compliant exclusion lists, and custom safe-lists to maximize ad relevance and maintain

suitability.

● Attribution & Measurement: Analyze conversion tracking, post-impression installs,

engaged-view conversions (EVC), and view-through conversions (VTC) to evaluate full-funnel

video influence.

● Policy & Compliance Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve platform approval bottlenecks,

restricted content categories, and Google YouTube policy compliance issues.

● Reporting & Analysis: Prepare actionable performance reports for internal teams and clients,

highlighting view-through rate (VTR), video completion rate (VCR), cost per view (CPV), and

conversion metrics.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

● 7–8 Years of Dedicated Experience: Minimum 7–8 years of direct, hands-on experience

managing YouTube ad campaigns.

● Dual-Platform Proficiency: Proven expertise in operating YouTube campaigns natively across

both Google Ads and DV360 (YouTube & Partners line items).

● Full-Funnel Campaign Ownership: Demonstrated experience managing both reach/awareness

(CPM, VTR, VCR) and performance/conversion campaigns (tCPA, tROAS, CVR, app installs).

● Advanced Campaign Formats: Hands-on experience with Demand Gen and Performance Max

(PMax) campaign setup, video asset strategy, and performance optimization.

● Attribution & Tracking Knowledge: Practical understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking,

Floodlight pixels, engaged-view conversions (EVC), view-through conversions (VTC), and

attribution windows.

● Policy & Operations: Working knowledge of Google advertising policies, campaign approval

workflows, and troubleshooting restricted or sensitive ad categories.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

● Leadership Capability: Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members while operating as

an individual contributor.

● Multi-Market Exposure: Experience managing multi-region or global YouTube campaign

portfolios.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

● Independent Execution: Independently manages YouTube campaigns across Google Ads and

DV360.

● KPI Consistency & Efficiency: Consistently meets agreed client delivery targets and

demonstrates measurable improvements in campaign efficiency, ROAS, and completion rates.

● Pulse Integration: Seamlessly integrates Pulse’s AI contextual targeting and brand suitability

capabilities into daily campaign workflows to maximize ad relevance.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can apply directly by sharing their updated resume with the HR team at

career@xapads.com or visiting www.xapads.com/careers.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.

title: Tech Lead – IAM (Identity and Access Management)_ 11-15yrs Exp IRC304407
description:
**Description**
Tech Lead – IAM (Identity and Access Management)
  
  
Exp- 10 to 15 Years
  
  
Location-Any GL Locations
  
  
Hybrid Work Mode
  
  
**Requirements**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Tech Lead to guide a team in designing, implementing, and supporting modern Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in authentication and authorization frameworks and play a pivotal role in securing our systems through robust IAM strategies. The role requires hands-on experience with Duende IdentityServer (v6 and v4), cloud identity platforms, and strong collaboration with cross-functional global teams, particularly with senior architects and engineering stakeholders in the US.
  
  
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  
8+ years of overall software development experience with at least 4+ years in IAM.
  
  
Expertise in Duende IdentityServer (v6/v4) or any other IDM server, GoF design patterns, OIDC/OAuth2, .NET Core, and modern authentication protocols. Python is a plus
  
  
Hands-on experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, and related standards.
  
  
Experience with cloud-native IAM services (Azure AD, Okta, AWS Cognito, etc.).
  
  
Solid understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) as it applies to IAM.
  
  
Familiarity with serverless architecture design and implementation.
  
  
Knowledge of directory services (LDAP, Active Directory) and federation protocols.
  
  
Proficient in scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) to automate IAM workflows.
  
  
Experience with tools like Keycloak, ForgeRock, or Ping Identity is a plus.
  
  
Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to negotiate and align technical approaches with client architects.
  
  
Strong documentation and system design skills using tools like Visio, Draw.io, or Lucidchart.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Okta Certified Professional, or CISSP.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (Healthcare, Finance, etc.) is a plus.
  
  
Prior experience working with distributed global teams and agile methodologies.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Lead and mentor a technical team responsible for IAM implementation and support activities.
  
  
Work closely with Architect to Design, and develop scalable IAM solutions using Duende IdentityServer v6/v4.
  
  
Implement secure authentication and authorization protocols including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
  
  
Configure and manage Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across multiple applications and identity providers.
  
  
Define and enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) frameworks.
  
  
Automate identity lifecycle processes using tools such as Azure AD Connect, Okta Workflows, or similar.
  
  
Ensure systems adhere to GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA, and other relevant compliance and security standards.
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve complex authentication and access issues in collaboration with support teams.
  
  
Maintain and evolve cloud-native IAM solutions across AWS.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise Architecture, Security, and DevOps teams to align IAM solutions with organizational security strategy.
  
  
Drive documentation and knowledge sharing around identity governance, policies, and architecture.
  
  
Excellend communicaiton skills to present and defend architectural decisions to client stakeholders, demonstrating both technical depth and business understanding.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
**About the role**

Axeno’s conversion rate optimization (CRO) and experimentation practice helps enterprise clients grow website conversion. We turn analytics evidence into prioritised experiments and personalized experiences, and prove the business impact.

As Scrum Master & CRO Specialist you are the analytical and delivery lead of a CRO squad. You own journey analysis, drop-off diagnosis, hypotheses, experiment design and KPI interpretation, and you run the sprint cadence that keeps every cycle on time, evidence-backed and decision-ready. You will also strengthen the practice by evolving the playbooks, templates and ways of working we reuse across clients.

**What you will do**

**CRO and insights**

•   
**Journey and funnel analysis.**
Analyse the end-to-end website journey in Adobe Analytics. Build funnels, fallout and cohort views by source, device and new vs returning traffic.

•   
**Drop-off diagnosis.**
Combine quantitative funnels with session replay, heatmaps, zoning and journey analysis from Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare to explain friction.

•   
**Hypotheses.**
Produce focused insight briefs with ranked hypotheses, each with evidence, affected audience and a primary KPI.

•   
**Experiment design.**
Specify tests (A/B, experience targeting, personalization rules) with primary KPI, eligible audience, minimum detectable effect, allocation, control and decision window. Report absolute and relative effect with uncertainty and guardrails, and call “continue learning” when the evidence says so.

•   
**Measurement integrity.**
Define and maintain a measurement contract: journey events, experiment IDs, and reconciliation across SDK, analytics and server/CRM counts. Link website conversions to downstream lead quality.

•   
**Reporting.**
Maintain KPI dashboards covering conversion, lead quality and guardrails (Core Web Vitals, form reliability, personalization delivery, data integrity).

•   
**Activation partnership.**
Work with personalization and engineering specialists on Adobe Target and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization campaigns: targeting logic, preview and tracking QA, rollout and rollback.

**Scrum and delivery**

•   
Run a fortnightly delivery cycle: evidence mining, test agreement, build and verify, release and review. Facilitate planning, daily check-ins, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

•   
Own the prioritised backlog and a written decision log (launch, continue, revise, stop, escalate). Prioritise by opportunity, effort and traffic using a framework such as ICE or PIE.

•   
Track dependencies on client platform, data and BAU teams (access, consent, SDK, approved content). Raise blockers and risks early, and keep acceptance evidence for every deliverable.

•   
Be the day-to-day contact for client marketing and digital stakeholders. Present readouts in plain business language, without overclaiming uplift.

**Practice contribution**

•   
Maintain and improve reusable assets: hypothesis and experiment brief templates, QA checklists, KPI frameworks, dashboards and a CRO operating playbook.

•   
Support pre-sales and proposals with CRO approach, scoping and case studies. Coach junior analysts and personalization specialists across the team.

**﻿
Must-have requirements**

**Non-negotiable**

*Hands-on CRO delivery for comparable customers (large consumer or lead-generation websites, ideally automotive, BFSI or other high-consideration journeys), with proven, quantified impact you can walk us through.*

•   
6–7 years in web analytics, CRO or digital optimization, with at least 3 years running an experimentation programme end to end.

•   
Case studies we can verify: the problem, hypothesis, test design, result (with confidence or uncertainty) and business impact, e.g. lift in lead or conversion rate without loss in lead quality.

•   
Strong Adobe Analytics skills: Analysis Workspace, segments, calculated metrics, fallout and flow, eVars/props/events.

•   
Hands-on experience with Adobe Target (activities, audiences, A/B and experience targeting, QA; A4T is a plus).

•   
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare for session replay, heatmaps, zone-based and journey analysis.

•   
Working knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio) and how Data Cloud segments feed website personalization.

•   
Solid grasp of experiment statistics: sample size and MDE, significance and confidence intervals, sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, overlapping tests.

•   
Scrum fundamentals: you can run ceremonies, manage a backlog and unblock a team. CSM or PSM certification preferred.

•   
Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn data into a recommendation for non-technical stakeholders.

**Good to have**

•   
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target or Salesforce certifications.

•   
Experience with consent-aware measurement and privacy-safe personalization (including India DPDP requirements).

•   
Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, tag management (Adobe Launch, GTM) and basic SQL or Python for ad-hoc analysis.

•   
Experience linking web leads to CRM or dealer outcomes (Salesforce, Data Cloud).

•   
Agency or consulting background with client-facing experience.
